description:
**Job Title:** 
 3D Texturing Artist.
 



**Department:** 
 Immersive Technologies.
 



**Location:** 
 Vapi, Gujarat.
 



**Reports To:** 
 XR Lead
 



**Experience:** 
 2–5 Years
 



**Job Purpose:** 




 To create high\-quality, physically based (PBR) textures and technical art maps for a physics\-driven robotic surgical training simulator built in Unity. The role will be responsible for texturing surgical instruments, medical devices, operating\-room environments, metals, plastics, sterile surfaces, and organic tissues while maintaining consistent texel density, material quality, memory efficiency, and real\-time rendering performance suitable for workstation GPU environments.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. PBR Texturing \& Material Creation** 




 • Create production\-ready PBR textures for surgical instruments, medical devices, robotic components, operating\-room environments, and organic assets.
 



 • Develop high\-quality Albedo/Base Color, Normal, Metallic, Roughness/Smoothness, Ambient Occlusion, and other required texture maps.
 



 • Create realistic material definitions for metals, plastics, glass, rubber, ceramics, surgical surfaces, sterile materials, and biological/organic tissues.
 



 • Develop textures from 3D model and sculpt handoffs while preserving required surface details and visual fidelity.
 



 • Ensure physically accurate material response appropriate for real\-time surgical simulation.
 



**2\. Channel\-Packed Texture \& Technical Art Workflows** 




 • Create and maintain channel\-packed textures to optimize GPU memory and material performance.
 



 • Implement project\-specific packing standards such as:
 


* R \= Metallic
* G \= Ambient Occlusion
* A \= Smoothness
* • Ensure gloss/smoothness and roughness maps are correctly converted and exported according to the defined Unity pipeline.
* • Validate packed textures for accuracy, consistency, and compatibility with Unity materials.
* • Support optimization of texture memory through efficient channel usage and resolution management.



**3\. Trim Sheet \& Modular Asset Texturing** 




 • Develop and maintain trim\-sheet workflows for modular surgical instruments, robotic components, and environment asset families.
 



 • Create efficient UV layouts that maximize texture\-space utilization.
 



 • Ensure consistent material appearance across assets using shared trim sheets and reusable texture libraries.
 



 • Support modular asset development while minimizing redundant texture memory and draw\-call overhead.
 



**4\. UV Mapping \& Texel Density Management** 




 • Create and optimize UV layouts using Maya, Blender, or equivalent tools.
 



 • Maintain consistent texel density across the complete asset library.
 



 • Ensure appropriate UV packing and utilization based on asset importance and camera visibility.
 



 • Support second UV channel creation for lightmap UVs where baked lighting is used.
 



 • Identify and resolve UV overlaps, stretching, distortion, seams, and inefficient texture\-space utilization.
 



**5\. Substance Painter / Designer Workflow** 




 • Create production\-ready textures using
 **Substance Painter, Substance Designer, or equivalent PBR tools** 
 .
 



 • Build reusable Substance materials, procedural textures, and graphs for frequently used materials and asset families.
 



 • Generate textures from high\-poly sculpt and low\-poly model workflows.
 



 • Incorporate baked information such as curvature, cavity, AO, thickness, and other maps into material creation where required.
 



 • Maintain reusable and scalable material libraries for the simulation project.
 



**6\. Medical, Surgical \& Organic Material Development** 




 • Develop realistic material definitions for surgical instruments, medical devices, operating\-room surfaces, and organic tissues.
 



 • Create material variations for:
 


* Stainless steel and surgical metals
* Medical\-grade plastics
* Rubber and silicone
* Glass
* Sterile OR surfaces
* Soft tissues
* Anatomical structures
* Other medical/surgical materials
* • Work with clinical and visual SMEs where required to ensure appropriate representation of medical materials and surfaces.
* • Support the development of realistic tissue characteristics including surface variation, subtle color variation, roughness, folds, wrinkles, and tension\-related details.



**7\. Unity Look\-Development \& Validation** 




 • Validate materials and textures directly within Unity to ensure correct visual output and real\-time performance.
 



 • Work closely with Look\-Dev Artists, Technical Artists, Unity Developers, and Simulation Engineers to resolve material and rendering issues.
 



 • Verify correct interpretation of Normal, Metallic, Smoothness/Roughness, AO, and other texture maps within Unity.
 



 • Evaluate materials under different lighting conditions and camera distances relevant to surgical training scenarios.
 



 • Support optimization for workstation GPU budgets without compromising required visual quality.
 



**8\. Technical Art \& Performance Optimization** 




 • Optimize texture resolution, compression, channel packing, material complexity, and texture memory usage.
 



 • Create instancing\-friendly materials and reusable texture systems where required.
 



 • Support efficient texture workflows for modular environments and large asset libraries.
 



 • Identify performance bottlenecks related to textures and materials and recommend appropriate solutions.
 



 • Work with Technical Artists to maintain consistent rendering and material standards across the simulator.
 



**9\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 • Work closely with 3D Modelers, Sculpting Artists, Look\-Dev Artists, Technical Artists, Unity Developers, Simulation Engineers, and Clinical SMEs.
 



 • Receive and process asset handoffs from modeling and sculpting teams.
 



 • Collaborate with Look\-Dev and Technical Art teams to establish and maintain material standards.

 • Communicate texture quality issues, dependencies, and technical blockers proactively.
 



 • Explore new PBR, procedural texturing, technical\-art, and real\-time rendering techniques.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

 **Substance Painter and/or Substance Designer** 
 , or equivalent PBR texturing tools.

The organization is focused on ensuring that space remains accessible and safe for current and future missions.
 



  





**Role Description** 





 Cosmoserve Space is looking for a
 
 Computer Vision Engineer who is working on perception systems for spacecraft and space\-object relative navigation. He/She will design and build algorithms that estimate the 6\-DoF (position and orientation) of non\-cooperative or known space objects for autonomous rendezvous, proximity operations, and docking. This role sits at the intersection of classical computer vision (detection, geometry, calibration) and modern deep learning, with heavy use of synthetic data generated in simulation environments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 · Building vision\-based relative navigation pipelines for object detection, instance/semantic segmentation, and pose estimation of rigid space objects.
 



 · Working with PnP algrithms and RANSAC, epipolar geometry, and homography\-based pose recovery techniques, along with feature descriptors such as SIFT, ORB, etc
 



 · Applying data augmentation and domain randomization strategies to close the sim\-to\-real gap across illumination, albedo, distance, and attitude variations.
 



 · Handling classical image processing tasks, including filtering, morphological operations, and edge/contour and blob detection, alongside learned features.
 



 · Generating and curating photorealistic synthetic datasets in Blender, using procedural scenes, domain randomization, and automated ground\-truth pose/segmentation export.
 



 · Working across stereo and monocular camera geometry, including depth estimation, triangulation, and multi\-view sensor fusion.
 



 · Managing camera calibration workflows, including intrinsic/extrinsic parameters, lens distortion modeling, and stereo rectification, for single and multi\-camera rigs.
 



 · Optimizing and deploying models on embedded platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, using TensorRT, ONNX, and CUDA for real\-time inference, including profiling and quantization.
 



 · Collaborating with GNC (Guidance, Navigation \& Control) and simulation teams to feed pose and uncertainty estimates into the navigation filter.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




 · 2\+ years of relevant industry or research experience with a master’s degree, or 4\+ years of relevant industry or research experience, in Computer Vision, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.
 



 · Strong foundation in computer vision and deep learning: CNN backbones, detection architectures, segmentation architectures, pose estimation networks.
 



 · Solid grasp of projective geometry: PnP with RANSAC and Experience in applying data augmentation and domain randomization for robust, generalizable models.
 



 · Strong command of classical image processing using OpenCV (filtering, morphology, feature extraction, edge/contour detection).
 



 · Working knowledge of stereo and monocular camera geometry, depth estimation, and rectification.
 



 · Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, OpenCV, and NumPy, with hands\-on experience in model training, evaluation, and profiling.
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 · Hands\-on
 **camera calibration** 
 experience (single or multi\-camera, intrinsic/extrinsic).
 



 · Prior exposure to spacecraft navigation, robotics perception, or similar safety\-critical vision applications.
 



 · Familiarity with sensor fusion and state estimation (e.g., Kalman filtering) in a navigation context.

description:
**Description**
 Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
   

  

 UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. Node Receive COD team handles the process of receiving packages, routing them back to right origin, and handling Cash on delivery reconciliations and liabilities among driver, station and bank.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As an SDE\-2, you will develop a deep understanding of our business, work closely with development teams and own the architecture and end\-to\-end delivery of software components. Senior Engineers provide technical leadership at Amazon. They help establish technical standards and drive Amazon’s overall technical architecture, engineering practices, and methodologies. They work on our hard problems, building high quality, architecturally sound systems that are aligned with our business needs. They think globally when building systems, ensuring Amazon builds high performing, scalable systems that work well together. Senior engineers are pragmatic visionaries who can translate business needs into workable technology solutions. Their expertise is deep and broad. They are hands on, producing both detailed technical work and high\-level architectural designs.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience

title: Mechanical Engineer - Internship
description:
**About Airbound**
------------------

**Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.**


This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.


The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground\-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.


To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.

**About Hardware Engineering**
------------------------------


Hardware Engineering owns the aircraft's physical development, from a concept sketch to a part that flies. This spans system design, mechanism design, and structural design: working out how something moves, what it's made of, and whether it holds up under real load. Because most of what we design is custom, it also means designing the equipment we use to prove our work — rigs, jigs, and testers built specifically to validate a design before it goes anywhere near a real flight. It's one team across concept, design, initial prototyping, and test: the full arc of getting a product from an idea to something that ships.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're hiring a Mechanical Engineering Intern \- for freshers and university students who've built things with their own hands, not just studied how to. No prior professional experience is required; what we're looking for instead is real, hands\-on project experience: BAJA, FSAE, robotics teams, personal builds, or similar.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Mechanism \& Assembly Design**

* Support the design and development of mechanisms and mechanical assemblies for our aircraft, from early concept through production intent
* Build and test prototypes yourself — this is a hands\-on role, not a design\-and\-hand\-off one

**Analysis \& Validation**

* Assist with load calculations, tolerance stacks, basic FEA, and weight budgets to validate designs before they're cut or molded

**Manufacturing Process Exposure**

* Work with composites layup, injection molding, additive manufacturing, and CNC machining to learn how to choose the right process for each part

**Composites \& Structures Track**

* If focused on composites/structures: help us model and design composite structures — laminate design, layup optimization, and structural analysis — rather than just building to a fixed layup

**Mechanism Design Track**

* If focused on mechanism design help select actuation hardware — servos, stepper motors, and similar — and write short scripts to drive and test them

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Must\-Have**
--------------

* Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a degree in mechanical engineering or a related field
* Real hands\-on project experience (BAJA, FSAE, robotics, or similar build teams) that demonstrates genuine mechanism design or composites/structures work, not just coursework
* Working familiarity with 2D and 3D CAD
* Basic understanding of load calculations, tolerance analysis, and weight budgeting
* Strength in at least one of the following:


	+ Detailed mechanism design (including actuation hardware selection and basic scripting to drive and test it)
	+ Composites and structures (modeling and analysis, not just layup execution)
* Strong attention to detail and a willingness to get hands\-on with hardware
* Clear communicator, comfortable working with both internal teams and external vendors
* Willingness to go the extra mile when a project needs it

**Work location:** Hoskote, Bangalore (Headquarters)

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Comprehensive health insurance** to keep you and your loved ones covered
* **Relocation assistance and a daily travel stipend** to ease your commute
* **Advanced salary credit** to support you when you need it


“A driven, passionate team where you’ll have room to grow and thrive \- **this is more than just a job, it’s a rare opportunity to build something meaningful** from the ground up”

**Work Schedule:**
------------------

* In\-office role, working alternate Saturdays.

The **Travel Consultant** will be responsible for handling customer travel inquiries, understanding their requirements, preparing customized travel packages and quotations, following up with prospective customers, and converting inquiries into confirmed bookings.

The role involves managing the customer journey from the **initial inquiry through quotation, follow\-up, booking, payment, confirmation, and handover to the Operations Team.**

The Travel Consultant will also be responsible for maintaining accurate customer and follow\-up information in the CRM, coordinating internally for booking execution, and ensuring timely and professional communication with customers.

5\. Customer Follow\-Up \& Sales Conversion

title: Relationship Manager - Leading NBFC - Gurugram
description:
**Job Description – Senior Relationship Manager – MSME Lending / Investments**
==============================================================================


**Location:** Delhi / Gurugram


**Type:** Full\-time


**Experience:** 3–8 years


**Industry Preference:** NBFC / MSME Lending / SME Lending / Financial Services


**Role Overview**
-----------------


We are looking for a Senior Relationship Manager with strong experience in NBFC/MSME lending or investment sales, along with the ability to understand and analyze financial statements.


The candidate will be responsible for sourcing and developing relationships with MSME/SME businesses, identifying lending and investment opportunities, understanding business requirements, conducting preliminary financial analysis, and managing the relationship through the transaction lifecycle.


### **Key Responsibilities**


#### **1\. Business Development \& Sales**


* Source new MSME/SME lending and investment opportunities through direct sourcing, referrals, CA networks, DSAs, financial advisors, and industry contacts.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with SME/MSME promoters, business owners, and CXOs.
* Identify businesses that meet the lending/investment requirements of the assigned business or entity.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients and opportunities.
* Achieve assigned business development, sourcing, and revenue targets.

#### **2\. Relationship Management**


* Manage relationships with existing and prospective MSME/SME clients.
* Understand the client's business model, financial requirements, funding needs, and growth plans.
* Act as the primary point of contact and ensure smooth coordination throughout the transaction process.
* Develop long\-term relationships with promoters, referral partners, and other stakeholders.

#### **3\. Financial Analysis \& Initial Assessment**


* Analyze P\&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements of prospective businesses.
* Understand profitability, leverage, liquidity, working capital, and cash\-flow position.
* Conduct preliminary assessment of the company's financial strength and repayment/investment capacity.
* Review financial information and identify key business and financial risks.
* Coordinate with the Credit/Risk/Investment teams for detailed evaluation and underwriting.

#### **4\. Deal Execution \& Coordination**


* Coordinate with internal teams including Credit, Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations, and Compliance.
* Support the transaction process from sourcing and initial evaluation through sanction/investment and disbursement, wherever applicable.
* Ensure timely collection of financial and business documents from clients.
* Support structuring of suitable lending/investment solutions based on business requirements.

#### **5\. Portfolio \& Relationship Monitoring**


* Maintain regular engagement with clients and monitor business performance.
* Track repayment/business performance and identify potential concerns or early warning signals.
* Support repeat business and cross\-selling opportunities.
* Maintain accurate records and MIS of business sourced and relationships managed.

### **Ideal Candidate**


* 3–8 years of relevant experience in NBFC, MSME/SME lending, business banking, or financial services.
* Strong experience in MSME lending or investment sales.
* Existing network among MSME/SME promoters, CAs, DSAs, financial advisors, and business networks will be an advantage.
* Ability to understand and analyze financial statements and business performance.
* Good understanding of credit, lending, and financial products.
* Strong relationship management, communication, negotiation, and sales skills.
* Ability to balance business development with financial/business assessment.
* MBA Finance / CA / CFA or equivalent qualification will be an advantage.
### **Not Suitable**


* Pure retail loan sales profiles.
* Candidates with only retail lending experience.
* Pure sales profiles without understanding of financial statements.
* Freshers or candidates without relevant NBFC/SME/MSME experience.
### **What We Offer**


* Opportunity to work with a growing financial services group.
* Exposure to MSME lending, investments, and multiple businesses within the Company.
* Direct interaction with business owners and senior management.
* Growth\-oriented role with business development and financial analysis exposure.
* Competitive compensation and performance\-based incentives.
### **Important Note**


The selected candidate may be aligned with any specific business, vertical, subsidiary, associate, or entity within the Company based on organizational requirements.


The candidate may also be employed on the payroll of Company. or any other entity within the Company, as determined by management and business requirements.

title: Nykaa - Product Manager II
description:
**Role : Product Manager II \| Nykaa Fashion**
**Location :** 
 Gurgaon \|
 **Experience :** 
 2 \- 4 years \|
 **Team :** 
 Product \- Nykaa Fashion
   

  

 Fashion meets Product. And we're looking for someone who gets both.
   

  

 Nykaa Fashion is building the next generation of fashion shopping experiences \- experiences that are more visual, inspiring, social and AI\-native.
   

  

 We're looking for a Product Manager II to work on some of our newest bets : ideas that may start with a customer insight, prototype or experiment and have the potential to become entirely new experiences for millions of shoppers.
   

  

 This isn't a role where you'll inherit a mature roadmap and optimize it by 2%.
   

  

 You'll find problems worth solving, build from zero, experiment quickly and scale what works.
   

  

 And there's one thing we care about beyond the usual PM toolkit : You should genuinely love fashion.
   

  

 You notice what people are wearing. You know when a trend is taking off. You have opinions on how people discover brands, put together looks and decide what to buy.
   

  

 You don't just work on fashion. You talk about it. You follow it. You wear it.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 You'll work on 0 \- 1 bets for Nykaa Fashion across areas such as :
   

  

* New Discovery Experiences : Rethink how shoppers discover fashion beyond traditional homepages, PLPs and search \- from visual and inspiration\-led discovery to new content\-led shopping formats.
* AI x Fashion : Explore how Generative AI can change fashion shopping \- styling, personalization, conversational shopping, visual discovery and completely new interfaces.
* Content x Commerce : Build experiences where reels, creators, UGC, trends and editorial content become native parts of the shopping journey.


**What You'll Do**
* Build 0 \- 1 : Take ambiguous ideas from customer problems \- hypothesis \- prototype \- MVP \- experiment \- scale.
* Think customer\-first : Spend time understanding how people actually discover, evaluate and buy fashion \- not just what funnel dashboards tell us.
* Experiment aggressively : Run rapid experiments, learn what works and be equally comfortable scaling a winner or killing an idea.
* Use AI as a product primitive : Prototype with LLMs, multimodal models and emerging AI capabilities rather than treating AI as an add\-on.
* Own outcomes : Define clear customer and business metrics and take accountability for impact, not feature launches.
* Work deeply with Design \& Engineering : Build alongside designers and engineers from day one rather than throwing requirements over the fence.
* Stay culturally curious : Track fashion, creators, Gen Z behaviour, global commerce products and emerging consumer experiences \- and translate those signals into product ideas.


**Who We're Looking For**
 2 \- 4 years of Product Management experience, preferably in consumer internet or e\-commerce.
   

  

**You Will Probably Thrive Here If**
* You've shipped meaningful consumer products and can demonstrate measurable impact.
* You're comfortable operating with ambiguity and limited precedent.
* You have strong product intuition but are equally comfortable getting into data.
* You understand experimentation, funnels and consumer behaviour.
* You can work effectively with Design, Engineering, Analytics and Business teams.
* You're naturally curious about AI and how it changes consumer products.
* You move fast, prototype before over\-specifying, and learn from real users.
* Prior e\-commerce, discovery, personalization, content, social commerce or AI product experience is a strong plus.


 And the biggest plus? You are a fashion enthusiast. Not because your resume says Fashion / E\-commerce. Because you genuinely have a point of view on fashion. You follow brands, creators and trends. You understand why someone saves a look on Instagram, searches for it on Google, asks a friend about it and eventually buys something completely different.
   

  

 We want someone who can bring that instinct into the products they build.
   

  

**Why Nykaa Fashion? :**
 Because fashion e\-commerce still has a lot left to reinvent.
   

  

 Most shopping experiences today are built around catalogues, filters and funnels. The next generation will increasingly be built around inspiration, identity, creators, personalization and AI.
   

  

 At Nykaa Fashion, you'll get the scale of a major consumer platform with the opportunity to operate like a small 0 \- 1 product team. Millions of shoppers. Thousands of brands. And plenty of unsolved problems.
   

  

 Come build what fashion shopping looks like next!

title: Scrum Master
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Agile Delivery \& Ceremonies.
* Facilitate and time‑box all Scrum ceremonies: Sprint Planning, Daily Stand‑ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Ensure ceremonies are value‑driven, outcome‑focused, and aligned to MCP ways of working.
* Support teams in defining Sprint Goals, managing commitments, and avoiding spill‑overs.
* Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria, are estimated with team consent, and follow Agile best practices.
* Coach teams on Agile and Scrum principles, fostering ownership, accountability, and self‑organisation.
* Create a psychologically safe environment that enables honest reflection and continuous improvement.
* Identify and remove impediments and blockers to maintain delivery momentum.
* Promote strong Agile hygiene including Jira updates, correct status/labels, and transparent reporting.
* Act as a bridge between delivery teams and Product Owners, Tech Leads, Architects, Release/Integration teams, and other Scrum Masters.
* Proactively manage cross‑team dependencies, risks, and delivery constraints.
* Represent the team in MCP forums (e.g. design reviews, sprint demos, governance touchpoints).
* Escalate risks and issues with clear context and data‑backed insights.
* Track and report delivery health using Agile metrics (e.g. sprint predictability, carry‑over, team capacity).
* Support compliance with Barclays governance, risk, and control expectations.
* Ensure transparency on delivery progress, risks, and outcomes.

title: Product Designer
description:
***Important Note :***
*We'd love to see your work as a link to your own portfolio site. Behance boards and Figma link/Drive links/PDFs are hard for us to review, so those profiles may get missed.* 




  






 We're looking for a Product Designer to help shape the day\-to\-day experience of TIST Media's platform \- translating product thinking into clean, considered interfaces our users actually enjoy using. This is a craft \- heavy role for a designer who is past the "figuring out the basics" stage and ready to take real ownership of features, partner closely with engineers, and grow into a senior seat over time. You will work across influencer marketing flows and AI \- driven surfaces, supported by senior designers and product leadership, with plenty of room to push your own ideas.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities :** 




  





**Execute Product Design with Craft** 




  




* Design flows, wireframes, prototypes, and final specs for features across web and mobile\-web \- with the polish and clarity engineers need to ship.
* Take features from brief to handoff with growing independence, raising the right questions early and closing loops fast.



  





**Contribute to Product Direction** 




  




* Partner with product stakeholders to pressure\-test ideas, sharpen scope, and propose alternatives \- not just pick up tickets.
* Bring user empathy into every conversation: surface friction you notice, flag UX gaps, and back your point of view with reasoning.



  





**Use \& Extend the Design System** 




  




* Build with TIST's component library as your default, and contribute new patterns when gaps appear.
* Sweat token hygiene, naming, states, and edge cases \- the unglamorous work that keeps a system honest.



  





**Design Thoughtfully for AI\-Native Features** 




  




* Collaborate with senior designers and the AI / data team to shape interfaces around intelligent features \- recommendations, generated content, and data \- driven views.
* Care deeply about how trust, transparency, and explainability show up in the UI when AI is doing work on the user's behalf.



  





**Collaborate Across the Company** 




  




* Show up to design critiques with strong opinions held loosely, and walk through your work clearly \- rationale, trade \- offs, and what you chose not to do.
* Work closely with engineering through build and QA so what ships matches what was designed.



  





**What Makes You a Strong Fit** 




  




* 2 – 4 years of product design experience, ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, or consumer platform.
* A portfolio that shows clean execution, attention to detail, and a real understanding of
 
*why* 

 \- not just
 
*what* 

 \- was designed.
* Comfortable iterating on established flows, and eager ( with support ) to take on more ambiguous 0 \- to \- 1 problems.
* Solid grasp of interaction patterns, accessibility basics, and mobile\-first thinking.
* Curious about AI \- native and data\-heavy products \- bonus if you've shipped any.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or a related field \- or a portfolio that speaks louder.
* 2 \- 4 years of product design experience.
* Strong proficiency in Figma \- components, auto \- layout, prototyping and in micro \- animation tools.



  





**Growth Perks** 




  




* Learning and Certification budget.
* Exploratory travel budget.
* Flexible working hours.



  





**Budget** 




  




* Starting from 12 LPA, varies per experience and other factors.

description:
**Company Description** 
 Dunbar \& Boardman (D\&B), founded in the UK in 1981, is an independent specialist consultancy focused on Vertical Transportation and Façade Access advisory services across the UK, Middle East, India, and international markets. With over four decades of experience, D\&B supports clients throughout the entire building lifecycle, from feasibility and concept design through construction, commissioning, and ongoing asset management. The firm provides expert guidance on lifts, escalators, moving walkways, façade access systems, and related safety and maintenance strategies for a wide range of sectors, including high\-rise, commercial, residential, healthcare, and transport infrastructure. As a manufacturer\-neutral consultancy, D\&B bases its recommendations on performance, safety, operational efficiency, and lifecycle considerations rather than equipment supply, helping clients create safe, efficient, and future\-ready buildings.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time Graduate Engineering Trainee role is based in Chennai and follows a hybrid work model, combining office presence with some work\-from\-home flexibility. The trainee will support senior engineers in the planning and design of vertical transportation and façade access systems, assisting with technical calculations, data analysis, and preparation of reports and presentations. Day\-to\-day tasks include contributing to traffic analysis and simulations, reviewing drawings and specifications, supporting project documentation, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure project requirements are met. The role also involves learning and applying relevant standards and guidelines, participating in project meetings, and assisting in monitoring project progress and quality. The position offers structured training, mentoring, and exposure to multidisciplinary building projects across various sectors.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication and the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to interpret technical data, perform basic calculations, and support engineering assessments.
* Candidates should possess foundational Mechanical Engineering or Manufacturing Engineering knowledge, preferably with exposure to building services or related disciplines.
* Candidates should possess basic Project Management abilities, such as organizing tasks, tracking timelines, and supporting project documentation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a closely related engineering field.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); familiarity with CAD tools or engineering software is an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail, eagerness to learn, and ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment based in Chennai.
* Interest in vertical transportation, façade access, building design, or construction consultancy is highly beneficial.

title: Sr Officer R&D Electronics
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Sr. Officer – R\&D – Electronics.
 



**Location:** 
 Vapi, Gujarat
 



**Reports To:** 
 R\&D Lead
 



**Experience:** 
 2–3 Years
 



  





**Job Purpose** 




 To support the design, development, integration, testing, and validation of electronic medical devices for the portfolio.
 



 The role will focus on electronics hardware, embedded firmware, sensors, physiological signal acquisition, communication interfaces, hardware\-software integration, prototyping, troubleshooting, and product verification.
 



 The position requires a hands\-on R\&D engineer capable of converting product requirements into reliable electronic solutions while working within applicable medical\-device quality, safety, regulatory, and documentation requirements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Medical Electronics Product Development** 



* Participate in the complete R\&D lifecycle covering concept, feasibility, prototyping, development, integration, verification, validation, and product release.
* Support development of electronic systems for:
* Rigid \& Portable Colposcope
* Electronic Fetal Monitor
* Fetal Doppler Monitor
* Telemetry\-Based Fetal Monitoring System
* Smart Fetal Monitor
* Other medical\-device platforms
* Translate product and system requirements into suitable electronic and embedded solutions.
* Support component selection, prototyping, system integration, testing, debugging, and design improvements.
* Work closely with senior R\&D engineers and cross\-functional teams to deliver reliable, clinically relevant products.



**2\. Electronics Hardware Development** 



* Design, modify, test, and troubleshoot analog and digital electronic circuits.
* Work with:
* Microcontrollers/processors
* Sensors and transducers
* ADC/DAC
* Amplifiers and filters
* Signal\-conditioning circuits
* Power and battery\-management systems
* Displays and LEDs
* Communication modules
* Support schematic development, PCB design/review, BOM preparation, component selection, prototype assembly, and board bring\-up.
* Evaluate components based on performance, reliability, availability, cost, and product requirements.
* Troubleshoot hardware failures through structured Root Cause Analysis (RCA).



**3\. Embedded Firmware \& Hardware\-Software Integration** 



* Develop, modify, test, and integrate embedded firmware using C/C\+\+ and relevant microcontroller platforms.
* Develop and debug drivers and interfaces for sensors, displays, communication modules, memory, ADC/DAC and other peripherals.
* Support device control logic, data acquisition, alarms, monitoring, communication, and device\-status management.
* Perform hardware\-firmware integration and troubleshoot interface\-level issues.
* Use appropriate IDEs, programmers, debuggers, logic analyzers, and other development tools.
* Maintain source code using appropriate version\-control practices.



**4\. Physiological Signal Acquisition \& Fetal Monitoring** 



* Support development of electronic systems for fetal and maternal physiological monitoring.
* Work with signals/technologies such as:
* Fetal Heart Rate (FHR)
* Doppler\-based fetal monitoring
* Maternal heart rate
* TOCO / uterine activity
* ECG and other physiological signals
* Support signal acquisition, amplification, filtering, sampling, ADC conversion, noise reduction, and signal conditioning.
* Investigate signal\-quality issues including noise, interference, artifacts, instability, and signal integrity.
* Support integration of sensors and physiological signals with embedded processing and user interfaces.



**5\. Fetal Doppler, Wireless \& Telemetry Systems** 



* Support electronics development for Fetal Doppler and telemetry\-based monitoring systems.
* Work with Doppler transducers, signal\-acquisition electronics, amplification, filtering, and embedded processing.
* Support integration of Bluetooth/BLE, Wi\-Fi, RF/wireless telemetry, and other communication technologies.
* Troubleshoot connectivity, communication stability, latency, range, packet loss, synchronization, and interference issues.
* Participate in wireless module integration and system\-level testing.



**6\. Colposcope \& Imaging Electronics** 



* Support electronic development and integration for Rigid and Portable Colposcope systems.
* Work with:
* Camera/image sensors
* LED illumination
* Displays
* Image\-acquisition systems
* Electronic/optical interfaces
* Power and control electronics
* Support camera and sensor integration with embedded systems.
* Troubleshoot image quality, illumination, electronic noise, connectivity, and performance issues.
* Collaborate with optical, mechanical, software, and clinical teams.



**7\. Prototyping, Debugging \& Laboratory Testing** 



* Build and test electronic prototypes and proof\-of\-concept systems.
* Perform PCB bring\-up, power\-up, interface verification, subsystem testing, and system integration.
* Use laboratory equipment such as:
* Digital Multimeter
* Oscilloscope
* Logic Analyzer
* Function Generator
* DC Power Supply
* Electronic Load
* Spectrum/RF equipment, where applicable
* Perform component\-level and system\-level troubleshooting.
* Conduct structured RCA and corrective design improvements.
* Document technical observations, failures, corrective actions, and test results.



**8\. Verification, Validation \& Product Testing** 



* Develop and execute engineering test plans, test cases, protocols, and reports.
* Support:
* Design Verification
* Design Validation
* Functional Testing
* Performance Testing
* Electrical Safety Testing
* Environmental/Reliability Testing
* Regression Testing
* Identify, document, and resolve defects.
* Verify hardware and firmware changes before product release.
* Support pre\-compliance and product qualification activities.



**9\. Medical Device Quality \& Regulatory Compliance** 



* Follow established medical\-device development and quality processes.
* Support engineering documentation and compliance activities in coordination with Quality and Regulatory teams.
* Maintain awareness/exposure to:
* IEC 60601 – Medical Electrical Equipment
* IEC 62304 – Medical Device Software
* ISO 13485 – Quality Management Systems
* ISO 14971 – Risk Management
* Applicable EMC and electrical\-safety requirements
* Applicable CE, FDA and Indian regulatory requirements
* Support risk analysis, FMEA, hazard identification, risk controls, and design\-change documentation.



**10\. Engineering Documentation \& Design Transfer** 



* Prepare and maintain:
* Schematics
* PCB documentation
* BOMs
* Component specifications
* Interface specifications
* Test specifications
* Technical reports
* Maintain revision\-controlled hardware and firmware documentation.
* Support component lifecycle management and alternate component identification.
* Support design transfer, pilot production, manufacturing troubleshooting, calibration, test fixtures, and End\-of\-Line testing.
* Support DFM/DFT initiatives for production\-ready designs.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




**Education** 




 Bachelor's degree in:
 


* Electronics \& Communication Engineering
* Electronics Engineering
* Electrical \& Electronics Engineering
* Instrumentation Engineering
* Biomedical Engineering
* Or a related engineering discipline



**Experience** 



* 2–3 years of relevant experience in:
* Electronics R\&D
* Embedded Systems
* Medical Electronics
* Medical Devices
* Healthcare Technology
* Product Development
* Hands\-on experience in electronics hardware and hardware\-software integration.
* Experience with microcontrollers, embedded systems, PCB/schematic development, debugging, and electronic testing.
* Experience with C/C\+\+ or equivalent embedded programming languages.
* Medical\-device industry experience will be strongly preferred.



  





**Technical Skills** 




**Electronics \& Embedded** 



* Strong understanding of analog and digital electronics
* Microcontrollers and embedded systems
* Sensors and transducers
* ADC/DAC
* Amplifiers and filters
* Signal conditioning
* Power and battery management
* PCB and schematic design
* Hardware debugging and bring\-up



**Communication Interfaces** 




 Working knowledge of:
 



 UART \| SPI \| I²C \| USB \| CAN \| Bluetooth/BLE \| Wi\-Fi \| RF/Wireless
 



**Firmware** 



* C/C\+\+
* Microcontroller programming
* Peripheral interfacing
* Device drivers
* Debugging and firmware integration
* Version control



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Hands\-on approach to electronics development and troubleshooting
* Good understanding of hardware\-firmware integration
* Strong RCA and debugging capability
* Ability to read schematics and component datasheets
* Understanding of physiological signals and medical sensors
* Good technical documentation skills
* Attention to detail and product quality
* Ability to work effectively in a cross\-functional R\&D environment
* Ability to work in a regulated medical\-device development environment
* Curiosity to learn new technologies and solve complex engineering problems
* Passion for
 **medical technology, electronics, embedded systems, and healthcare innovation**



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 




  





**R\&D Delivery** 




 Timely completion of assigned R\&D activities and engineering milestones
 



**Hardware Development** 




 Quality, reliability and performance of electronic prototypes/designs
 



**Integration** 




 Successful hardware\-firmware\-sensor\-system integration
 



**Signal Quality** 




 Accuracy and reliability of physiological signal acquisition
 



**Debugging** 




 Timely resolution of technical issues through structured RCA
 



**Testing** 




 Successful completion of verification, validation and engineering testing
 



**Quality \& Compliance** 




 Adherence to medical\-device development and documentation processes
 



**Documentation** 




 Accuracy and completeness of schematics, BOMs, test reports and technical records
 



**Manufacturing Transfer** 




 Successful transition of validated designs to production
 



**Design Improvement** 




 Reduction in failures and improvement in reliability, performance and cost
 



**Innovation** 




 Contribution of new technologies, ideas and design improvements

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
Snabbit is India’s first Quick\-Service App delivering home services in just 10 minutes through a hyperlocal network of trained and verified professionals. Backed by Elevation Capital, Nexus Venture Partners, and Lightspeed, Snabbit is redefining the home services space by combining speed, quality, and trust.
 



  





 Founded by Aayush Agarwal, Snabbit is on a mission to make home services as seamless and instant as ordering groceries. We’ve already completed thousands of jobs with exceptional customer satisfaction \- and we’re just getting started.
 



  





 We’re looking for a
 **Talent Acquisition Intern** 
 who’s curious about people, organised in execution, and excited to help build Snabbit’s team from the ground up. This is a hands\-on role where you’ll learn how early\-stage hiring really works \- end to end.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* **Support hiring across roles \-** 
 Help with sourcing profiles, screening resumes, and coordinating interviews.
* **Keep the hiring engine moving \-** 
 Track candidates, follow up with stakeholders, and make sure nothing slips through the cracks.
* **Candidate communication \-** 
 Reach out to candidates, schedule interviews, and ensure a smooth, friendly experience.
* **Work closely with the TA team \-** 
 Assist with job postings, hiring reports, and day\-to\-day recruitment ops.
* **Learn how teams are built \-** 
 Get exposure to how hiring decisions are made in a fast\-growing startup.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* **Interest in recruitment \& people** 
**\-** 
 You’re curious about hiring, startups, and how teams come together.
* **Organised \& reliable \-** 
 You’re good at tracking details and following through.
* **Clear communicator** 
**\-** 
 Comfortable writing emails and speaking with candidates professionally.
* **Bias for action \-** 
 You’re proactive, eager to learn, and not afraid to ask questions.
* **Comfortable in a fast\-paced setup** 
**\-** 
 Things move quickly, and you’re excited by that.



  





**Why Snabbit?** 



* **Learn by doing** 
**\-** 
 Real exposure to startup hiring, not just shadowing.
* **Build, don’t inherit** 
**\-** 
 Help shape early hiring processes and candidate experience.
* **High ownership** 
**\-** 
 Trusted with real responsibility from day one.
* **People\-first culture** 
**\-** 
 Collaborative, honest, and focused on doing meaningful work.

At EY, People Consulting professionals help clients' in strategically aligning their people agenda with broader business goals. By placing Humans@Center of the transformation journey, we help organizations drive sustainable change through the power of their workforce. Our approach enables clients to reimagine their future workforce—ensuring they have the right talent, with the right skills, in the right roles, at the right cost—ultimately turning their people strategy into a competitive advantage.



The key fields of play are:



Organization and Workforce Transformation\- Integrated approach to align business and workforce strategies with current and future operating models by applying capabilities such as scenario modelling, org design, workforce planning \& analytics as well as talent strategy, leveraging our proprietary, award\-winning EY Organization \& Talent Hub.



Change Experience \& Learning \- Working with clients to define the new Workforce Experience including New Ways of Working (Agile, Design Thinking, Digital, Problem Solving, Collaboration) as well as accelerated adoption through our digitally\-enabled Change Experience tracked via Change Insights and Digital Learning via our EY Noggin Labs platform.



Purpose, Culture and Leadership \- Align leadership and cultural programs with clients’ business strategy, purpose and operating model, adapting to the changing needs of their customers and building modern leadership and talent capabilities to drive efficiency and innovation.



HR Transformation, Systems and Rewards \- Re\-imagining and digitizing the HR function, including HR strategy, HR service delivery model, HR cloud technology as well as transforming employee policies and rewards to align with business and individual objectives.

  

**Your key responsibilities**  

  

**Technical Excellence**

  


* Scope : The HR Generalist \- Employee Lifecycle will support the Bangalore GCC HR Shared Services operation for employee lifecycle management. The role will provide operational execution, case support, data stewardship, stakeholder follow\-up and transition\-readiness support. The role is expected to work within defined HR policies, country process nuances, data privacy requirements and BOT governance standards, while helping build a stable and transferable HRSS capability for a global pharma organization. Responsibilities: Own end\-to\-end employee lifecycle transactions including hires, transfers, job changes, manager changes, exits and employment\-data updates. \- Validate approvals, effective dates, employee data fields and downstream payroll or reporting impact before execution. \- Maintain accurate lifecycle cases, audit trails, evidence and closure notes in the HR helpdesk system. \- Coordinate with HRBPs, payroll, reporting and sending\-side process owners to resolve missing or conflicting inputs. \- Support shadowing and reverse\-shadowing during knowledge transfer and provide process playback to confirm operational readiness. \- Identify recurring defects, delayed approvals and avoidable employee queries, and recommend process or knowledge\-base improvements. Competencies: \- Strong HR operations mindset with ability to balance employee experience, policy adherence and service controls \- High attention to detail, data accuracy and documentation discipline for audit\-ready execution. \- Clear written communication, professional stakeholder follow\-through and ability to manage global hand\-offs. \- Comfortable operating in a GCC or shared services model with SLAs, queues, escalations and governance reviews \- Ability to learn process nuances during knowledge transfer, ask structured questions and convert knowledge into \- Sound judgement in handling confidential employee information and escalating sensitive matters appropriately. Tools and Tech Workday HCM / SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central; ServiceNow HRSD; policy knowledge base; reporting dashboards MUST have 3\-5 years of experience is mandatory, with hands\-on experience in employee lifecycle management within HR operations, GCC, GBS or shared services; working knowledge of HR ticketing, case documentation, SLA management and employee\-data confidentiality; ability to use HR systems and process documentation to execute employee lifecycle transactions or resolve employee queries; Workday HCM or SAP SuccessFactors exposure for employee\-data lookup, transactions, reporting or process validation; ServiceNow HRSD or comparable helpdesk / case management workflow experience; strong business English and ability to support global stakeholders. NICE to have Pharma, life sciences, GCC or regulated\-industry HR operations experience; exposure to BOT, transition or knowledge\-transfer environments; experience with process documentation, knowledge\-base governance, dashboards, root\-cause analysis or continuous improvement; awareness of data privacy, GDPR, HR compliance and audit\-support requirements.

  

**Skills and attributes**  

  

**To qualify for the role you must have**  

**Qualification**


* Master of Business Administration
* PG Diploma in Human Resource Management
* Bachelor of Commerce
* Bachelor of Business Administration


**Experience**


* HR Shared services (3 to 5 years)

  

  

**What we look for**  

  

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.  

  

**What we offer**  

  

Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side\-by\-side with market\-leading entrepreneurs, game\-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.  

  

EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.  

  

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.  

  

Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

**EY\- Cyber Risk Compliance and Resilience – Senior Manager**



As part of our EY\-Cyber Security Risk and Compliance Consulting team, you’ll contribute technically to Cyber Security client engagements and internal projects. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships.

  


**The opportunity**



We’re looking for Senior Manager who should have Deep technical understanding of risk and compliance solutioning for enterprise including products and capabilities, service competitor landscape, pricing methodologies, brand positioning and management, etc. In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.

  


**Your key responsibilities**



Reporting to the competency leader for Cyber Risk, Compliance, Resilience and Emerging Technology and will be responsible for:


* Defining, developing, and implementing strategic go\-to\-market plans in collaboration with local EY member firms in region.
* Own end\-to\-end sales opportunity qualification and pursuit, including drafting RFP responses, proposal defence during Orals, drafting State of Work (SoW) leveraging expertise in scoping, solutioning and costing for Enterprise and Cloud security solutions.
* Support and drive the overall growth strategy for the Cybersecurity practice as part of the leadership team.
* Identify and drive development of market differentiators including new products, solutions, automation etc.
* Support refinement of service approach and service delivery methodology for Enterprise and Cloud security solutions.
* Identify and pursue strategic opportunities for partnerships and acquisitions.
* Develop and rollout branding and marketing strategy including items such as solution brochures, sales videos, thought leadership, community engagement etc.
* Inspire and motivate direct and in\-direct reporting professionals while fostering an environment of collaboration and participation.
* Manage engagements across the client and ensure teams delivers value to the customers and ensure horizontal growth in the accounts.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Deep knowledge of services and service delivery approach and methodology for Cyber Risk, Compliance and resilience including governance and operating models.
* Proven track record and success in collaborative sales bringing together internal and external stakeholders across Cyber competencies, Digital \& Technology practices (Engineering, Analytics, Automation etc.) and business functions (Branding \& Marketing, Legal, HR etc.).
* Proven track record in building and maintaining trusted relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
* Deep technical understanding of architecture and solutioning of risk and compliance including products and capabilities, service competitor landscape, pricing methodologies, brand positioning and management, etc.
* Willingness to travel and flex work timings as and when required.
* Ability to change and adapt in a hyper\-growth environment.
* Self\-starter and strategic thinker.
* Cyber Strategy \& Governance, Cyber Transformation and co\-sourcing, Cyber Cost Optimization, Cyber Operating Model
	+ Compliance Management \- Regulations/standards such as ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HITRUST, CCPA, FISMA/FEDRAMP, COBIT, OWASP Top 10, NIST 800\-53, NIST\- CSF, HIPPA, GDPR
	+ Cyber Risk management
	+ Cyber Resilience, Business Continuity \& Disaster Recovery
	+ Application security and Threat Modelling
	+ Vendor Risk Management/Supplier Security
  


**To qualify for the role, you must have**


* At least 15 years of overall experience
* At least 10 years architecture and solutioning for enterprise and cloud security
* Bachelor or college degree in related field or equivalent work experience
* MBA (Good to have)

  


**Ideally, you’ll also have**

  


* Project management skills
* CISSP/CISA/CISM
* ITIL of Equivalent

  


**What we look for**

  


* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 2000 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**About the company :\-** 





 Zivaya is a chain of luxury wellness outlets at major chains of hotels, palaces, airports and lounges across India. We offer premium therapies, beauty, spa \& hair treatments. 
 









**Position Overview** 





 The Human Resources Manager shall be responsible for leading the entire Human Resources and Administration function of the organization and serving as a strategic partner to the Directors in building a high\-performing, compliant, and people\-centric workplace. The role requires ownership of talent acquisition, employee lifecycle management, payroll administration, statutory compliance, labour law adherence, HR operations, employee engagement, and organizational culture.
 





 The incumbent will be expected to establish robust HR systems and processes, ensure timely recruitment of quality talent, maintain employee discipline and workplace standards, safeguard confidential employee information, and drive initiatives that contribute to employee retention, productivity, and overall business growth.
 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 



* Partner with the Directors and departmental heads to understand current and future manpower requirements across all business locations.
* Develop and execute recruitment strategies to ensure timely fulfillment of approved manpower requirements.
* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment activities, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, salary negotiations, offer management, and onboarding.
* Source candidates through multiple channels including:
* Job Portals
* LinkedIn and professional networks
* Campus recruitment drives
* Job fairs and career expos
* Hospitality institutes and universities
* Skill development centres and vocational training institutes
* Employee referral programs
* Recruitment agencies and consultants




 ﻿
 



* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with hospitality institutes, colleges, universities, and training partners to create a sustainable talent pipeline.
* Ensure recruitment metrics, turnaround times, and hiring quality standards are consistently achieved.
* Develop employer branding initiatives to position the organization as an employer of choice.




  
 




**2\. Employee Lifecycle Management** 




**Onboarding \& Induction** 



* Manage all joining formalities including documentation, verification, offer letters and employee record creation.
* Conduct comprehensive induction programs to familiarize employees with company policies, culture, values, and operational standards.



**Employee Engagement \& Retention** 



* Design and implement initiatives aimed at enhancing employee engagement, motivation, and retention.
* Monitor attrition trends and recommend corrective actions to improve employee retention.
* Foster a positive work environment built on trust, accountability, professionalism, and mutual respect.



**Separation Management** 



* Manage resignation, termination, retirement, and exit processes in accordance with company policies and legal requirements.




  
 




**3\. HR Operations \& Administration** 



* Oversee daily HR operations and administrative activities across all business locations.
* Monitor attendance, leave management, shift records, overtime, absenteeism, and employee movement.
* Ensure proper maintenance of employee records, personnel files, contracts, and HR databases.
* Coordinate the issuance and management of official email IDs, employee access credentials, and company assets.
* Ensure adequate availability and maintenance of:
* Office stationery
* Workstations and systems
* Communication tools
* Employee facilities and operational resources
* Develop and implement administrative procedures that improve operational efficiency and accountability.
* Maintain accurate HR reports, documentation, and management information systems.








**4\. Workplace Culture, Discipline \& Employee Relations** 



* Promote and uphold the organization's values, professional standards, and workplace culture.
* Ensure discipline, decorum, ethical conduct, and adherence to company policies at all levels.
* Act as the primary point of contact for employee grievances and workplace concerns.
* Investigate employee complaints and recommend fair and practical resolutions.
* Support managers in handling disciplinary matters and employee performance issues.
* Facilitate effective communication between management and employees.
* Drive initiatives that strengthen teamwork, collaboration, accountability, and employee morale.








**5\. Payroll, Compensation \& Benefits** 



* Manage the end\-to\-end payroll process with complete accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality.
* Ensure timely processing of salaries, incentives, reimbursements, statutory deductions, and employee benefits.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of employee compensation and personal information.
* Resolve employee queries related to salary, benefits, and payroll discrepancies.








**6\. Labour Law Compliance \& Statutory Requirements** 



* Ensure full compliance with all applicable labour laws, employment regulations, and statutory obligations.
* Monitor legal developments and proactively update HR policies and practices to maintain compliance.
* Maintain statutory registers, records, returns, and documentation.
* Coordinate labour inspections, audits, legal notices, and interactions with government authorities.
* Liaise with legal advisors, consultants, and compliance agencies whenever required.








**7\. Strategic Partnership with Directors** 



* Work closely with the Directors on workforce planning, business expansion, organizational development, and manpower budgeting.
* Provide regular reports and insights on recruitment, attrition, payroll costs, employee productivity, and compliance status.
* Support leadership in developing people strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Recommend and implement HR policies, systems, and best practices that contribute to organizational growth.
* Participate in strategic decision\-making relating to people, culture, and organizational effectiveness.








**Desired Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources preferred.
* Minimum 5–8 years of progressive experience in Human Resources and Administration.
* Prior experience in hospitality, wellness, aviation, retail, healthcare, or service industries will be preferred.

 HR Specialist
   

  

 Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
   

  

 Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
   

  

 Why Syneos Health
   

  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.

* Participate in projects, process improvement initiatives, and system enhancements, providing operational insights and recommendations.
* Effectively manage workload, prioritize activities based on business needs and service level commitments, and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.


 Requirements:
   

  

* Minimum 3 \- 5 years of experience
* Experience in exposure of HR operations \& knowledge of HR operations processes.
* Analytical \& customer service oriented
* Workday knowledge \- mandatory
* Ticketing tool experience \- mandatory
* Proficient in Microsoft Office

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Ivtex Corporate Solutions Private Limited delivers high\-quality, technology\-driven solutions tailored to clients’ evolving business needs. The organization specializes in AI, Data Analytics, Consulting, Emerging Technologies, and Cybersecurity, helping partners remain competitive in an increasingly digital landscape. Ivtex collaborates with organizations across various industries to provide robust, scalable, and future\-ready solutions. The company focuses on enhancing operational efficiency, strengthening digital capabilities, and driving sustainable success for its clients.
 



  





 JOB DESCRIPTION – HR EXECUTIVE
 



**Position:** 
 HR Executive
 



**Department:** 
 Human Resources
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Location:** 
 Bhubaneswar, Odisha
 



**Reporting To:** 
 HR Manager / Administration Head / Management
 



  





 Job Summary
 



 We are looking for a proactive and organized
 **HR Executive** 
 to manage day\-to\-day HR operations across the employee lifecycle. The role will be responsible for recruitment coordination, onboarding, attendance and leave management, employee documentation, payroll inputs, HRMS/MIS maintenance, employee engagement, performance coordination, and exit formalities.
 



 The ideal candidate should possess strong communication and documentation skills, maintain confidentiality, and be capable of coordinating effectively with employees, reporting managers, candidates, and management.
 



  





 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
 



  





 1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
 


* Coordinate end\-to\-end recruitment activities for assigned positions.
* Prepare and publish job descriptions across relevant recruitment platforms.
* Source and screen candidates based on defined job requirements.
* Conduct preliminary HR screening and coordinate technical/managerial interview rounds.
* Schedule interviews and maintain regular communication with candidates.
* Coordinate assignments, skill tests, and interview evaluations.
* Maintain candidate trackers and recruitment MIS.
* Conduct salary discussions as per approved compensation ranges.
* Coordinate offer approvals and issue LOI/Offer Letters to selected candidates.
* Follow up with selected candidates until joining.
* Maintain a pipeline of potential candidates for upcoming requirements.



  





 2\. Joining \& Onboarding
 


* Coordinate pre\-joining documentation and joining formalities.
* Verify employee documents and maintain personnel records.
* Prepare and issue Offer Letters, Appointment Letters, confirmation letters and other employment documents.
* Coordinate employee ID, official email, HRMS access, system/assets and other joining requirements with concerned teams.
* Conduct HR induction and explain company policies, working hours, attendance, leave procedures and reporting structure.
* Maintain employee master data and ensure timely HRMS updates.
* Coordinate Background Verification (BGV), wherever applicable.



  





 3\. Attendance \& Leave Management
 


* Monitor daily attendance, late arrivals, absences, WFH and employee movement.
* Maintain monthly attendance and leave trackers.
* Coordinate leave applications with respective Reporting Managers.
* Maintain records of approved/rejected/pending leaves.
* Follow up on unauthorized absence or attendance irregularities.
* Prepare finalized monthly attendance inputs for payroll processing.
* Maintain accurate leave balances as per company policy.



  





 4\. Payroll \& Compensation Support
 


* Prepare and verify monthly payroll inputs.
* Coordinate attendance, leave deductions, LOP, incentives, reimbursements and other payroll variables.
* Coordinate with Accounts/Finance for salary processing.
* Verify employee salary details before final payroll submission.
* Assist in preparation and distribution of salary slips.
* Maintain salary revision, increment and compensation records.
* Support PF, ESI, Professional Tax and other applicable payroll/compliance processes as required.



  





 5\. Employee Documentation \& HR Operations
 


* Maintain complete employee personnel files in physical/digital format.
* Draft HR letters, notices, circulars and employee communications.
* Prepare confirmation, promotion, designation change, salary revision, warning, show\-cause, transfer, relieving and experience letters as required.
* Maintain updated employee database and organizational records.
* Ensure HR documents are properly signed, acknowledged and archived.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee, compensation and management information.



  





 6\. Employee Relations \& Engagement
 


* Act as a point of contact for routine employee HR queries.
* Coordinate employee grievances with appropriate management representatives.
* Support employee engagement and workplace initiatives.
* Coordinate birthdays, festivals, celebrations and internal events.
* Facilitate effective communication between employees, reporting managers and management.
* Support initiatives aimed at improving employee experience and retention.



  





 7\. Performance \& Productivity Coordination
 


* Coordinate periodic performance review processes.
* Follow up with Reporting Managers for employee performance feedback.
* Maintain performance/productivity trackers where applicable.
* Document performance discussions, improvement requirements and management decisions.
* Assist with Performance Improvement Plans (PIP) and related documentation when required.



  





 8\. HR Policies \& Compliance
 


* Support implementation of HR policies, SOPs and employee handbook provisions.
* Communicate approved HR policies and amendments to employees.
* Ensure employees provide required policy acknowledgements.
* Maintain documentation required for HR audits and compliance.
* Assist management with implementation of applicable employment and statutory requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality and proper access control over HR records.



  





 9\. Separation \& Full\-and\-Final Coordination
 


* Receive and process employee resignations as per company procedure.
* Calculate/track notice periods and proposed last working dates.
* Coordinate handover requirements with Reporting Managers.
* Ensure company assets, documents, credentials and responsibilities are properly handed over.
* Conduct or coordinate exit interviews.
* Obtain departmental and asset clearances.
* Coordinate Full \& Final Settlement inputs with Accounts.
* Issue relieving and experience documents after completion of required clearances.



  





 HR MIS \& Reports
 



 The HR Executive will be expected to maintain accurate and updated:
 


* Employee Master Database
* Recruitment Tracker
* Interview \& Candidate Status Tracker
* Joining Tracker
* Attendance \& Leave Tracker
* Payroll Input Sheet
* Employee Documentation Tracker
* BGV Tracker
* Performance/Productivity Tracker
* Asset/Exit Clearance Tracker
* Resignation \& Notice Period Tracker
* Monthly HR MIS



  





 Required Skills
 


* Recruitment \& candidate screening
* HR operations and employee lifecycle management
* Attendance and leave management
* Payroll coordination
* HR documentation and drafting
* Employee engagement and grievance coordination
* HRMS/MIS management
* Strong MS Excel / Google Sheets knowledge
* MS Word and PowerPoint
* Professional email and business communication
* Strong follow\-up and coordination ability
* Documentation and record\-management skills
* Ability to handle confidential information responsibly
* Good interpersonal and problem\-solving skills



  





 Educational Qualification
 



**Preferred:** 
 MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent postgraduate qualification.
 



 Candidates with a relevant graduate degree and strong practical HR experience may also be considered.
 



  





 Experience
 



**Preferred:** 
 1–3 years of relevant experience in HR Operations, Recruitment, Employee Management or a similar HR role.
 



 Experience working in an
 **IT/Technology/Corporate environment** 
 will be an added advantage.
 



  





 Preferred Candidate Profile
 



 The candidate should be:
 


* Proactive and responsible
* Organized and detail\-oriented
* Comfortable handling multiple HR activities simultaneously
* Strong in follow\-up and coordination
* Professional in employee and candidate communication
* Capable of maintaining strict confidentiality
* Comfortable working with deadlines and management requirements
* Willing to take ownership of assigned HR processes



  





 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 Performance may be assessed based on:
 


* Recruitment turnaround time and closure rate
* Candidate joining ratio
* Accuracy of attendance and payroll inputs
* Timely completion of onboarding formalities
* HR documentation accuracy and completeness
* Employee database/HRMS accuracy
* Timely closure of employee queries and HR actions
* Compliance with HR processes and policies
* Exit and clearance turnaround time
* Quality and timeliness of HR MIS/reporting



  





 Interested candidates are requested to send their
 **updated CV/Resume** 
 to:
 



 neetu@ivtexsolutions.com
 



**Email Subject:** 
 Application for HR Executive – \[Candidate Name]
 



 Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the further selection process.
