The school has 150\+ IB\-trained teachers, enabling consistent outstanding results and inspire students go on to study at some of the world’s leading universities. The school serves Nursery through to high school (Grade 12\) students. Oakridge offers IB, CBSE, and Cambridge curricula, and is recognized as one of the best schools in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

 The Oakridge International School, Gachibowli is partnered with the Nord Anglia Education family, the world’s leading premium international school organisation. They currently have 81 schools in India, China, Europe, the Middle East, South East Asia and North, Central and South America. NAE are a fast growing, successful education company with over 50 years’ experience. The schools are amongst the most respected premium schools in their markets and are a very popular choice for parents.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The HR Business Partner (HRBP) is a strategic role responsible for aligning HR practices with the school’s goals and educational mission. Acting as a trusted advisor to school leadership and faculty, the HRBP supports workforce planning, employee relations, talent management, performance development, and change management. The role ensures that HR initiatives promote a positive, inclusive, and high\-performing school culture.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic HR Partnership:** 
 Collaborate with school leadership to understand staffing needs and workforce planning.Align HR strategies with academic and operational goals.Provide data\-driven insights to support decision\-making and organizational effectiveness.
   

  

**Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding:** 
 Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and lead recruitment for teaching, administrative, and support staff.Ensure timely onboarding and orientation of new hires.Promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in hiring practices.
   

  

**Employee Relations \& Engagement:** 
 Foster a positive work environment through proactive engagement and support.Handle employee concerns, grievances, and conflict resolution in a fair and consistent manner.Develop and implement initiatives that support staff well\-being and retention.
   

  

**Performance Management \& Development:** 
 Support performance appraisal processes and goal\-setting practices.Collaborate with department heads to identify professional development needs.Guide leadership and staff on career development opportunities and succession planning.
   

  

**Compliance \& Policy Implementation:** 
 Ensure compliance with labor laws, school policies, and relevant educational regulations.Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date HR documentation and records.Lead internal audits and HR reporting as needed.
   

  

 Detailed JD : JD \- HR Partner \- OIS.pdf
   

  

 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils where we embrace all race, abilities, religions, genders, and cultures.
   

  

 All post holders in regulated activity (having regular unsupervised contact with children) are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We welcome applications from suitable qualified persons from all diverse backgrounds.
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

description:
**Company Description** 




 Leap of Faith? Nah, Leap of Creativity! THE LEAPFROG NETWORK is not your average ad agency \- we are the cool experts in the marketing playground. They craft campaigns stronger than your coffee and have more ideas than coffee stains on their brainstorming whiteboard. Join us for a joyride through the world of witty campaigns and quirky concepts. THE LEAPFROG NETWORK is not in the business of blending in; we are here to make your brand stand out like a unicorn.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The HR Specialist will lead end\-to\-end people operations within our fast\-paced, deadline\-driven agency environment. In this role, you will act as a strategic partner to creative, account, and technical teams, executing core HR functions with high velocity. The ideal candidate has deep experience navigating the unique dynamics of agency life\-balancing rapid talent acquisition, payroll accuracy, compliance, and burnout mitigation to keep our billable teams motivated and high\-performing.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. High\-Velocity Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding** 



* **Full\-Cycle Recruitment:** 
 Lead full\-cycle hiring for creative, strategy, account management, and technical roles, ensuring a pipeline of top\-tier industry talent.
* **Talent Branding:** 
 Partner with marketing and hiring managers to enhance candidate pipelines and optimize the time\-to\-hire metric.
* **Onboarding Integration:** 
 Execute an efficient integration framework that accelerates time\-to\-productivity for all new hires.



  





**2\. Compensation \& Payroll Operations** 



* **Payroll Lifecycle:** 
 Manage and audit monthly payroll inputs (attendance, leaves, overtime, and performance\-based bonuses) to ensure 100% accuracy.
* **Benefits Oversight:** 
 Manage health, wellness, and statutory benefit programs customized to support.



  





**3\. Performance \& Retention Management** 



* **Agile Performance Reviews:** 
 Facilitate continuous feedback loops and structured appraisal frameworks aligned with project velocity and KPIs.
* **Retention \& Burnout Mitigation:** 
 Proactively identify signs of burnout and implement targeted wellness initiatives to maintain high morale and reduce turnover.
* **Career Mapping:** 
 Map clear growth trajectories for creative and account teams to foster long\-term internal growth.



  





**4\. Compliance \& Employee Relations** 



* **Labor Law Compliance:** 
 Ensure strict adherence to local labor laws and corporate governance.
* **Conflict Resolution:** 
 Serve as an objective mediator for workplace grievances, managing employee relations fairly and confidentially.
* **Policy Governance:** 
 Update and enforce agency\-specific guidelines (e.g., client confidentiality, intellectual property, remote work rules).



  





**5\. HRIS \& People Analytics** 



* **Data Integrity:** 
 Maintain accurate real\-time records in the HRIS, ensuring data security and confidentiality.
* **Metrics \& Reporting:** 
 Generate weekly/monthly metrics on headcount utilization, recruitment velocity, and attrition trends to help leadership make data\-driven decisions.



  





**Core Competencies \& Qualifications** 



1. **Experience:** 
 3\+ years of progressive HR experience, specifically within an advertising, digital marketing, PR, or creative agency environment.
2. **Industry Knowledge:** 
 Deep understanding of agency structures, client\-servicing dynamics, and billable vs. non\-billable time metrics.
3. **Technical Proficiency:** 
 Strong hands\-on knowledge of HRIS and ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems) platforms.
4. **Traits:** 
 Exceptionally organized, emotionally intelligent, resilient under pressure, and highly skilled at communicating with diverse, creative personalities.

**Job Description**
 Title:
 **Head of Human Resources – Global Innovation Center**
 We are looking for a Head of HR for our newly established Global Innovation Center (GIC) in Pune, India. You will be responsible for building, scaling, and running the full people strategy for the Jefferies GIC. In this role, you will play an important part in developing the talent, helping create the culture, and be deeply involved in governance, and the people operations framework needed to operate a high performing, innovation\-driven global center.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
*HR Strategy \& Organizational Build\-Out*
* Establish the HR operating model for the GIC, aligned with Jefferies’ global people strategy, and localized for the Pune labor market.
* Partner with the GIC leadership team to align HR priorities with delivery demands.
* Build and lead the end\-to\-end people lifecycle for the GIC including workforce planning, onboarding, performance management, compensation including benchmarking to local market, and management of employee relations in partnership with employment legal.
* Establish and continuously refine organization structures, role architecture, and capability frameworks that support scaled growth.


*Stakeholder Management \& Leadership*
* Serve as the primary HR business advisor to the GIC Head and global technology leaders.
* Partner closely with global HR leadership including Global Head of HR, Asia Head of HR, Corporate Head of HR and Global Head of Recruiting to ensure the GIC develops as a seamless extension of Jefferies’ global organizational model.
* Represent the GIC HR function in global forums, governance committees, and transformation programs.
* Provide development, training, guidance, and leadership to new GIC HR team members.
* Help identify and successfully hire the GIC HR team.


*Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning*
* Partner with recruiting leadership and global stakeholders to support the development and execution of a comprehensive hiring strategy. This will include contributing to superday hiring initiatives, advancing workforce diversity goals, and helping to define the technical requirements that enable the recruiting team to build a strong candidate pipeline aligned to the GIC’s strategic objectives.
* Ensure all hiring processes are consistent with Jefferies’ global standards and local regulatory requirements.
* In partnership with Head of Recruiting for GIC, drive leadership hiring and oversee recruitment governance, vendor management, and capacity planning.


*Culture, Engagement \& Local HR Policy*
* In partnership with Technology leaders, define the Jefferies culture of the GIC.
* Advise and partner closely with the India HR team across the two established Jefferies entities, and employment legal in establishing regulatory requirements such as India Labor codes and ensuring ongoing compliance.
* Localize global people policies, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment to GIC local culture.
* Design and deliver employee engagement strategies, leadership development, inclusion initiatives, and communication programs to foster a cohesive, high performance GIC culture.


*Compensation, Performance \& Development*
* Establish performance management frameworks optimized for GIC talent.
* Lead compensation and benefits strategy for the GIC in partnership with Compensation \& Benefits team, driving alignment with the GIC market.
* Partner with the global Training \& Development and Community \& Engagement teams to design capability building programs.


*HR Governance \& Compliance*
* Ensure the GIC is audit ready across all HR processes, partnering with Global HR, Compliance, and Legal.
* Operationalize local employment requirements relevant to Pune.
* Lead engagement with external audits for items related to Pune and the GIC.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 15\+ years of experience in financial services business advisory HR leadership, with experience leading HR for GICs, shared services, or global operations businesses.
* Proven experience in growth environments and building HR functions from the ground up.
* Extensive knowledge of the Pune talent market with strong local labor law and regulatory experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and matrix organization influencing skills; experience partnering with global functional heads.
* Proven track record in leadership and management of employment relations matters.
* Ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial, fast scaling, environment.
* Experience managing HR transformation and change\-management initiatives.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**About the Company** 




 Scapia is a co\-branded credit card built to make travel happen for people, by converting their everyday expenses into travel experiences. We’re a bunch of passionate people who work together, brainstorm, and debate with each other, and don’t stop until we’re proud of our work. Customer delight tops everything else — we’ve worked hard to create an environment of honesty and passion that sets everyone up for success.
 



**Role :** 




 Business Analyst, Commerce and Customer Support \& Experience \- owning analytics for Scapia's Commerce charter as well as org\-level Customer Support \& Experience use cases. You will work closely with Commerce/Store product and category teams, and with the Scapia customer support team, to turn data into decisions across both charters.
 



**Scope of Role :** 




 You will own the data models and analysis that power decision\-making across Scapia's Commerce vertical, focused on three charter areas:
 



 • Commerce category growth analytics \- track and diagnose GMV/order growth by category, and
 



 identify the levers (new users, repeat purchase, basket size, category mix) driving or dragging
 



 growth.
 



 • Product performance analysis \- build recurring views of how products/listings perform (conversion, returns, margin, ratings) to inform catalog, pricing, and vendor decisions.
 



 • Commerce inventory forecasting \- build demand and stock\-cover models that help the
 



 category/procurement teams avoid stockouts and overstock.
 



 In addition, you will own analytics for Scapia's org\-level Customer Support \& Experience use cases (not limited to Commerce):
 



 • Customer support \& experience analytics — build models and dashboards that help the CX support team prioritize tickets, predict escalations, track sentiment, and plan resourcing.
 



  





*Beyond these charter areas, you will:* 




 • Work closely with business and product teams to understand challenges, break problems into
 



 analytical components, and deliver insights that influence strategy.
 



 • Independently plan, execute, and deliver analytical projects with high quality, finding solutions to mitigate risks and dependencies along the way.
 



 • Use AI\-powered tools (Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) throughout your workflow (for SQL, Python, and reporting) to be more productive.
 



  





*Example Projects You’ll Drive* 




 Commerce Category Growth Analytics
 



 • Category growth diagnostics: decompose GMV/order growth for each commerce category into
 



 new\-user acquisition, repeat purchase, basket size, and category mix shifts — and flag which
 



 categories are decelerating and why.
 



 • Category expansion / cross\-sell: identify which category a customer is most likely to try next, based on current purchase pattern and Scapia Coins engagement, to prioritize placement, offers, and homepage real estate.
 



 Product Performance Analysis
 



 • Product performance scorecards: build a repeatable view of top\- and bottom\-performing
 



 SKUs/listings by conversion, return rate, and margin to inform catalog curation and vendor
 



 conversations.
 



 • New product / category launch tracking: define success metrics and track performance of newly onboarded products or categories over their first 30/60/90 days, flagging underperformers early.
 



 Commerce Inventory Forecasting
 



 • Demand forecasting: build category/SKU\-level demand forecasts using historical sales, seasonality, and the promotional calendar to reduce stockouts and overstock.
 



 • Inventory health monitoring: build a live view of stock cover, aging inventory, and reorder triggers to support procurement and vendor discussions.
 



 Scapia Customer Support \& Experience
 



 • Support ticket prioritization model: score and rank incoming tickets by urgency/impact so agents work the highest\-priority issues first.
 



 • Ticket escalation predictive scoring: predict which open tickets are likely to escalate, using early signals from ticket content, customer history, and agent handling, so they can be pre\-empted.
 



 • NPS sentiment analytics and recommendations: analyze NPS verbatims and support interactions to surface sentiment drivers and recommend actions to the CX org.
 



 • Ticket/contact volume projections: forecast ticket and contact volumes by channel/category to
 



 support CX Agent staffing and resource planning.
 



  





**What We're Looking For :** 




 Education \& Professional Background
 



 • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a
 



 related quantitative field.
 



 • 1–3 years of experience in a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Data Scientist, or Analytics role at a product\-based B2C organization; exposure to e\-commerce/commerce analytics is a strong plus.
 



 Core Skills
 



 • Strong proficiency in SQL and Excel — able to write queries to extract, filter, and analyze data from structured and unstructured tables.
 



 • Working knowledge of Python for data mining, analysis, statistical modeling, and machine learning.
 



 • Working knowledge of AI\-powered agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, etc.) to accelerate SQL, Python, and analytical workflows.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with a BI tool (Tableau, Power BI, QuickSight, Looker, or similar).
 



 • Solid understanding of statistical concepts (correlation, regression, segmentation, hypothesis testing, and statistical significance)
 



 • Ability to break down complex business problems into analytical components and work
 



 collaboratively to solve them.
 



 • Prior exposure to A/B testing or experimentation frameworks is a plus
 



 • Familiarity with data tools (Databricks, Airflow) or cloud environments (AWS/GCP) is a plus
 



 Communication Skills
 



 • Exceptional written and verbal communication \- able to explain complex findings clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 • Ability to multitask and manage diverse analytical requirements simultaneously.
 



 • Collaborative mindset with strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.

title: Sizing Analyst
description:
**Department:** 
 Sales
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata / Gurgaon
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Salary:** 
 10\-12 LPA
 



  





**About Triphos** 




 Triphos Power is a full\-stack battery\-as\-a\-service company focused on commercial and industrial (C\&I) customers. We finance, own, deploy, operate, and maintain battery storage systems, backed by our own in\-house Energy Management System (EMS) — putting us at the intersection of system integration, battery portfolio management, and technology. Our target is 100 MWh across 30–40 C\&I sites in Year 1, scaling to a gigawatt\-hour\-plus portfolio within three years. We're backed by the promoter family of Rupa \& Co. and Neo Metaliks, giving us capital strength, distribution expertise, and a warm C\&I customer pipeline from day one.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Every Triphos proposal starts with a number: how much battery a site actually needs, and what it saves the customer. The Sizing Analyst owns that number. You'll work directly with C\&I clients to pull the load, tariff, and consumption data we need, clean it into something usable, and run the sizing and feasibility analysis behind every deal. Your output is the package the customer decides on — a full sizing report, a savings analysis, and a financial model with a clear ROI case. As we push toward 100 MWh across 30–40 sites in Year 1, this analysis is what separates a deal that closes and performs from one that doesn't.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the client data pipeline end to end — work through the data questionnaire with C\&I clients, understand exactly what's needed from each site, and follow up until it lands
* Clean, structure, and validate large, messy client datasets into analysis\-ready inputs
* Run sizing and optimization analysis to determine the right battery configuration for each site
* Determine which use case fits each client best — peak shaving, time\-of\-day arbitrage, renewable integration — based on what the data actually shows
* Research and interpret state tariff orders, electricity bills, penalty structures, and open access regulations to ground every analysis in real numbers
* Build savings analyses that quantify what the customer actually stands to gain
* Produce the full BESS feasibility analysis report for each site
* Communicate directly with clients throughout — chasing data, clarifying assumptions, and keeping the process moving
* Contribute to automating and streamlining the analysis process as we scale



  





**Key Requirements / Skills** 



* 0–3 years of experience
* BSc or higher in Operations Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative field
* Strong expertise in Excel, Python, SQL, or similar analytical tools
* Strong with numbers, with a solid grounding in optimization, statistics, and sharp problem\-solving instincts
* Basic electrical knowledge, or willingness to pick it up quickly



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 Your analysis drives real investment decisions on both sides, so we want someone who feels that weight and checks their work accordingly.
 


* Meticulous — you go through data line by line because you know what rides on it
* Mathematically sharp, with the instinct to spot a number that looks wrong
* A clear communicator who builds rapport with clients and gets the data you need fast
* Comfortable working directly with C\&I customers
* High ownership and hands\-on, in a small, fast\-moving team



  





**How to Apply** 



* Send your resume and a note under 200 words on why you think you are the right fit to hr@triphospower.com.

* Familiarity with vector databases/vector search technologies such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector, Azure AI Search, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, or equivalent.

title: Analyst-Data Science
description:
**Job Description**
 Credit and Fraud Risk (CFR) team helps drive profitable business growth by reducing the risk of fraud and maintaining industry lowest credit loss rates. It uses an array of tools and ever\-evolving technology to detect and combat fraud, minimize the disruption of good spending, and provide a world\-class customer experience. The team leads efforts that leverage data and digital advancements to improve risk management as well as enable commerce and drive innovation.
   

  

 A single decision can have many outcomes. And when that decision affects millions of customers, it needs to be the right one. That’s where our Credit \& Fraud Risk (CFR) Analytics \& Data Science CoE team comes in. The team leads efforts that leverage data and digital advancements to improve risk management as well as enable commerce and drive innovation, every day. Right from targeting the right customer for our products to underwriting them to managing their experience with Amex when they get onboarded, every decision is advised by groundbreaking analytics \& data science. We help the company grow its business profitably while delivering the world's best customer experience, all powered by data. We are the backbone of all financial services operations at American Express and impact every aspect of the company.
   

  

 As a part of the team, you’ll have the opportunity to work in one of the best companies for data scientists in the country. You will solve real world business problems while getting exposure to the industry’s top leaders in analytics, data science and machine learning. If you’re passionate about solving complex problems and crafting solutions that impact millions, you should consider a career in CFR.
   

  

**Description On The Role**
 Development, deployment and validation of predictive model(s) and supporting use of models in economic logic to enable profitable decisions across risk, fraud and marketing.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Understand the core business of AXP and the levers behind various decisions
* Analyze large amounts of data to derive business insights and create innovative solutions
* Leverage the power of closed loop through Amex network to make decisions more intelligent and relevant
* Innovate with a focus on developing newer and better approaches using big data \& machine learning solution
* Clear articulation and structuring of business findings across prospect and customer domain to the leadership and key partners
* Maintain external lens and be aware of developments in the field of Finance/Payments/Analytics etc.


**Qualifications**
* MBA, master’s degree in economics, Statistics, Computer Science Or related fields
* 0\-30 months of experience in analytics, big data workstreams.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment
* Ability to drive project deliverables to achieve business results
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Innovative problem solver with ability to learn quickly and work independently with complex, unstructured initiatives
* Ability to Integrate with Cross\-Functional Business Partners Worldwide
* SAS, R, Python, Hive, Spark, SQL
* Unsupervised and supervised techniques \-: active learning, transfer learning, neural models, Decision trees, reinforcement learning, graphical models, Gaussian processes, Bayesian models, Map Reduce techniques, attribute engineering


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Expertise in Coding, Algorithm, High Performance Computing


**About Us**
 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
   

  

 As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well\-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We back you with benefits that support your holistic well\-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
   

  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial\-well\-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on\-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

title: Associate Data Scientist – Modeling, Analytics & Pipelines
description:
Aera Technology is a pioneer in the growing category of Decision Intelligence Platforms and a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for 2026 – the technology to digitize, augment, and automate decision\-making processes with AI and machine learning. Through our AI decision automation platform, Aera Decision Cloud™, we are helping the best\-known brands in the world make smarter, faster decisions.
   

  

 The need for decision intelligence has never been greater. The digitization of the economy has introduced a paradox: Companies today are awash in data, yet the velocity, volume, and complexity of that information is outpacing their ability to make decisions with the speed and precision that today’s business environment demands. Decision intelligence represents the critical shift — moving from people making decisions with machine support to machines making decisions guided by people. As the digital economy accelerates into an era defined by agentic AI, this shift has become a competitive necessity, enabling organizations to act faster, adapt with confidence, and unlock value once beyond reach.
   

  

 Aera Technology is at the forefront of this agentic revolution. Recognized by IDC as a leader in decision intelligence and cited by Gartner in its Market Guide for Decision Intelligence, we’re the trusted choice of global market leaders. Built on a comprehensive and composable platform, Aera empowers organizations to optimize and automate all types of decisions, across every business area.
   

  

 We are looking for an Associate Data Scientist who is exceptional at understanding data, extracting insights, and turning those insights into robust machine learning or statistical models. You will own the full modeling workflow from exploratory analysis and feature engineering through to building reproducible pipelines that can be deployed into production for our customers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with product and domain experts to translate ambiguous business questions into clear analytical and modeling problems.
* Perform deep exploratory data analysis (EDA) on complex, noisy, and often incomplete datasets; validate data quality, uncover patterns, and frame hypotheses.
* Design and implement features, select appropriate modeling approaches (e.g., regression, tree\-based models, time series, clustering), and benchmark alternatives.
* Write clean, well\-structured Python code and notebooks for interactive analysis, experimentation, and result communication.
* Build end‑to‑end data and modeling pipelines (data extraction, preprocessing, feature generation, model training, evaluation, and inference) that are modular, testable, and reproducible.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to productionize models on the Aera platform, including packaging, versioning, monitoring, and validation.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders using visualizations, written narratives, and live walkthroughs.


**About You**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
* 1–3 years of experience in data science, data analysis, or ML engineering, or equivalent strong project/internship experience.
* Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis: pandas, NumPy, and common scientific/ML libraries (e.g., scikit‑learn; familiarity with TensorFlow/PyTorch is a plus).
* Solid experience with EDA and statistical analysis; comfortable working in notebooks to iteratively explore data and build intuition.
* Good working knowledge of SQL and data manipulation; able to join, aggregate, and transform data from multiple sources.
* Experience structuring code into reusable components, applying basic software engineering practices (version control, testing, documentation).
* Strong analytical thinking and problem‑solving skills, with a bias for clear, data‑backed decision making.


**Nice to have**
* Exposure to production ML/analytics systems (scheduling, APIs, CI/CD, monitoring).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and distributed data frameworks (e.g., Spark).
* Domain experience in supply chain, logistics, or operations.


 If you share our passion for building a sustainable, intelligent, and efficient world, you’re in the right place. Established in 2017 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, we're a series D start\-up, with teams in Mountain View, San Francisco (California), Bucharest and Cluj\-Napoca (Romania), Paris (France), Munich (Germany), London (UK), Pune (India), and Sydney (Australia). So join us, and let’s build this!
   

  

 Aera Technology is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

**Benefits Summary**
 At Aera Technology, we strive to support our Aeranauts and their loved ones through different stages of life with a variety of attractive benefits, and great perks. In addition to offering a competitive salary and company stock options, we have other great benefits available. You’ll find comprehensive medical, Group Medical Insurance, Term Insurance, Accidental Insurance, paid time off, Maternity leave, and much more. We offer unlimited access to online professional courses for both professional and personal development, coupled with people manager development programs. We believe in a flexible working environment, to allow our Aeranauts to perform at their best, ensuring a healthy work\-life balance. title: AI/ML Engineer I
description:
**Job description** 




  





 Job Role \-
 **AI/ML Engineer I** 




 Job Type:
 **Full\-Time** 




 Mode:
 **WFO \- Onsite** 




 Location:
 **Pune** 




 Notice Period:
 **Immediate (preferred) to 30 days** 




 Experience:
 **01 to 03 yrs** 




  





**Most engineers with a year of AI experience have trained models. Few have kept one alive in production. We're hiring for the second kind.** 




  





 Plenty of places will let you fine\-tune a model on a clean dataset, report an accuracy number and call it done. We'd rather hand you a real client problem, a senior engineer who will tell you honestly when your approach won't hold up, and enough rope to own a scoped piece of the system end to end.
 



 If you want the next year to be about production judgement rather than another notebook, this is the right place for it.
   




 About Kreeda Labs
 
 We are an AI and full stack product engineering company based in Pune. We have delivered 75\+ production systems for 40\+ clients across three continents, spanning fashion, HR tech, healthcare, insurance, eLearning and supply chain.
 



 Our work includes engagements with Ralph Lauren, Tata Group / Tata Play, Patanjali and Multiversity. AI is not a side experiment here — it is what a growing share of our client work is built on, and this role works on it directly.
   




 What you'll do
 
 You will work alongside senior engineers on live client systems, not sandboxed exercises — starting with well\-scoped pieces and taking on more as you prove you can carry them.
 



  





**Build** 





 •   
 
 Build and train ML/DL models for real client use cases, from data preparation through evaluation
 




 •   
 
 Build Computer Vision pipelines, including image preprocessing and object detection
 




 •   
 
 Prototype GenAI and RAG applications, including vector database integrations
 



  





**Ship** 





 •   
 
 Build production inference pipelines and REST APIs (FastAPI) around your models
 




 •   
 
 Deploy and maintain AI applications on AWS using Docker
 




 •   
 
 Debug and stabilise deployed models under real traffic, not just in a notebook
 



  





**Research and improve** 





 •   
 
 Fine\-tune open\-source models and compare approaches, including PEFT/LoRA
 




 •   
 
 Read papers, documentation and open\-source repos, and turn promising ideas into working prototypes
 




 •   
 
 Evaluate models and systems properly, and use failure cases to improve them
   




 Who can apply
 
  





**Must have** 





 •   
 
 Approximately 1 year of hands\-on engineering experience, including real AI/ML systems
 




 •   
 
 Strong Python, with scikit\-learn and PyTorch and/or TensorFlow
 




 •   
 
 Practical experience building, training and evaluating ML/DL models, including data preprocessing and feature engineering
 




 •   
 
 Computer Vision fundamentals: OpenCV/PIL, image preprocessing and object detection (YOLO or similar)
 




 •   
 
 Hands\-on GenAI work: prompt engineering, Hugging Face/Transformers, RAG and vector databases
 




 •   
 
 Fine\-tuning experience with open\-source models, including PEFT/LoRA familiarity
 




 •   
 
 Agent and tool\-calling experience with LangChain, LangGraph or an equivalent framework
 




 •   
 
 Backend and API development with FastAPI, plus Pydantic/request validation
 




 •   
 
 Cloud deployment experience with Docker, AWS S3 and AWS EC2
 




 •   
 
 Ability to evaluate models with the right metrics and explain what a failure case taught you
 




 •   
 
 The ability to explain your own architecture and model choices without hiding behind jargon
 



  





**Good to have** 





 •   
 
 MLOps tooling: MLflow, CI/CD, Kubernetes
 




 •   
 
 AWS ECR / ECS / CloudWatch
 




 •   
 
 Multimodal or Vision\-Language Models, advanced model optimisation or quantisation
 



*You don't need every line here. What matters is that you can point to at least one AI/ML project you personally took into production — not just trained.*



 What makes this different
 
 At most companies, a year into an AI role you are still working in one corner of one product, off someone else's spec. Here you will touch real client systems across industries within your first year — the fastest way to build the production judgement that separates an AI/ML engineer from someone who can only train models.
 



 You will also work in an engineering environment where AI\-assisted development is normal. We expect you to use those tools well and still be able to review and defend everything that ends up in the repository.
   




 What you'll gain
 

 •   
 
 Hands\-on ownership of scoped AI/ML components inside real client systems, not sandboxed exercises
 




 •   
 
 Exposure to production GenAI, Computer Vision and classical ML work across industries, not one product
 




 •   
 
 Direct mentorship from senior engineers who will tell you honestly when your approach won't hold up
 




 •   
 
 A clear, merit\-based path toward Senior AI Engineer, defined by what you ship and fix
 




 •   
 
 Compensation that reflects hands\-on production experience, not just a generic entry\-level band
   




 This role may not be for you if
 
 You want to stay in notebooks and hand off anything that touches production, you are only comfortable with clean tutorial datasets, you expect to be told exactly what to build rather than figuring it out, or you have not yet shipped anything a real user depended on.
 



  





*We aim to close the process within two weeks and we respond either way.*

title: Generative AI Data Scientist — Wealth Analytics
description:
This is an opportunity to build and ship Generative AI models that power a live, intelligent client engagement platform at the heart of Citi's Wealth business. As a Generative AI Data Scientist within Citi's Analytics \& Information Management function, you will design, train, and deploy LLM\-based solutions that help financial advisors reach the right clients, with the right message, at the right time — at scale and with measurable impact. You will go beyond modelling to own the analytics that measure how the platform performs and inform how it improves.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and implement Generative AI and LLM\-based solutions using Python, PySpark, and SQL, applying techniques including prompt engineering, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and model fine\-tuning to power an intelligent client engagement platform.
* Train, validate, and deploy machine learning models across the full model lifecycle — from data extraction and exploratory analysis through to production deployment and ongoing governance.
* Analyse structured and unstructured datasets to surface business insights that directly inform product decisions and strategic priorities within the Wealth business.
* Harden GenAI components for production use by improving output relevance and quality, building in monitoring and evaluation, and ensuring models meet Citi's compliance and governance standards.
* Build and apply product analytics to measure platform adoption, quantify value delivered to advisors, and identify where users encounter friction — then translate those findings into concrete platform improvements.
* Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to move solutions from prototype to production, integrating models directly into platform workflows.
* Evaluate emerging AI and LLM capabilities for applicability to the platform, and communicate findings clearly through presentations and analytical reports to technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in an AI, machine learning, or data science role, with direct exposure to deep learning or generative AI applications.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL, including writing efficient queries, processing large datasets, and applying these tools to build and validate analytical solutions.
* Practical experience working with Large Language Models (such as OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini) and frameworks including TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
* Ability to apply core machine learning techniques — including supervised and unsupervised modelling, statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and data visualisation — to generate clear, actionable insights.
* Familiarity with vector databases and model fine\-tuning techniques, and the ability to validate and maintain models once deployed in production.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.


**Beneficial Skills \& Qualifications**
* Exposure to product development practices such as working with engineering teams, version control, API integration, or feature monitoring within a live platform or application.
* Experience using product analytics to define metrics, measure user adoption and engagement, and analyse behavioural patterns such as drop\-offs or conversion funnels.
* Awareness of what makes an AI platform production\-grade, including evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, and scalability considerations.
* Published research, conference presentations, or certifications in AI, machine learning, data science, or analytics.

 Joining this team means working on a production\-grade GenAI platform that is already delivering measurable impact for Citi's Wealth business — not a proof of concept, but a live system used by financial advisors at scale. You will work within one of India's most established analytics functions, alongside data scientists, engineers, and product managers who are committed to building something that genuinely works in the real world.

* Hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge GenAI and LLM technologies applied to real financial services use cases.
* Exposure to the complete model lifecycle — from training and fine\-tuning through to production deployment, monitoring, and governance.
* Access to learning and development resources to grow your technical skills and deepen your knowledge of AI and machine learning.
* The opportunity to build product analytics capability alongside your data science work, developing a broader understanding of how intelligent platforms succeed in practice.

description:
**About the Job** 




  





 Infinita Lab is a material testing solutions provider that helps engineers, researchers, and product development teams validate materials, components, and technical decisions through a global network of specialized testing laboratories.
 



 We support clients across aerospace, semiconductor, advanced materials, polymers, chemicals, energy, sustainability, manufacturing, and medical device industries by simplifying access to testing expertise through a single point of contact.
 



  





 We are looking for a Materials Application Engineer – Data \& Experiment Planning with strong materials fundamentals and exposure to computational, statistical, or data\-driven methods.
 



 In this role, you will work at the intersection of materials science, technical requirements, experimental data, experiment planning, modelling, analysis, and optimization. You will help translate open\-ended engineering and R\&D problems into structured technical workflows and practical testing approaches.
 



  





 Initially, you will work closely with the team to understand client requirements, materials testing workflows, laboratory processes, and how technical projects are evaluated and executed. As you gain this understanding, you will apply computational and data\-driven approaches to support materials\-related problem\-solving, experiment planning, modeling, and optimization.
 



  





**In this role, you will:** 




  





 • Understand customer goals, material requirements, constraints, available samples, timelines, and the technical decision they are trying to make
 



 • Work with materials data, experimental results, and technical requirements to develop structured experiment plans and analysis
 



 • Apply statistical and computational methods such as regression, model validation, optimization, and other appropriate data\-driven approaches
 



 • Support modeling and optimization of material variables, formulations, processes, or other technical parameters
 



 • Support the development of repeatable technical workflows, digital tools, and templates for materials\-related applications
 



 • Work closely with engineers, scientists, researchers, laboratory partners, and internal teams to develop practical technical solutions
 



  





**What makes this role unique?** 




  





 • Work at the intersection of materials science, computational methods, data, and real\-world experiments
 



 • Opportunity to work on open\-ended materials and engineering problems across multiple industries
 



 • Exposure to experiment planning, optimization, modeling, and data\-driven decision\-making
 



 • Opportunity to contribute to internal digital workflows and technical tools
 



 • Direct exposure to engineers, scientists, researchers, and R\&D teams
 



 • Opportunity to build expertise across materials applications, computational thinking, and technical problem\-solving
 



  





 If you're interested in using materials science and computational thinking to solve practical engineering and R\&D problems, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
**Job Title: AI Engineer** 




 Location: Gurugram, Haryana, India
 



 Experience: 1\-3 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 We are a technology\-driven organization focused on building practical products and services that solve meaningful customer and business problems. Our teams combine software engineering, data, and product thinking to turn complex requirements into reliable solutions. We value ownership, learning, thoughtful execution, and measurable outcomes. Engineers work closely with product, design, operations, and business stakeholders to understand problems clearly and deliver improvements that customers can experience. We are building an environment where early\-career professionals can develop strong technical judgment, learn from experienced teammates, and contribute to production systems. The organization encourages experimentation when it is grounded in evidence, disciplined engineering practices, and responsible use of technology. By joining our engineering team, you will help strengthen intelligent capabilities while developing the practical skills required to move models and ideas from experimentation into dependable business value.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As an AI Engineer, you will own the development and improvement of machine learning and generative AI capabilities that support business and customer outcomes. You will work across the delivery lifecycle: understanding the problem, preparing data, developing models or AI workflows, evaluating quality, integrating services, and monitoring results in production. The role is designed for an engineer with 1–3 years of experience who can combine practical software development with curiosity about modern AI techniques. You will partner with senior engineers, product stakeholders, and domain experts to convert ambiguous requirements into testable solutions. Success means shipping reliable capabilities, improving model or workflow performance, and making AI features maintainable for the wider engineering team. You will also contribute to engineering standards, documentation, and responsible practices that help the organization scale AI adoption with confidence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Build, integrate, and maintain machine learning or generative AI solutions that address defined product and business problems, improving user experience, process efficiency, or decision quality.
* Prepare, transform, and validate datasets through reproducible pipelines, ensuring data quality, traceability, and fit\-for\-purpose inputs for model development and evaluation.
* Develop evaluation approaches using relevant metrics, test cases, and human or business feedback, turning results into targeted improvements in model quality and system reliability.
* Deploy AI services through maintainable APIs, applications, or orchestration workflows, working with platform and software engineers to support secure, scalable production usage.
* Monitor model and application behavior after release, identifying drift, latency, cost, failures, or quality degradation and driving corrective actions through measurable operational signals.
* Translate stakeholder requirements into technical designs, communicating trade\-offs clearly and keeping delivery aligned with expected outcomes, constraints, and responsible AI considerations.
* Contribute production\-quality code through version control, peer reviews, automated testing, documentation, and incident learning, strengthening the team’s engineering standards over time.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong Python programming and practical software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, APIs, testing, version control, debugging, and writing maintainable production code.
* Working knowledge of machine learning concepts, model training and evaluation, data preparation, and common libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn, or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with SQL, cloud or containerized environments, and modern AI patterns such as embeddings, vector search, prompt design, retrieval\-augmented generation, or model\-serving workflows.
* Ability to analyze experimental results, communicate technical findings clearly, and collaborate with product and engineering stakeholders to turn uncertain problems into measurable delivery plans.
* Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, bias awareness, security, reproducibility, and monitoring requirements for systems used by real customers or business teams.



**Additional Plus** 



* Experience taking a machine learning, NLP, computer vision, recommendation, or generative AI prototype into a usable application or production workflow.
* Exposure to MLOps or DevOps practices such as CI/CD, experiment tracking, model registries, observability, Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud AI services.
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation, fine\-tuning, agent workflows, prompt versioning, or techniques for improving inference quality, latency, and cost.



  





**What You'll Bring** 




 You bring a practical engineering mindset and the ability to learn quickly in a changing technical environment. You can write clear Python, reason about data and model behavior, and work methodically from an unclear problem toward a testable solution. You are comfortable asking questions, validating assumptions, and using evidence rather than relying on intuition alone. You understand that an AI capability is valuable only when it is reliable, maintainable, secure, and connected to a real user or business outcome. You take responsibility for the quality of your work, including tests, documentation, monitoring, and follow\-through after release. You collaborate openly with senior engineers and cross\-functional partners, explaining technical concepts in language that supports sound decisions. You are curious about new developments in machine learning and generative AI, but you also know when a simpler approach is more appropriate. You will be successful if you combine technical fundamentals, disciplined execution, thoughtful communication, and a strong willingness to grow through feedback and hands\-on delivery.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Build practical AI capabilities that move beyond experimentation, with ownership across data, engineering, evaluation, deployment, and measurable business impact.
* Work alongside experienced engineers and cross\-functional partners, gaining exposure to production systems, responsible AI decisions, and the full lifecycle of intelligent products.
* Grow through meaningful ownership, structured feedback, and opportunities to deepen both core software engineering skills and modern machine learning expertise.
* Join a collaborative engineering environment that values learning, clear communication, dependable delivery, and solutions that create lasting value for customers and the organization.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A hands\-on opportunity to work on real AI engineering problems across experimentation, integration, deployment, evaluation, and production improvement.
* Direct collaboration with engineering, product, and business teams, providing broad exposure to how technical systems create customer and operational outcomes.
* A learning\-oriented environment with mentorship, peer feedback, and space to build depth in machine learning, generative AI, software engineering, and MLOps practices.
* An onsite role in Gurugram with clear ownership, meaningful work, and the opportunity to contribute to an engineering organization scaling practical AI adoption.

By integrating advisory capabilities with scalable delivery, TresVista helps clients operate smarter and grow stronger.  About Department The Operational and Digital Excellence (ODEX) team is a newly established, cross\-functional task force within TresVista, focused on driving firm\-wide transformation. Our mandate is to reimagine and elevate the way we operate — across internal support functions and client\-facing teams — through process optimization, technology enablement, and digital innovation. ODEX sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology. The team leads high\-impact initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, and client delivery. This includes applying principles of process re\-engineering, automation, and data driven decision\-making, as well as exploring the responsible and practical use of AI. It is a highly selective and agile team made up of high\-performing individuals who bring a deep understanding of our business, high integrity, willingness to learn, and a strong appetite for change. description:
**Who are we?**
 RZR is an AI\-driven company specializing in mobile advertising solutions designed to fuel revenue growth. We leverage AI to discover audiences in a privacy\-first environment through trillions of contextual bidding signals and proprietary behavioral models. Our audience engagement platform includes creative strategy and execution. We handle 5 million mobile ad requests per second from over 10 billion devices, driving performance for both publishers and brands. We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with a global presence across the United States, EMEA, and APAC.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. As an ML Engineer, you will be involved in designing and implementing machine learning models and data pipelines to enhance our programmatic demand\-side platform (DSP). You will work closely with Senior MLE and other team members to drive impactful machine learning projects and contribute to innovative solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Support the development of machine learning models to address challenges in programmatic advertising, such as predicting user responses, forecasting bid landscapes, and detecting fraud.
* Collaborate with senior data scientists and cross\-functional teams (product, engineering, and analytics) to integrate models into production workflows.
* Analyze the impact of integrating new data sources and features into our models.
* Build and maintain data pipelines to process and prepare large datasets for model training and evaluation.
* Contribute ideas and assist in testing new tools, methodologies, and technologies to improve our machine learning capabilities.
* Document experiments, assumptions, and outcomes; maintain reproducibility


**Required Skills / Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 1\-3 years of professional experience in machine learning, statistical analysis, and data analysis.
* Experience with machine learning techniques such as regression, classification, and clustering.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL and familiarity with big data tools (e.g., Spark) and ML libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-Learn).

title: Analyst Technology Risk Intelligence
description:
**About Us**
**Standard**
 At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Analyst, Technology Risk Intelligence in our Risk, Group Technology team, you’ll support the Technology Risk Intelligence practice to provide day\-to\-day analyst support to by assisting with repeatable data, reporting and evidence routines that help the team deliver Line 2 oversight.
   

  

 Working under the supervision of Senior Associates/Managers to gather and organise evidence, extract and reconcile data, you’ll refresh dashboards and prepare draft summaries that support reviews, thematic work, events/issues analysis and governance packs.
   

  

 You’ll contribute to efficiency and repeatability by maintaining and running approved templates, scripts and automation steps (where authorised), escalating data quality issues and tool/access concerns promptly, and ensuring all outputs are quality\-checked and reviewed before use in governance.
   

  

 Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
   

  

**Role Type: Permanent
   

  

 Role Location: Bengaluru
   

  

 Work Hours: 7 AM to 4 PM**
**What will your day look like?**
 As an Analyst Technology Risk Intelligence, you will:
   

  

* Assisting with delivery of assigned tasks for prioritised insight routines and use\-cases by following defined procedures, checklists and templates
* Extracting, cleaning and reconciling data from approved sources, maintaining working files used for repeatable insight routines
* Refreshing dashboards and reporting packs by updating datasets, running refresh steps and completing quality checks, escalating anomalies before distribution
* Assisting with maintenance of approved automation (where authorized) by running scheduled steps, updating parameters and logging outcomes; escalating failures and access/tool issues promptly
* Support stakeholder requests by gathering data and evidence, documenting assumptions, ensuring traceability to source information, and assisting with governance pack preparation, including data compilation, formatting, proofreading, and draft narrative development
* Assisting with thematic reviews and events/issues analysis by collating data and evidence, preparing draft summaries and supporting basic trend/exceptions analysis under supervision
* Supporting uplift tracking routines (e.g., PACT\-aligned measures) by updating trackers, compiling evidence and preparing draft updates for review
* Operating as a developing analyst, building capability in data handling, dashboarding, documentation and risk concepts through coaching and on\-the\-job learning


**What will you bring?**
 To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
   

  

* Experience (or demonstrated capability) in an analyst/support role involving data, reporting, operations, risk, assurance or technology within a complex environment
* Basic analytical skills: ability to extract, organise and reconcile data and identify exceptions for review
* Exposure to reporting tools (e.g., Excel and/or Power BI) and ability to follow defined refresh and QA steps
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline, including evidence referencing and version control
* Clear written communication skills to draft simple summaries and status updates for review
* Tertiary qualifications (or working toward) in a relevant discipline (data/analytics, technology, cyber security, engineering, risk, or business/finance)


**Good To Have’ Knowledge, Skills And Experiences**
* Awareness of technology and cyber risk concepts and common control practices
* Exposure to basic automation (e.g., Excel Power Query) and/or simple scripting (SQL/Python) in a governed environment
* Experience maintaining trackers, logs and evidence packs for governance, audit or assurance activities


 You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**So why join us?**
 ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
   

  

 We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
   

  

 We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a highly motivated Performance Test Engineer with 2–4 years of experience in performance engineering and testing. * Collaborate with Architects, Developers, Infrastructure, and DevOps teams to troubleshoot and resolve performance issues.
* Integrate performance testing into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Harness, or similar DevOps tools.
* Support continuous performance engineering initiatives throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Participate in workload modeling, capacity planning, scalability, stress, endurance, and volume testing activities.
* Develop reusable automation utilities and frameworks to improve performance testing efficiency.

 Performance Engineering \-
   

  

* Hands\-on experience with Apache JMeter or similar performance testing tools.
* Strong understanding of:
* Load Testing
* Stress Testing
* Endurance (Soak) Testing
* Scalability Testing
* Volume Testing
* Workload Modeling
* Capacity Planning
* Experience defining, validating, and testing against Non\-Functional Requirements (NFRs).
* Experience preparing performance test reports, analysis, and recommendations.


**Qualifications \-**

* 2–4 years of hands\-on experience in Performance Testing and Performance Engineering.
* Hands\-on experience working with AWS\-based applications, Microservices, Apache Kafka, API Testing, Java/Python and distributed system architectures is mandatory.

title: Junior Consultant – Vulnerability Assessment, Penetration Testing & Red Teaming
description:
Location: Clearwater Pune, WFO
   

  

 Experience: 1–3 years
   

  

 Employment Type: Full\-time
   

  

 Department: Cybersecurity / Information Security
   

  

 Reporting To: Senior Consultant / Team Lead
   

  

**About The Role**
 Clearwater is looking for a Junior Consultant – Vulnerability Assessment, Penetration Testing (VAPT) \& Red Teaming to join our consulting services team.
   

  

 The role will support the delivery of vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, application and infrastructure security assessments, and red team engagements for clients across different technology environments. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in cybersecurity, networking, operating systems and common security testing methodologies, along with a willingness to continuously learn and develop offensive security skills.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Vulnerability Assessment \& Penetration Testing
   

  

* Assist in conducting vulnerability assessments and penetration tests across:
+ Web applications and APIs
+ Mobile applications
+ Network and infrastructure environments
+ Cloud environments
+ Internal and external networks
+ Wireless environments, where applicable

* Perform reconnaissance, enumeration, vulnerability identification and validation.
* Identify and safely validate security weaknesses using manual and automated techniques.
* Assist with exploitation and post\-exploitation activities under approved engagement scopes.
* Conduct security testing in accordance with established methodologies such as OWASP, PTES and NIST, as applicable.
* Analyse scan results and distinguish genuine vulnerabilities from false positives.


 Red Teaming
   

  

* Support red team and adversary simulation engagements under the guidance of senior team members.
* Assist with reconnaissance, attack\-path identification, initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement and other approved activities.
* Develop an understanding of adversary tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs), aligned with frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK and regulatory compliance requirements such as HIPAA, HITRUST, PCI DSS, SOC2, CMMC.
* Assist in evaluating security controls, detection capabilities and potential attack paths.
* Document technical findings with clear evidence and reproduction steps.
* Prepare professional vulnerability assessment, penetration testing and red team reports.
* Provide risk ratings, business impact and remediation recommendations for identified vulnerabilities.
* Maintain accurate POC, testing notes, evidence and supporting documentation.
* Participate in client discussions and technical walkthroughs
* Stay current with emerging vulnerabilities, exploits, attack techniques and cybersecurity trends.
* Research new tools, techniques and methodologies relevant to offensive security.
* Build and maintain practical skills through labs, CTFs and security research.
* Contribute to internal knowledge bases, testing methodologies and reusable security\-testing resources.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in cybersecurity, VAPT, security testing or a related technical role.
* Good understanding of:
+ Networking fundamentals and Windows and Linux operating systems
+ Web application architecture and common security vulnerabilities
+ Authentication, authorization and session management

title: Software Engineer in Test
description:
**About the Role** 




 Join the CX Testing team to validate the quality, performance, and scalability of every release from the customer's perspective. You'll own performance validation end to end — workload design, load/stress/endurance testing, bottleneck analysis, and root\-cause triage — across On\-prem and SaaS environments. We're looking for someone hands\-on and analytical who folds modern AI tooling (agents, LLMs) into the testing workflow to move faster.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design and execute load, stress, endurance, and scalability tests for new features and releases
* Build and maintain automated performance scripts (JMeter, Locust, Gatling, K6, or similar)
* Run API performance testing against REST endpoints and backend systems
* Analyse metrics, isolate bottlenecks, and deliver actionable recommendations to dev teams
* Establish baselines and track performance regressions across releases
* Integrate performance tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins / GitHub Actions)
* Drive performance triage and root\-cause analysis through to resolution
* Leverage AI agents and LLMs to accelerate test creation, log/metric analysis, and triage



  





**Must\-Have** 



* 4\+ years in performance or API testing only / UI and API Testing
* Load testing framework expertise (Locust/JMeter//Gatling/K6\) with Python or Java
* API testing proficiency — REST APIs, HTTP protocols, backend systems
* Strong Python or Java scripting skills
* CI/CD integration experience (Jenkins preferred)
* Performance analysis with observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus, etc)
* Working knowledge of AI tooling — agents and LLMs in a testing/analysis context
* Solid grasp of distributed systems, system architecture, and database context.
* Git/GitHub; cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)



  





**Nice\-to\-Have** 



* Load\-testing data/analytics platforms, databases
* Resource allocation management, reviewing logs, finding RCA.
* Reproducing and triaging real customer\-reported production issues

**Job Description**

* Report defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, configurations, and technical findings.
* Verify fixes and provide evidence\-based quality sign\-off.
* Contribute qualified tests to automated sanity and regression suites.
* Collaborate with globally distributed development, validation, and release teams.
* Improve test automation, diagnostics, reliability, and engineering productivity.
* Leverage AI\-assisted engineering tools responsibly for test design, coding, debugging, data analysis, and documentation activities.


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in software engineering, validation, system testing, quality assurance, or test automation.
* Strong programming skills in Python with hands\-on experience developing automated test solutions.
* Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining automated test frameworks.
* Good understanding of software testing methodologies, defect lifecycle management, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience working in Linux and Windows environments.
* Working knowledge of Git and GitHub development workflows.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development, testing, debugging, or engineering productivity tools.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, drive tasks to completion, and take ownership of validation activities.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with SSDs, flash storage, firmware, drivers, embedded systems, or system software.
* Knowledge of storage protocols such as NVMe, SCSI, or ATA.
* Experience with Python test frameworks, log analysis, and data\-driven testing methodologies.
* Familiarity with GitHub, Jira, Agile, Scrum, and Continuous Integration workflows.
* Working knowledge of C or C\+\+.
* Exposure to large\-scale automation environments and test infrastructure development.
* Experience using AI tools to improve software development, testing, or engineering productivity.


 What We Look For
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving and debugging abilities.
* Attention to detail and commitment to product quality.
* Curiosity to understand complex interactions between software, firmware, operating systems, and hardware.
* Ownership mindset from requirement analysis through validation sign\-off.
* Proactive mindset with a high level of accountability.
* Assertive communicator who can clearly and confidently express technical viewpoints while respecting others.
* Ability to challenge assumptions and make data\-driven decisions.
* Continuous learning attitude with interest in automation, AI\-assisted engineering, and emerging technologies.
* Strong collaboration skills across globally distributed teams.
* Confidence to take initiative, drive improvements, and deliver results

description:
**Build Autonomous Cloud Systems as a Site Reliability Engineer**
 Are you an early\-career engineer passionate about cloud security, site reliability, and automation? Trimble is seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (P1\) to join our Global AI Site Reliability \& Security Operations (AI\-SecOps) team. Operating across an enterprise Azure ecosystem of 22,000\+ Windows Virtual Machines and 3,000\+ Microsoft SQL Servers, you will combine SRE principles, Zero Trust architecture, and AI\-driven automation to ensure our systems remain secure, resilient, and highly available.
   

  

**About Us**
 Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose\-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
   

  

**Our SecOps \& SRE Ecosystem:** 
 Our AI\-SecOps team integrates cutting\-edge AI capabilities, automated patch orchestration, and DevSecOps pipelines to safeguard Trimble's enterprise infrastructure, ensuring compliance with global benchmarks while protecting global customer workflows.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Great**
 As a P1 Site Reliability Engineer, you will contribute directly to multi\-year cloud security roadmaps, autonomous patching workflows, and AI\-driven CVE remediation under the mentorship of senior engineering leadership. Supporting a follow\-the\-sun model across North America and India, you will gain hands\-on exposure to enterprise\-scale Azure governance, modern observability tooling, and automated deployment pipelines. This role is an ideal launchpad for an ambitious engineer looking to master cloud reliability at scale.
   

  

 Key Exciting Responsibilities
   

  

* Cloud Infrastructure Support: Support the reliability and security strategy across our Azure infrastructure footprint, assisting in maintaining system stability and performance metrics.
* Windows \& SQL Server Operations: Help apply enterprise security configurations, patching standards, and operational guidelines across 22,000\+ Windows VMs and 3,000\+ SQL Servers.
* Patch Orchestration \& Troubleshooting: Participate in global patch deployment workflows (using tools like Azure Update Manager, NinjaOne, SCCM/MECM, WSUS, PatchMyPC, ManageEngine, or Ivanti) to prevent deployment failures.
* Azure Governance \& Security: Assist with Azure landing zone policies, RBAC access controls, Web Application Firewall (WAF) rule sets, and Zero Trust security protocols.
* Vulnerability Analysis \& Remediation: Execute routine CVE scans across platforms (Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, Defender), utilizing AI tools and scripts for triage and automated patch deployment.
* Automation \& Scripting: Write and maintain scripts in PowerShell, Python, or Terraform to automate administrative tasks, continuous integration gates, and operational runbooks.
* Incident Response \& Collaboration: Support incident triage and root\-cause analysis (RCA) activities while collaborating closely with engineering teams in North America and India.


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Experience: 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in cloud technical support, systems administration, DevOps, or site reliability engineering.
* Cloud \& Security Foundations: Fundamental understanding of Microsoft Azure, Azure Active Directory/Entra ID, RBAC, and basic cloud networking/security concepts.
* Scripting \& Automation: Introductory to intermediate skills in PowerShell or Python for task automation and system scripting.
* OS \& Systems Familiarity: Basic administration knowledge of Windows Server environments and familiarity with relational database management systems like MS SQL Server.
* Analytical Mindset: Strong problem\-solving aptitude, meticulous attention to detail, and a desire to learn modern AI\-assisted engineering practices.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.


**Bonus Points For**
* Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ\-900\), Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\), or CompTIA Security\+.
* Infrastructure as Code: Exposure to enterprise IaC tools such as Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps pipelines.
* Vulnerability Management: Familiarity with CVSS scoring, patch management platforms, or common vulnerability scanning tools.


**Logistics**
* Grade / Level: P1 (Entry Level)
* Department: Global AI Site Reliability \& Security Operations (AI\-SecOps)
* Location: Chennai
* Job Type: Full\-Time


 Why You'll Love Working With Us
   

  

 At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real\-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
   

  

* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose\-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* Collaborate with like\-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
