* Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.


****How to Apply:****
 Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.
   

  

**Join a Values\-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**
 At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

title: Engineer I - Cloud Support Engineer
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting\-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.
   

  

 Want to learn AWS by running it at a Tier 1 financial firm? As Engineer 1, Cloud Support Engineer, you'll be first on the ticket — triaging requests, running runbooks, and shadowing incidents — with senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Support right beside you and a clear certification path to Engineer 2\. If you're hungry to grow into a serious cloud engineer with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 As the Engineer 1, Cloud Support Engineer, you are a hands\-on entry\-level cloud operations engineer in the Support team within LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE) — the run\-the\-cloud function for LPL's AWS multi\-account landing zone. Under close guidance from senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Support, you triage inbound tickets from application teams across Jira and ServiceNow, execute runbooks, fulfill well\-scoped account / IAM / access requests, and act as a supported first\-line responder in the 24x7 on\-call rotation. You partner with the Monitoring pod within Foundations on alerting and runbooks, and you escalate cleanly to Engineer 2s and above when work is beyond your current scope. LPL is an AWS\-first CCOE: a multi\-account landing zone with 100\+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60\+ AWS services, delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands\-on and learning — progressing along the Engineer 1 certification path (AWS Cloud Practitioner, Terraform Associate, KCNA) toward Engineer 2 — across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Triage inbound tickets from application teams across Jira and ServiceNow against clear SLAs under guidance: own well\-scoped Tier 1 requests end\-to\-end and escalate cleanly to Engineer 2s, AVPs, and the VP, Support when work is beyond your current scope
* Fulfill well\-scoped account / IAM / access requests using the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) and the private Terraform module library, following established runbooks
* Execute runbooks for known incident classes and help keep them accurate; partner with the Monitoring pod within Foundations to capture what you learn
* Support change\-management execution: change\-window participation and ServiceNow change\-record discipline under senior review
* Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self\-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities in your day\-to\-day support work: AI\-assisted ticket triage, runbook lookup and generation, MCP\-driven self\-service for common account / IAM / access requests, and on\-call copilots that summarize telemetry during incidents
* Operate as a hands\-on entry\-level cloud engineer under close guidance: spend the majority of your time on well\-scoped Terraform changes, AWS console / CLI tasks, ticket and runbook execution, and shadowing incident response — building core cloud skills is the primary focus
* Participate in 24x7 on\-call rotations as a supported first\-line responder, following runbooks and escalating early to Engineer 2s, AVPs, and VPs
* Consume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship small, well\-scoped changes; raise focused pull requests that a senior engineer reviews before merge
* Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and write down what you learn
* Apply the AWS Well\-Architected Framework to the work you touch under senior guidance
* Participate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master
* Pursue and maintain the Engineer 1 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\), and Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA) — progressing toward Engineer 2 over time


 What are we looking for?
   

  

 We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 1\+ years of technical experience in cloud, infrastructure, or software engineering (internship / co\-op / bootcamp experience counts); Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* Foundational AWS exposure and a demonstrated willingness to learn Terraform in a private module ecosystem delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions
* Demonstrated ability to complete well\-scoped technical tasks under guidance, with reliable follow\-through and a strong learning mindset
* Willingness to participate in 24x7 production on\-call rotations as a supported first\-line responder in a fast\-paced, security\-conscious environment (financial services preferred)
* Familiarity with an ITSM / ticketing workflow (Jira, ServiceNow, or comparable) and a strong customer\-service orientation toward application teams


**Core Competencies**
* Strong growth mindset — actively pursues the Engineer 1 certifications in the CCOE certification matrix and treats every ticket and incident as a learning loop
* Highly coachable; acts on feedback and improves quickly
* Asks for help early rather than struggling alone, and documents what they learn for the next engineer
* Reliable, careful execution on well\-scoped work
* Continuous learner in cloud\-native, IaC, and applied AI
* Builds trusting relationships with peer engineers across the US and India / GCC
* Clear written and verbal communication in tickets and pull requests


**Preferences**
* On the Engineer 1 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
* On the Engineer 1 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\)
* On the Engineer 1 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
* Exposure to agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) in day\-to\-day work
* Scripting exposure in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across the US and India / GCC

* Instrument the pipeline with traces and metrics, including per\-turn latency breakdowns (ASR → LLM → TTS)
* Chase down tail latency, jitter, and dropped sessions


**What We're Looking For**
* 1\+ years writing backend code that ran in production — internships and substantial side projects count
* Solid in at least one of Go, Rust, or Python
* Working knowledge of Docker; comfortable with Kubernetes or keen to get there fast
* Some exposure to Redis and to observability tooling like Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry
* Genuine interest in real\-time systems, where latency is a correctness problem rather than a nice\-to\-have


**Nice to have**
* WebRTC, SIP/telephony, RTP, Opus
* LiveKit, Pion, or any streaming media work
* Anything you've shipped that had to stay up

description:

 Viscadia is a premier global forecasting firm that empowers the life sciences industry with clarity and confidence. Our team of specialists builds custom forecasting solutions, conducts targeted market research, and provides comprehensive cycle support to optimize decision\-making. Since our founding in 2010, we've assembled industry\-leading experts with decades of experience, establishing Viscadia as a trusted partner to many of the largest global life sciences companies. Our success is built on core values of Resilience (working effectively as a team), Innovation (continuously improving customer experience), Shared Success (recognizing collective achievement), and Excellence (embedding servant leadership throughout our organization).
 



  





 We are seeking an Associate Consultant to join our India team based in Gurgaon. This role at Viscadia offers an opportunity to work at the intersection of software development, healthcare analytics, and consulting. You will contribute to the design, development, and enhancement of modern web applications and digital platforms used to support pharmaceutical forecasting and analytics. Through hands\-on project work and collaboration with cross\-functional teams, you will deepen your technical expertise, develop an understanding of pharmaceutical business needs, and build a strong foundation for a consulting career.
 



  





**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Technical Responsibilities** 



* Design, deploy, and manage scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure primarily on AWS.
* Build and maintain cloud\-native solutions using services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, ECS/EKS, Lambda, CloudFront, Route53, API Gateway, and CloudWatch.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform and AWS CloudFormation.

* Design and manage containerized workloads using Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes (EKS).
* Configure and maintain cloud networking components, including VPCs, subnets, load balancers, security groups, VPNs, and connectivity solutions.
* Implement cloud security best practices, including identity and access management, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability remediation, and compliance controls.
* Monitor cloud environments using tools such as CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and centralized logging solutions to ensure system reliability and performance.
* Automate operational tasks, environment provisioning, system maintenance, and incident response processes using Python and cloud\-native automation tools.
* Optimize infrastructure utilization and cloud spending through performance tuning, resource right\-sizing, and cost\-management initiatives.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across infrastructure, networking, deployment pipelines, and cloud services.

* Contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement by mentoring junior team members and helping codify best practices in forecasting and business analytics
* Grow into a client\-facing role, combining an understanding of commercial strategy with forecasting expertise to lead engagements and drive value for clients



**Skills \& Technical Proficiencies** 




**Technical Skills** 



* Strong programming skills in Python, with experience building backend applications, automation scripts, APIs, and cloud\-native solutions.
* Proficient in SQL for data extraction, transformation, optimization, and integration with enterprise applications.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS Cloud Services, including services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM, ECS/EKS, and related cloud\-native technologies.
* Working knowledge of other cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is preferred.
* Experience designing, developing, and maintaining REST APIs, microservices, and serverless applications.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, source control systems (Git), and DevOps practices for automated deployments.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Experience working with containerization technologies such as Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes is a plus.
* Understanding of cloud security, networking concepts, monitoring, logging, and performance optimization.
* Exposure to modern web technologies and full\-stack application development is desirable.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues in distributed cloud environments.



**Soft Skills** 



* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving abilities, with a structured and solution\-oriented mindset
* Demonstrated ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross\-functional teams
* Adaptable and proactive, with a willingness to thrive in a dynamic, fast\-growing environment
* Genuine passion for consulting, with a focus on delivering tangible business value for clients



**Domain Expertise (Good To Have)** 



* Strong understanding of pharmaceutical commercial models, including treatment journeys, market dynamics, and key therapeutic areas
* Experience working with and interpreting industry\-standard datasets such as IQVIA, Symphony Health, or similar secondary data sources
* Familiarity with product lifecycle management, market access considerations, and sales performance tracking metrics used across the pharmaceutical value chain



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree (B.Tech/B.E.) from a premier engineering institute, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or related disciplines
* 2\+ years of experience in cloud engineering, data engineering, or software development, with a strong focus on AWS\-based solutions.



  





**Benefits**

To support your transition, we also provide relocation assistance and reimbursement for moving closer to our office location. In addition, Gratuity, as applicable, is paid in accordance with The Payment of Gratuity Act, over \& above the CTC.

* Generous Leave policy: Our leave framework includes, but is not limited to, Sick leave, casual leave, earned leave, bereavement leave, maternity \& paternity leave – ensuring you have the flexibility and support you need at different stages of life.
* Global Exposure \& Collaborative Culture: Work in a high\-impact, intellectually stimulating environment that values collaboration, diversity, and continuous learning. You will have opportunities to engage with global clients, cross\-functional teams, and industry thought leaders across geographies.
* Career Development \& Growth Pathways: At Viscadia, your growth is our priority. We offer structured career development programs, leadership training, and opportunities to expand your expertise through global projects, conferences, and innovation initiatives.
* Viscadia is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

title: DevOps Engineer II
description:
**About Neo** 




  





 AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value.
 **Neo** 
 is changing that.
 



 Founded by
 **Bhavin Turakhia**
 — Co\-Founder of
 
 Zeta
 
 ,
 
 Radix
 
 , and
 
 Titan
 
 —
 **Neo** 
 is building an integrated, AI\-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first\-class participant in every workflow:
 


* **Tasket** 
 — A radically reimagined, AI\-native, work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.
* **Friday** 
 — AI Assistant, co\-worker and agent platform, pre\-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000\+ SaaS platforms.
* **Studio** 
 — AI\-native suite for co\-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.
* **Drive** 
 — AI\-native repository, where humans and agents can co\-work on files.
* **Scribe** 
 — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note\-taking and actually does your work while on the call.



  





**About the Role** 




 As a DevOps Engineer, you will build and operate the infrastructure and delivery platform behind the Neo suite — cloud, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and the path to production — working closely with senior engineers who set the architecture and standards.
 



 We are proponents of leveraging best\-in\-breed AI tools at every step of the engineering lifecycle — design, development, review, and testing. This requires a different engineering mindset: a lean team of hands\-on, AI\-adept engineers, resulting in ultra\-rapid iteration cycles and fast output. You will apply this approach every day, using agents to move faster while owning the quality of what ships.
 



 At Neo, the platform serves both people and a growing fleet of agents shipping change in parallel. This role is for an engineer with strong fundamentals who wants real production ownership and a steep learning curve.
 



  





**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Cloud \& infrastructure** 



* Build, operate, and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS/GCP/Azure, following the architecture and security standards set by the team.
* Write and maintain infrastructure as code with Terraform; contribute to reusable modules and keep an eye on cost and performance.



**Delivery \& GitOps** 



* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines as code; improve build speed, reliability, and quality checks on the path to production.
* Operate GitOps\-based deployments with Argo CD / Flux, and run rolling, canary, and blue\-green releases.



**Containers \& Kubernetes** 



* Deploy, run, and troubleshoot workloads on production Kubernetes — manifests and Helm charts, ingress (NGINX/Kong), autoscaling, and resource tuning.



**AI\-first delivery** 



* Use agentic tooling day to day to write, review, and test infrastructure code and automation — and validate what agents produce before it ships.
* Contribute to the guardrails and CI quality gates (linting, policy checks, plan reviews, scanning) that let engineers and agents ship safely.



**Reliability \& observability** 



* Set up and maintain dashboards, alerts, logs, and traces for the services you support.
* Participate in on\-call; triage and resolve incidents, and contribute to root\-cause analysis and follow\-up fixes.



**Security \& automation** 



* Apply cloud security best practices — least\-privilege IAM, secrets management, and image and dependency scanning.
* Write scripts and small tools in Python, Go, or Bash to automate repetitive operational work; document runbooks and share what you learn.



  





**Skills** 



* **AI\-native engineering practice** 
 — Uses agentic tooling across the lifecycle and builds the reusable modules, automation, and CI quality gates that make both human and agent\-authored infrastructure change safe to ship.
* **Systems \& networking** 
 — Solid Linux fundamentals (processes, filesystems, permissions, systemd, logs) and networking basics (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/TLS, load balancing, subnets and routing); comfortable debugging from the command line.
* **Cloud** 
 — Hands\-on with at least one major cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure): compute, VPC networking, IAM, storage, and managed databases.
* **Containers \& Kubernetes** 
 — Docker and image builds; hands\-on with Kubernetes objects (Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps/Secrets, HPA) and Helm or Kustomize.
* **CI/CD \& GitOps** 
 — Has built or maintained pipelines in tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins; working exposure to Argo CD or Flux.
* **Infrastructure as Code** 
 — Terraform (modules, remote state, plan/apply workflows); Ansible a plus.
* **Observability** 
 — Working knowledge of metrics, logging, and tracing tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, OpenTelemetry); can use them to debug a live issue.
* **Security basics** 
 — IAM, secrets management (e.g. Vault or cloud secret managers), and secure CI/CD practices.
* **On\-call \& Incident Response** 
 — Experience in an on\-call rotation or hands\-on incident response.
* **Programming \& automation** 
 — Writes clean, reviewable Python, Go, or Bash for automation and tooling.



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 



* 2\+ years of relevant experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or related roles.
* Software engineers with a bent towards Operations engineering or vice versa.
* Solid fundamentals in Linux/OS internals, networking, and system performance.
* Hands\-on experience with public or private cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar).
* Good understanding of distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proven experience with modern CI/CD practices, GitOps workflows, and deployment strategies.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and configuration management using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Programming or scripting proficiency in Python, Go, or Bash.
* Has been part of a production on\-call rotation and has participated in incident response.
* Continuous learner with a strong ownership mindset and effective engineering practices.
* B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science or equivalent.



  





**Equal Opportunity** 




 Neo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.

LPL is an AWS\-first CCOE: a multi\-account landing zone with 100\+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60\+ AWS services, all delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You partner with the Platforms and Containers teams, the Support team, and the Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), and you spend the majority of your time hands\-on in Terraform and delivery work across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC) — leaving the teams you help able to run what you built together.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Deliver white\-glove cloud delivery support during Experience\-Based Acceleration (EBA / SBA) and other acceleration events — embedding with application teams to land workloads on AWS quickly and correctly
* Partner with less\-funded / lean application teams to deliver their applications to the cloud: reference\-architecture guidance, hands\-on Terraform, and pairing that leaves the team able to run what you built together
* Engineer Infrastructure\-as\-Code solutions that operationalize AWS services — turning a raw AWS capability into a paved, reusable path consumable through the private Terraform module library
* Operationalize third\-party systems on AWS (for example, Confluent Kafka and Kong) as Terraform\-managed, supportable building blocks with clear runbooks and hand\-off to the Support and Containers teams
* Support migrations of application workloads into the multi\-account landing zone — coordinating cutover, validation, and hand\-off
* Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self\-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities to accelerate delivery: AI\-assisted Terraform authoring and refactoring, reference\-pattern scaffolding, migration discovery and documentation, and MCP\-driven self\-service so the teams you help can keep moving after you rotate off
* Operate as a hands\-on mid\-level cloud engineer in the pod: spend the majority of your time in Terraform code, AWS console / CLI, design documents, peer code review, and incident response — execution and growth are the primary leverage points
* Personally participate in 24x7 on\-call rotations as a primary responder for production incidents within the pod's scope; grow into senior responder framing over time with support from AVPs and VPs
* Consume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship application\-aligned infrastructure; raise small, well\-scoped pull requests against shared modules and the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) foundational base layer to improve what you use
* Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and pass what you learn on to peers
* Apply the AWS Well\-Architected Framework in the work you touch and drive continuous improvement against operational, security, reliability, performance, cost, and sustainability outcomes
* Participate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master and partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on delivery commitments and dependencies
* Pursue and maintain the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Developer – Associate, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\), Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA), and Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) — progressing toward Senior Engineer over time


 What are we looking for?
   

  

 We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of progressive technical experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or software engineering; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* 1\+ years of hands\-on production AWS in a multi\-account environment with hands\-on production Terraform delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions; comfort consuming a private Terraform module library and raising well\-scoped pull requests against shared modules
* Demonstrated track record of owning meaningful, well\-scoped engineering work end\-to\-end under senior guidance — design, implementation, code review participation, and follow\-through
* Experience participating in 24x7 production on\-call rotations as a primary responder in a fast\-paced, security\-conscious environment (financial services preferred)
* Hands\-on experience delivering application workloads to AWS in a consulting, professional\-services, or platform\-delivery capacity — including Infrastructure\-as\-Code delivery and, ideally, operationalizing a managed AWS service or a third\-party system (e.g., Kafka, Kong, or similar) as reusable IaC


**Core Competencies**
* Strong growth mindset — actively pursues the Engineer 2 certifications in the CCOE certification matrix and uses each incident, code review, and design discussion as a learning loop
* Bias toward shipping high\-quality, well\-tested, code\-reviewed work; leaves the codebase a little better than they found it
* Asks for help early when stuck and writes down what they learn for the next engineer
* Calm primary responder during incidents; pages an AVP or VP early rather than struggling alone
* Continuous learner in cloud\-native, IaC, and applied AI
* Builds high\-trust relationships with peer engineers across the US and India / GCC
* Excellent written and verbal communication; can articulate what they changed and why in a clear pull request description


**Preferences**
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: AWS Certified Developer – Associate
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* Experience using agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) in day\-to\-day engineering work
* Strong scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across the US and India / GCC
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CCP) as a stepping stone toward Developer – Associate

title: System Engineer, GIOC
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Vultr is on a mission to make high\-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3\.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self\-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately\-held cloud infrastructure company.
   

  

**Vultr Cares**
* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company\-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy \+ 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years \+ Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription


**Join Vultr**
 Vultr is expanding its India presence and is building its first
 **Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai** 
 — the 24x7 nerve center for monitoring, triage, and first response across Vultr’s global
 **cloud, systems, network, and security operations.**
 We are seeking
 **Systems Engineers** 
 to serve as the first line of response for Vultr’s systems estate —
 **compute, storage, operating systems, and virtualization.** 
 This is a frontline operations role for engineers who thrive in a fast\-paced, alert\-driven environment and want to grow into deeper SRE, systems, and platform engineering careers. You must be comfortable working on a rotational shift model (24x7\) — including nights, weekends, and holidays, to ensure we have full coverage.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The
 **Systems Engineer** 
 is the entry point of the GIOC incident lifecycle. You monitor health signals across Vultr’s systems estate, acknowledge and triage alerts within
 **defined first\-response SLAs,** 
 execute documented runbooks to resolve common issues, and escalate cleanly to Senior Systems Engineer when an issue falls outside L1 scope. The role ensures
 **fast, accurate first response** 
 that protects customer experience and keeps incidents moving toward resolution.
   

  

 You operate from a
 **consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard** 
 , classifying and routing incidents by severity and tower while owning accurate, complete documentation of every action. Success is measured by
 **first\-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate.** 
 The role runs on a
 **rotational schedule** 
 to sustain 24x7 coverage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Alert Monitoring \& First Response**
* Monitor systems\-estate health signals (compute, storage, OS, virtualization) from a consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard
* Acknowledge alerts and incidents within first\-response SLA targets
* Perform initial review — read the alert, check recent changes, and review the CMDB before acting


**Triage \& Severity Classification**
* Classify each incident by severity and customer impact, confirming the owning tower (Systems / Network / Security / cross\-tower)
* Route and assign tickets accurately to the correct tower or escalation path
* Sustain triage accuracy at or above the GIOC go\-live standard
* Reassess severity as impact evolves, and declare higher when in doubt


**Runbook\-Driven Resolution**
* Match alert signatures to documented runbooks and execute permitted L1 actions
* Resolve common, well\-understood systems issues end to end within L1 scope
* Document every step taken, with supporting evidence, in the incident ticket


**Escalation \& Handoff**
* Escalate unresolved or out\-of\-scope issues to Senior Engineers with a clean, complete handoff (symptom
* evidence collected
* steps tried
* current state)
* Flag missing or ineffective runbooks as runbook gaps for review and continuous improvement
* Initiate and support major\-incident (Sev\-0 / Sev\-1\) bridges per the escalation matrix
* Track escalations to closure and confirm service is restored before resolving the ticket


**Operational Documentation \& Communication**
* Maintain accurate shift logs, ticket updates, and incident timelines
* Provide clear, timely status communication to stakeholders and customers per severity
* Produce thorough shift\-handover notes for seamless continuity


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring alerts and noise as candidates for tuning and automation
* Contribute to and improve runbooks and knowledge\-base articles
* Participate in post\-incident reviews (PIR) and trend reviews


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Graduate/Engineer in a relevant field (B.E./B.Tech, or equivalent)
* 3–5 years of experience in systems administration, preferably in NOC/SOC, or IT operations
* Good understanding of Linux/Windows
* Working knowledge of operating systems — processes, services, and log analysis (Linux/Windows)
* Familiarity with compute, storage, and virtualization concepts — VMs, Hypervisors, and basic networking
* Understanding of incident\-management fundamentals and severity\-based triage
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools and ticketing systems (alerting consoles, ITSM)
* Strong written communication for accurate documentation and clean escalation handoffs; willingness and ability to work a rotational 24x7 shift model, including nights, weekends, and holidays
* Proficient in English verbal and written communication


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL V4 Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge
* Linux certification (RHCSA / LFCS) or a cloud\-fundamentals certification
* Scripting familiarity (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for routine automation
* Exposure to cloud platforms and GPU / high\-density infrastructure
* Prior working experience in a 24x7 NOC, SOC or Command\-Center environment
* Experience in using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, PagerDuty, and observability platforms


**Inclusion \& Privacy**
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
   

  

 We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023\. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
   

  

 Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

title: Associate Technology Risk Intelligence
description:
**About Us**
**Standard**
 At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Associate, Technology Risk Intelligence in our Risk, Group Technology team, you’ll support the Technology Risk Intelligence practice to deliver trusted, repeatable and decision\-useful risk insights and AI\-enabled outputs that strengthen the Risk, Group Technology team’s ability to provide clear, data\-led risk insight and challenge.
   

  

 Working under the guidance of the Senior Manager and in partnership with Risk Managers and other team members, you will help deliver monitoring and analytics across material Technology and Information Security (Cyber) risk themes, support thematic reviews, events/issue analysis and governance, and contribute to evidence collation, indicator analysis and synthesis of key risk insights. This role has a developing scope, with lower autonomy and a strong focus on learning, execution discipline and quality delivery.
   

  

 Using approved automation and AI\-enabled tooling (where authorised), you will support the development and enhancement of automated insight products (dashboards, repeatable insight analysis, trend synthesis and first\-draft packs), while maintaining strong data governance, privacy/security controls, and clear human accountability. Partnering with Risk specialists across the team, you will contribute to the evolution of technology and cyber risk appetite, metrics and oversight priorities through analysis, documentation and timely escalation of material concerns for review.
   

  

 This role may also provide support for oversight of international jurisdictions, partnering (as directed) with country risk officers to provide Line 2 technology and information security support as part of a matrixed Line 2 oversight model
   

  

 Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
   

  

**Role Type: Permanent
   

  

 Role Location: Bengaluru
   

  

 Work Hours: 7 AM to 4 PM**
**What will your day look like?**
 As an Associate Technology Risk Intelligence , you will:
   

  

* Supporting the Senior Manager and Risk Managers to deliver prioritized insight use\-cases aligned to risk appetite, Board/ExCo metrics and material risk themes
* Applying agreed standards for insight definitions, metric calculations, data quality and reproducibility to support consistent governance decisions and auditability
* Building and maintaining insight assets (datasets, definitions, lineage notes, dashboards and briefing packs) that provide timely, trusted insight on control effectiveness, resilience outcomes, risk\-in\-change and remediation progress
* Supporting repeatable insight routines (e.g., indicator analysis, trend synthesis, evidence collation and first\-draft packs) using approved automation and AI\-enabled tooling (where authorized), with appropriate controls, QA and clear human accountability
* Providing hands\-on analytical support for independent oversight, review and challenge activities across Technology domains and cross\-cutting disciplines, including preparing analysis, summarizing evidence and drafting commentary
* Working with Technology Risk leaders and stakeholders to support risk measurement and governance narrative through indicator analysis, threshold monitoring and interpretation of trends
* Preparing draft insight packs and dashboard views that link metrics to material risk themes, decisions required and recommended actions for review by Managers and Senior Managers
* Supporting PACT\-aligned NFR uplift through monitoring and analytics that inform Line 2 oversight priorities and escalation
* Operating as a developing professional within the team, demonstrating analytical discipline, documentation quality and responsible tool use
* Coordinating with Technology, Cyber, Risk, Data and Internal Audit stakeholders on agreed analytics, definitions, thresholds and evidence expectations to improve consistency and reduce duplication


**What will you bring?**
 To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
   

  

* Experience in technology/cyber risk, operational risk, assurance, analytics or a related discipline within a complex regulated environment
* Sound analytical and data skills, including working with datasets, applying defined metrics/KRIs, and translating analysis into clear risk observations and insights
* Experience supporting repeatable insight products such as dashboards, packs or reporting routines, with attention to data quality, definitions and lineage
* Foundational understanding of technology and cyber controls and resilience concepts to support credible analysis and interpretation of indicators
* Exposure to automation and AI\-enabled workflows (e.g., Copilot/LLM agents) and an understanding of governance, controls and human accountability requirements.
* Good written communication skills to prepare concise, governance\-ready materials and clear stakeholder messaging under guidance
* Ability to work effectively in a matrixed model, manage assigned tasks and priorities, and collaborate across teams and geographies
* Demonstrated willingness to learn and build expertise across regions, governance requirements and consistent Group standards
* Working knowledge of APRA standards relevant to technology and cyber (e.g., CPS 230, CPS 234\) and associated evidence expectations
* Exposure to data science, analytics engineering or automation techniques in a governed enterprise setting
* Experience with risk tooling and platforms (GRC, issue/action management, control testing, service management) and common integration patterns


 You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**So why join us?**
 ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
   

  

 We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
   

  

 We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
   

  

 To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number
 **124088\.**

description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Security Consultant owning VAPT and Red Teaming engagements across infrastructure, network, web, mobile, API, thick\-client, cloud and AI/LLM environments. The role involves identifying and exploiting security weaknesses, simulating real\-world adversary techniques, developing proof\-of\-concept exploits, documenting findings and providing clear remediation guidance to technical and business stakeholders. The consultant will also support purple\-team activities, mentor junior resources and contribute to offensive security capability development.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing across infrastructure, network, web, mobile (Android/iOS), API, thick\-client and cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP).
* Identify, validate and document vulnerabilities using manual testing techniques and automated security tools; develop PoCs to demonstrate exploitability.
* Conduct database security testing and configuration reviews across MySQL, Oracle and NoSQL platforms.
* Plan, execute and document Red Team engagements simulating real\-world threat actor TTPs mapped to MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Execute attack chains covering initial access, lateral movement, privilege escalation and data exfiltration.
* Conduct Active Directory exploitation, phishing/social\-engineering campaigns and endpoint security bypass exercises.
* Use and adapt adversary\-emulation tools and frameworks such as Cobalt Strike, Metasploit and Caldera.
* Collaborate with Blue Teams during purple\-team exercises to validate and improve detection and response capabilities.
* Perform security testing of AI/ML and LLM\-based applications, including prompt injection, jailbreak, model extraction and adversarial\-input testing.
* Apply relevant AI security frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS to identify AI\-specific risks.
* Prepare detailed technical reports covering assessment methodology, vulnerabilities, severity, evidence, PoCs and remediation recommendations.
* Present security findings and risk implications clearly to technical teams, management and business stakeholders.
* Stay current with emerging vulnerabilities, APT techniques, malware trends and offensive\-security research and incorporate relevant techniques into assessments.
* Mentor junior consultants on penetration\-testing tools, techniques and methodologies and contribute to internal security capability building.


**Mandatory Qualifications**
* 3–6 years of hands\-on experience in VAPT, Red Teaming and Application Security, including client\-facing or security advisory exposure.
* Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, OSSTMM, NIST and CIS security frameworks.
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including OSI and TCP/IP, and network/infrastructure security.
* Hands\-on experience with penetration\-testing and vulnerability\-assessment tools such as Burp Suite Pro, Nessus, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Nikto, ZAP and MobSF.
* Ability to perform manual penetration testing beyond automated scanner capabilities.
* Working experience with scripting and exploit development using Python, Bash or PowerShell.
* Working knowledge of security assessment across AWS, Azure and/or GCP environments.
* Strong analytical, technical documentation, report\-writing and client communication skills.
* BE/B.Tech/MCA or equivalent qualification.
* Ability to communicate security risks and remediation requirements effectively with technical and business stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* OSCP, OSCE, CRTP, eWPTX, CREST\-CRT or Security\+ certification.
* Hands\-on exposure to AI/LLM security testing and frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS.
* Experience with advanced Red Teaming and adversary\-emulation techniques.
* Exposure to Active Directory exploitation, phishing/social engineering and endpoint bypass techniques.
* Experience participating in purple\-team engagements and working with Blue/SOC teams.


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Software Engineer Product Security
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Summary:**
 As a Software Engineer – Product Security, you will be part of a team responsible for helping ensure Rockwell Automation products are designed, developed, and maintained using industry\-leading secure development practices.
   

  

 You will work closely with software development teams, architects, product security engineers, and DevSecOps teams to implement security capabilities, address vulnerabilities, automate security workflows, and improve the overall security posture of our products.
   

  

 You will provide opportunities to contribute across the software development lifecycle, from design and implementation through testing, deployment and maintenance.
   

  

 You are a collaborative engineer who enjoys solving technical problems, learning new technologies, and working with globally distributed teams.
   

  

 In addition to software engineering fundamentals, you have an interest in cybersecurity, secure software development, cloud technologies, and new AI\-assisted development practices.
   

  

 You will report to the SENIOR MANAGER, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING and have a hybrid schedule working in
 **Bangalore or Pune, India.**
**Your Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, test, and maintain software components, services, and tools supporting product security programmes.
* Apply secure coding practices and security\-by\-design principles throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Participate in feature design, implementation, testing, and deployment activities.
* Support threat modelling, security reviews, vulnerability remediation, and risk mitigation efforts.
* Develop automation solutions that improve security, compliance, and engineering productivity.
* Contribute to cloud\-native, web, desktop, or distributed application development.
* Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate security requirements into product designs and implementations.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects, performance issues, and security findings.
* Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, test plans, and engineering artefacts.
* Support DevSecOps projects by integrating security tooling into CI/CD pipelines.
* Use Generative AI tools responsibly to improve software development efficiency, code quality, testing, documentation, and engineering workflows.
* Learn and stay current with latest technologies, cybersecurity threats, software engineering practices, and AIdriven development methodologies.


**The Essentials \- You Will Have**
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 2\+ years of software development experience.
* Product Security \& DevSecOps Knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices.
* Understanding of common software vulnerabilities and mitigations (OWASP Top 10, CWE, secure coding practices).
* Familiarity with threat modelling concepts and security risk assessments.
* Experience developing software using one or more modern programming languages such as C\#, C\+\+, Java, Python, Go, or TypeScript.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.


**The Preferred \- You Might Also Have**
* Experience developing software for cloud, web, desktop, or distributed systems.
* Experience with object\-oriented design principles, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
* Experience with TypeScript, Node.js, Angular, React, GraphQL, or similar technologies.
* Experience developing software on Windows or Linux platforms.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, microservices, containers, and cloud\-native architectures.
* Experience with Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and security protocols.
* Understanding of security frameworks and standards such as IEC 62443, NIST SSDF, CRA, NIS2, or similar industry standards.
* Generative AI \& Modern Engineering Practices
* Experience using Generative AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar platforms to improve engineering productivity.
* Understanding of AI\-assisted software development, prompt engineering, code generation, automated testing, and documentation workflows.
* Exposure to AI/ML concepts, LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, or AI\-enabled developer tooling.
* Evaluate AI\-generated outputs for quality, security, maintainability, and compliance with secure development standards.


**What We Offer**
 Our benefits package includes …
   

  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!


*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
 Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Engineer II – SIEM Integrations
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
   

  

****About The Role:****
 Get Data In (GDI) Integrations Content team at Next Gen\-SIEM is responsible for building out of the box integrations for 3rd party products to ingest and parse data into SIEM platform. We are looking for a passionate Security Engineer with expertise in data ingestion and integration for SIEM. This role focuses on designing, developing, and maintaining out of the box data connectors for CrowdStrike Next\-Gen SIEM, ensuring seamless ingestion of security data from various third\-party products.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has hands\-on experience in cybersecurity, data ingestion pipelines, log collection mechanisms, and security event processing. You should be well\-versed in industry\-standard data ingestion and integration methods and possess strong knowledge about security products and platform
   

  

******What You'll Do:******
* Evaluate, develop, maintain, and enhance data connectors and parsers to ingest data from third\-party security products into CrowdStrike Next\-Gen SIEM
* Set up and maintain a lab or test environment for security products to validate data connectors and troubleshoot issues
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues with existing data connectors to ensure reliable log ingestion
* Collaborate with internal teams to define efficient logging, error handling, data normalization and documentation for data connectors
* Research and implement best practices for ingesting security logs from Firewalls, IDS/IPS, Cloud Security products, Endpoint Security, and other security products and platforms
* Write and maintain high\-quality technical documentation for integration methods and troubleshooting guides
* Provide on\-call support for critical data ingestion issues and production incidents
* Work with customers, customer success and customer support teams to troubleshoot and resolve data ingestion\-related issues and ensure effective communication


******What You'll Need:******
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent work experience.
* 4\+ years of experience in cybersecurity and SIEM integrations
* Experience in developing data connectors or ingestion pipelines for SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Sentinel, Exabeam, QRadar etc.
* Experience in security data normalization schemas, parsing and data enrichment
* Experience in setting up and managing environments for security products such as Firewalls, IDS/IPS, EDR, CASB, Identity Security, Email Security etc.
* Experience with security events and its formats such as Syslog, CEF, LEEF, JSON, XML
* Working knowledge of log processing or shipping tools such as Cribl, Splunk forwarder, Azure monitoring agent, LogScale log collector etc.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language, preferably Python or Go
* Strong documentation, communication and customer interaction skills
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision\-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.


******Bonus Points:******
* Knowledge with cloud\-native logging services such as AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, or GCP Logging

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
**Job Description**

 Job Summary :
   

  





 Specialists play a crucial role in ensuring smooth and efficient support of day\-to\-day operations. They act as frontline defenders, addressing a wide array of cases, fulfilling setup and access requests, providing prompt solutions, and ensuring client satisfaction. Their broad knowledge and problem\-solving skills make them indispensable in maintaining the NIQ Platform accessibility, reliability, and usability.
   

  





 Role Definition :
   

  





 Specialists are versatile members of the Global Tech Support team who handle a wide range of issues across all aspects of the applications supported. They serve as the first point of contact for clients and are responsible for SOP driven client setup and administration requests as well as initial troubleshooting and issue resolution. If a case is complex, they raise it to the next level for additional support.
   

  





 Responsibilities :
   

  




* **Client Interaction** 
 \- Specialists manage client communications, addressing queries and concerns promptly and professionally
* **Client Access Setup –** 
 Specialists follow standardized operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure client access is configured accurately and securely. This includes validating account details, applying the correct access levels, and confirming successful activation to minimize onboarding delays and support issues
* **Initial Issue Troubleshooting \-** 
 They perform initial diagnostics to identify the nature of the case and provide immediate solutions when possible
* **Issue Resolution** 
 \- Specialists resolve common cases and ensure that clients can continue using the applications with minimal disruption
* **Escalation** 
 \- For complex or unresolved cases, Specialists escalate the problem to the next level
* **Documentation** 
 \- They maintain detailed case records, resolutions, and client interactions to ensure continuity and knowledge sharing within the team



 Skills :
   

  





**Broad Knowledge** 
 \- Specialists possess a broad understanding of NIQ applications, including their functionalities, user interfaces, and common issues.
   

  





**Problem\-Solving** 
 \- They have strong analytical skills to diagnose and resolve a variety of technical problems.
   

  





**Communication** 
 \- Effective communication skills are essential for interacting with clients and conveying information clearly.
   

  





**Adaptability** 
 \- Specialists must be adaptable to handle diverse issues and work in a dynamic environment.
   

  





 Tasks :
   

  





**Responding to Cases** 
 \- Specialists manage incoming support tickets, prioritize them based on urgency, and provide accurate, timely responses.
   

  





**Performing Diagnostics** 
 \- They use diagnostic tools and techniques to identify the situation.
   

  





**Providing Solutions** 
 \- Specialists offer solutions to common problems, such as software access configuration, user errors, and minor bugs.
   

  





**Escalating Issues** 
 \- When an issue requires specialized knowledge or deeper investigation, Specialists escalate it to the appropriate next support level.
   

  





**Example Scenario** 
 \- A client states that they are unable to log into an application. The Specialist would:
   

  




1. Verify the Issue: Confirm that the client is provisioned access properly, verify the client's credentials, and check for any obvious errors, such as email differences or URLs
2. Perform Initial Troubleshooting: Check the user status and ensure the client's network connectivity
3. Provide Immediate Solutions: If the issue is due to a common problem (e.g., password reset), the Specialist provides user directions to resolve it directly
4. Escalate if Necessary: If the issue is complex (e.g., user access is missing), the Specialist escalates it to the next support level for further investigation



 Success metrics :
   

  




* First time right ticket handling, quality communication, and solution/escalation within the expected time frame
* All NIQ technical certifications

description:
Support Technician \| scanO
   

  

 Company: Trismus Healthcare Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (scanO)
   

 Location: Pune, Corporate Office
   

 Employment Type: Full\-time, On\-site
   

 Reports To: Head of Customer Support / Operations
   

  

 About scanO
   

  

 scanO builds AI\-powered oral health screening solutions for dental clinics, including scanO air, our screening unit; scanO engage, our practitioner platform; and scanO care, our patient app.
   

  

 Over 400 units are live across clinics in India, the UK, UAE, and South Africa. When something does not work, clinics rely on our support team. How quickly and effectively we resolve those issues directly impacts their experience with scanO.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a technically strong and customer\-focused Support Technician to join our support desk.
   

  

 Clinics will reach out through email, phone, and WhatsApp with issues ranging from “the scan will not start” to “this AI report looks incorrect.”
   

  

 You will diagnose issues, resolve what you can remotely, escalate technical problems to the appropriate engineer or field technician, and follow through until the clinic is operational again.
   

  

 You will also maintain accurate records of our installed device fleet and help convert real customer issues into actionable feedback for our product, engineering, ML, and clinical teams.
   

  

 This is a technical support role, not a call centre role. You should be able to understand how the device, application, and network work together well enough to isolate and troubleshoot faults remotely.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 1\. Own the Support Queue
   

 Respond to support requests received through support@scanoai.com, phone, and WhatsApp within defined response timelines. Log every issue, maintain accurate statuses, and close the loop with the clinic.
   

  

 2\. Diagnose Issues Remotely
   

 Troubleshoot device, application, connectivity, and user\-related issues through phone, chat, and screen sharing. Reproduce issues wherever possible before escalating them.
   

  

 3\. Escalate \& Follow Through
   

 Raise clear and reproducible bug reports for the engineering team, including logs, unit ID, firmware version, and reproduction steps. Track escalations until resolution and keep the customer informed.
   

  

 4\. Coordinate Field Service
   

 Coordinate technician visits, part replacements, and unit returns with the operations team. Track units from pickup through service and redeployment.
   

  

 5\. Maintain the Fleet Record
   

 Keep accurate records of installed units, including clinic details, unit serial numbers, firmware versions, warranty status, open faults, and service history.
   

  

 6\. Report AI Output Corrections
   

 Collect cases where clinicians dispute or correct AI\-generated reports and share them with the ML and clinical teams, along with relevant images and context.
   

  

 7\. Identify Recurring Patterns
   

 Prepare a weekly summary covering support volumes, recurring faults, and major issue drivers to help the team address root causes instead of individual symptoms.
   

  

 8\. Build the Knowledge Base
   

 Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, FAQs, and clinic\-facing how\-to documentation as the product evolves.
   

  

 9\. Support the Field Team
   

 Provide remote technical assistance during installations, camps, demos, inaugurations, and escalations.
   

  

 Requirements
   

  

 Diploma or degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science, or a related technical field
   

  

 1–3 years of experience in technical support, service desk, field service, or device support
   

  

 Strong freshers with demonstrated technical aptitude may also be considered
   

  

 Comfortable troubleshooting hardware, mobile/web applications, Wi\-Fi, and basic networking
   

  

 Clear spoken and written English and Hindi
   

  

 Marathi or another regional language is an advantage
   

  

 Ability to explain technical solutions clearly to dentists, receptionists, and other non\-technical users
   

  

 Ability to remain calm and professional while handling frustrated customers

 Nice to Have

title: IT Systems Analyst
description:
NEOLYTIX
   

  

 IT Systems Analyst
   

  

 IT Team \| Workforce Tools Administration \| Adoption \& Compliance \| Excel Reporting
   

  

 DEPARTMENT
   

  

 IT Team
   

  

**Experience**
 0–1 Year
   

  

 LOCATION
   

  

 Gurugram (Onsite)
   

  

 REPORTS INTO
   

  

 Assistant Manager
   

  

 SHIFT
   

  

 US Shift (5:00 PM–2:00 AM IST)
   

  

 ⚠ US Shift: 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST, 5 days a week, onsite in Gurugram. This is not a hybrid role. Apply only if you can fully commit to this schedule.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Neolytix runs its operations on a set of third\-party workforce tools, including Dialpad for communication and Hubstaff for time and productivity tracking. These tools only deliver value when they are properly administered and actively used. When licenses go unmanaged or teams aren't using tools correctly, it creates waste and compliance gaps.
   

  

 As an IT Systems Analyst, you will wear two hats. The first is platform administrator: you will manage user accounts, assign and revoke licenses, onboard new joiners, offboard exits, and be the go\-to person for access and user management across these tools. The second is analyst: you will track adoption, monitor compliance, manage license costs, and produce Excel\-based reports and dashboards for IT and management.
   

  

 This is an entry\-level role open to fresh graduates and candidates with up to 1 year of experience. Strong Excel skills and an organised, detail\-oriented approach are the core requirements. You will develop the full scope with guidance from the IT Manager.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Platform Administration \& User Management
   

  

* Create, manage, and deactivate user accounts across Dialpad, Hubstaff, and other assigned tools.
* Assign and revoke licenses based on team requirements, role changes, and access levels.
* Onboard new employees to tools and ensure timely offboarding of departed staff.
* Manage user permissions and access control settings within each platform.
* Serve as the first point of contact for user access issues, login problems, and tool\-related queries.
* Coordinate with tool vendors on admin\-level issues, outages, and support tickets.


 Tool Adoption \& Compliance Tracking
   

  

* Track how teams across Neolytix are using each tool: who is active, how often, and whether usage meets expected standards.
* Identify and report underutilization or non\-compliance to the IT Manager with supporting data.
* Monitor adoption trends over time and flag drops or anomalies before they become larger issues.
* Coordinate with department heads to understand usage patterns and address adoption gaps.


 License Management \& Cost Tracking
   

  

* Maintain a complete record of all licenses: total seats, active users, inactive seats, and renewal dates.
* Track utilization on a rolling basis and flag unused or underused seats to the IT Manager.
* Prepare summaries that help the IT Manager make renewal and cost decisions.
* Monitor monthly tool spend and flag variances before billing cycles.


 Reporting \& Excel Dashboards
   

  

* Build and maintain Excel\-based dashboards and reports covering user activity, adoption rates, license utilization, and cost trends.
* Prepare weekly and monthly management reports in a clear, structured format for IT leadership.
* Handle ad\-hoc data and reporting requests from the IT team accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Keep all reports updated on schedule with no stale data.


 What You Bring
   

  

 Must\-Have
   

  

* Graduate degree in BBA, MBA, BTech, or equivalent. Mandatory.
* MS Excel at a working level: pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, IF formulas, data cleaning, and structured report building. This is the primary reporting tool for the role.
* Organised and process\-driven: you manage tasks, follow\-ups, and deadlines without being reminded.
* Analytical thinking: you can look at a usage table and tell what looks right, what looks off, and what it means.
* Attention to detail: your reports and records are always accurate and up to date.
* Good written and verbal English for internal coordination, user support, and management reporting.


 Strong Preference
   

  

* Prior exposure to SaaS tool administration: any experience managing user accounts or access in any platform (even Google Workspace, Zoom, or similar).
* Basic understanding of software license models: per seat, per user, concurrent pricing.
* Internship or project work involving data, reporting, or IT operations.
* Familiarity with Dialpad, Hubstaff, or similar workforce management or communication tools.


 Nice\-to\-Have
   

  

* Basic understanding of IT asset or software asset management (SAM) concepts.
* SQL: basic querying for data extraction.
* Exposure to ITSM or ticketing tools (Freshdesk, Jira, Zendesk, etc.).
* Power BI or any other reporting tool familiarity.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You keep things organised. Licenses, user lists, and reports are always current because you maintain them without being asked.
* You do not miss deadlines and you do not wait to be reminded.
* You are comfortable being the person teams come to with access issues, and you resolve them calmly and quickly.
* You want to understand why a metric matters, not just how to pull it.


 Eligibility Criteria
   

  

* Education: BBA / MBA / BTech or equivalent is mandatory.
* Excel: functional working level required. Will be tested in the assessment.
* Shift: 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST, 5 days a week, onsite in Gurugram. Non\-negotiable.
* Work Mode: fully onsite, Gurugram. No remote or hybrid option.
* Notice Period: immediate preferred. Up to 15 days considered.


 Performance Expectations (KPIs)
   

  

 In the first 6 months:
   

  

* User onboarding and offboarding completed within 24 hours of request, consistently.
* License registry complete and current within 45 days of joining.
* Inactive or underused licenses flagged monthly with supporting data.
* Reports delivered on time with zero data errors.
* Tool adoption rates tracked by team, with changes flagged proactively.
* User access issues resolved within the agreed response window.


 Hiring Process
   

  

* Stage 1: Talent Management screening.

description:

**Job Description**
**Meet the Team**
 Cisco Customer Experience (CX) is a global team of extraordinary technical specialists whose singular focus is delivering a premier customer experience. We partner with the world's leading Service Providers to tackle their most complex network transformation challenges — designing, deploying, and optimizing next\-generation infrastructures built on Cisco's industry\-leading IOS\-XR platforms, IP/MPLS architectures, and cloud\-native solutions. Our SP Migration practice sits at the heart of some of the largest and most strategically significant network modernization program globally, driving measurable outcomes for customers while advancing Cisco's position as the trusted partner of choice.

Working alongside senior technical leads, you will help accelerate customer business outcomes by supporting the design, configuration, testing, and execution of migrations across Cisco SP platforms. This role offers hands\-on exposure to cutting\-edge network technology, real\-world migration execution, and the opportunity to develop deep expertise in IOS\-XR, IP/MPLS, and automation — positioning you for accelerated career growth within Cisco CX.
   

  

* Support the design and implementation of Service Provider network migrations, including platform upgrades, topology changes, and protocol transitions across Cisco IOS\-XR \& Nexus \-based router platforms (ASR, NCS, and Cisco 8K Series).
* Contribute to the development of technical documentation including test plans, MOPs, and post\-migration validation reports that meet Cisco CX quality standards.
* Apply Python scripting and automation tooling to accelerate repetitive migration tasks, improving delivery efficiency and reducing manual error rates.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including TAC, and partner organizations to resolve escalated issues and maintain customer satisfaction throughout the migration lifecycle.

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline; or equivalent, demonstrable work experience in a network engineering role.
* Active CCNA certification; CCNP (Service Provider) certification highly desirable or actively in progress.
* 1–3 years of hands\-on experience configuring, deploying, and troubleshooting Cisco routing and switching platforms, including exposure to IOS\-XR environments.
* Working knowledge of core Service Provider networking protocols: BGP, IS\-IS, OSPF, IP/MPLS, and QoS fundamentals.
* Demonstrated experience supporting or executing network migration activities, including lab validation, MOP adherence, and change window participation.


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Basic proficiency in Python scripting for network automation tasks; exposure to Ansible, REST APIs, or NETCONF/YANG is an advantage.
* Foundational awareness of AI/ML applications in network operations (AIOps) and an interest in leveraging AI\-driven tooling to enhance service delivery.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to document technical procedures clearly and engage confidently with customer technical teams.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team\-oriented, high\-velocity delivery environment; proactive, detail\-oriented, and committed to continuous learning.


 Why Cisco?
