**Network Engineer (WAN) \- GCS**
**Senior Associate / Associate**
**Job Summary:**
 The Network Engineer (WAN) within Global Connectivity Solutions (GCS) supports vulnerability remediation, software lifecycle management, firmware upgrades, and production change execution across enterprise WAN infrastructure. The role performs technical implementation, validation, troubleshooting, and documentation activities involving Cisco routing and switching, Versa SD\-WAN, WAN links, and related connectivity platforms.
   

  

 The position works with Senior Engineers, Network Engineering, Network Operations, Information Security, Change Management, Outage Management, vendors, carriers, and service providers to execute remediation and upgrade activities safely and maintain compliance with approved software and operational standards.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Support vulnerability remediation activities across Versa SD\-WAN, Cisco routing and switching, and WAN connectivity platforms.
* Execute approved software and firmware upgrades on Cisco ISR and ASR routers, Catalyst platforms supporting WAN connectivity, Versa SD\-WAN controllers, branch edge devices, and supporting infrastructure.
* Review and implement assigned remediation actions arising from vendor security advisories, software recommendations, defects, and EOS/EOL notices.
* Support software lifecycle management and platform currency for Cisco routing and switching platforms and Versa SD\-WAN infrastructure.
* Perform pre\-upgrade validation, compatibility checks, configuration reviews, software image verification, post\-upgrade validation, and health checks.
* Prepare and maintain implementation procedures, rollback steps, validation plans, technical assessments, change tasks, and deployment records.
* Participate in CAB preparation and support Senior Engineers during technical change reviews when required.
* Execute approved remediation activities, platform upgrades, configuration updates, and network changes within planned maintenance windows.
* Troubleshoot Versa SD\-WAN overlays, underlay connectivity, routing protocols, enterprise routing infrastructure, and WAN link issues.
* Diagnose and resolve issues involving BGP, OSPF, route policies, WAN failover, VPN connectivity, QoS, traffic steering, and application forwarding policies.
* Support troubleshooting of ISP circuits, branch connectivity, SD\-WAN fabric health, cloud connectivity, and data center interconnects.
* Work with vendors, carriers, service providers, and internal teams to restore service and resolve technical issues.
* Participate in outage calls, incident recovery, impact assessment, issue investigation, root cause analysis, and resolution validation.
* Support Problem Management by providing technical analysis, logs, command outputs, trends, and troubleshooting evidence.
* Support remediation waves, upgrade deployments, technology refreshes, and WAN modernization initiatives.
* Participate in testing, implementation, stabilization, and post\-deployment validation activities.
* Maintain operational runbooks, remediation documentation, software compliance records, upgrade history, and implementation outcomes.
* Provide accurate progress updates and promptly escalate technical risks, blockers, failed validations, and dependencies.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, compliance validation, monitoring, and operational improvement.


**Knowledge \& Competencies Required:**
* Working knowledge of Versa SD\-WAN, including Versa Director and Analytics, overlays, underlay connectivity, traffic steering, and branch edge operations.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Cisco routing technologies, including ISR and ASR platforms, and switching platforms supporting WAN connectivity.
* Understanding of BGP, OSPF, IP addressing, route selection, redundancy, VPN services, QoS, and WAN failover.
* Ability to troubleshoot WAN links, ISP circuits, branch connectivity, SD\-WAN fabric health, cloud connectivity, and data center interconnects.
* Experience supporting network firmware upgrades, vulnerability remediation, configuration changes, and lifecycle activities.
* Strong troubleshooting discipline, including collection and interpretation of logs, command outputs, alerts, and monitoring data.
* Working knowledge of Change, Incident, Problem, Risk, and Release Management practices.
* Ability to follow implementation procedures, complete validation accurately, and escalate unexpected conditions appropriately.
* Good technical documentation, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Knowledge of network monitoring, observability, analytics, and automation platforms.
* Basic scripting or automation knowledge using APIs, Python, Ansible, or related tools is desirable.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, compliance focus, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Willingness to work in a global support model, including rotational shifts and support across multiple time zones.
* Flexibility to support maintenance, deployments, upgrades, remediation, and incident recovery outside regular business hours when required.
* Ready to travel when required and collaborate with globally distributed teams, vendors, carriers, and service providers.


**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical discipline


**Experience:**
* Minimum of 3\-6 years of experience in enterprise WAN network engineering, SD\-WAN, routing and switching, or related network technology support.


**Certification Requirements:**
* CCNA preferred. Versa Associate certification and ITIL v4 Foundation are value adds.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: VPN Engineer
description:
Graviton is a privately funded quantitative trading firm striving for excellence in financial markets' research. We are seeking a Network Engineer for our team in Gurgaon. Graviton trades across a multitude of asset classes and trading venues using a gamut of concepts and techniques ranging from time series analysis, filtering, classification, stochastic models, pattern recognition to statistical inference analysing terabytes of data to come up with ideas to identify pricing anomalies in financial markets.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Manage and support corporate network infrastructure across multiple locations, including routers, firewalls, switches, wireless access points, VPN gateways, Internet links, and LAN/WAN connectivity.
* Configure and troubleshoot VPN technologies such as IPsec, SSL VPN, site\-to\-site VPN, remote\-access VPN, WireGuard, OpenVPN, and FortiClient/FortiGate VPN, including issues related to authentication, tunnels, routing, DNS, packet loss, performance, split tunnelling, and firewall policies.
* Manage secure connectivity between offices, data centres, cloud environments, and remote users.
* Configure and maintain office LAN infrastructure, including VLANs, trunk/access ports, inter\-VLAN routing, DHCP, DNS, NAT, ACLs, static routing, BGP, and OSPF where required.

* Coordinate with ISPs and telecom providers for new circuits, link failures, bandwidth upgrades, routing issues, packet\-loss investigations, and service escalations.
* Manage firewall policies, NAT rules, VPN policies, network objects, and routing, while regularly reviewing and removing unnecessary access.
* Implement network segmentation across user, server, management, guest, and other business networks, while maintaining secure administrative access to network equipment.
* Support MFA and secure authentication for remote VPN users and investigate suspicious network activity and connectivity issues.
* Work with security teams on vulnerability remediation, firewall reviews, and network audits.
* Manage wired and wireless office connectivity, including VLANs, access points, SSIDs, authentication, and guest Wi\-Fi.
* Support network connectivity for new office expansions and relocations, including coordination of cabling, patch panels, switch ports, ISP connections, and network equipment installations.
* Maintain accurate documentation for network diagrams, IP addresses, VLANs, VPN tunnels, firewall rules, ISP circuits, device inventory, switch\-port mappings, and Wi\-Fi infrastructure.
* Maintain SOPs for common networking tasks and incident recovery, and follow established change\-management processes for production changes.
* Prepare implementation and rollback plans for major network changes and maintain configuration backups for routers, switches, firewalls, and VPN gateways.
* Basic experience with network automation is preferred, including Python, Bash/Shell scripting, Ansible, REST APIs, and other network automation tools.
* Automate repetitive tasks such as network checks, configuration backups, VPN monitoring, IP validation, and device health checks where possible.



  





**Qualifications** 




 The ideal candidate will have 3\+ years of experience with:
 


* Automate repetitive tasks such as network checks, configuration backups, VPN monitoring, IP validation, and device health checks where possible.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing and switching, VLANs, NAT, DHCP, DNS, and Internet routing.
* Hands\-on knowledge of VPN technologies, including IPsec and SSL VPN, as well as firewalls, access\-control policies, and network troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of BGP, OSPF, and VRFs, along with their application in enterprise network environments.
* Knowledge of high availability, load balancing, network security, Wi\-Fi, and Linux networking.
* Experience with network automation and technologies such as Python, Bash/Shell scripting, Ansible, REST APIs, and network automation tools is preferred.



  





**Why Join Graviton?** 



* Work in a high\-performance, data\-driven trading and engineering environment.
* Collaborate with some of the brightest minds in quantitative finance and technology.
* Competitive compensation, benefits and opportunities for professional growth.

description:

 You'll own the journey from client requirement to production system.

**⚙️ How We Work** 



* All code is reviewed before it merges. Architectural decisions sit with the Principal AI / Systems Architect; implementation decisions are yours
* Client delivery code lives in client\-specific repositories, separate from the core platform
* Weekly standup with the founding team, daily async updates in Slack
* Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot aren't tolerated here, they're expected. If you're not building agentically, you're building slowly



  





**📦 What You'll Have Built** 




 In your first six months:
 


* Two or more production AI systems live with enterprise clients, from first discovery call to deployment
* A reusable delivery stack: orchestration patterns, eval harnesses and deployment templates so no engagement starts from a blank repo
* A monitoring and validation layer that catches drift and quality issues before the client does
* Documentation and handover packs that make every deployment maintainable without you
* A weekly shipping cadence clients set their watch by

* A strong T1 technical degree, with an Master's in an AI native program preferred. We hire on evidence, not just pedigree
* Serious Python and full\-stack fundamentals. Non\-negotiable, and how we'll assess you. You'll be handed a real problem and a hard time limit
* Native to agentic development: Claude Code or similar as your primary way of building, with the depth to review, correct and harden everything it generates
* Production LLM experience: you've shipped something real on model APIs and you understand context management, token economics, latency and failure modes
* DevOps competence: Docker, CI/CD, cloud deployment (AWS preferred)
* Client\-ready communication. You can explain a technical trade\-off to a non\-technical stakeholder without dumbing it down or drowning them

* Nice to have: RAG and retrieval systems, MCP, eval frameworks, event\-driven architecture, exposure to healthcare or other regulated industries



  





**📍Role Basics** 



* Role: Full Stack AI Engineer (Full\-time)
* Location: Fully Remote, Start ASAP
* Compensation: $250pm with a world\-class mentorship program and the real prospect of a FT role



  





**Why Join Unloq®?** 



* Learn from the best. You'll work directly with the founders on live enterprise deployments, and grow faster than any grad scheme would allow
* Real craft, real ownership. Your code ships to paying enterprise clients. There is no layer between your work and the outcome it drives
* Direct founder access. Small team, big problems, zero bureaucracy
* Modern stack. Claude and Claude Code at the core, Databricks underneath, ClickUp for delivery
* We're building something that doesn't exist yet: the layer that makes AI trustworthy enough for the boardroom, not just the back office. It's early, it's hard, and the right people find that exciting. If you take pride in flawless execution done properly, this is your role.

We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned \& damaged product value, and create the best customer returns experience in the world.
   

  

 Amazon WW R\&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re\-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world\-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.
   

  

 As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C\+\+, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements.
   

  

 We are looking for software engineers with 2\+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.
   

  

 We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.

title: Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
**Full\-Stack AI Engineer, Titan Capital** 




**Location:** 
 Gurgaon Sec 67, in office/hybrid \|
 **Experience: 2** 
 \-4 years \|
 **Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About** 




 Titan Capital is a leading early\-stage venture capital firm investing in India's most ambitious startups at the seed stage. With a portfolio spanning 300\+ companies in consumer, fintech, SaaS, healthcare and emerging technologies, Titan partners closely with exceptional founders to build category\-defining companies.
 



 Our investment team builds its own solutions and MVPs \- sourcing engines, portfolio trackers and diligence agents that the firm now depends on daily. We are hiring one go\-getter AI\-native engineer to own data, IT and AI resources at Titan: to develop the solutions the team needs, decide which prototypes merit investment, move them into a secure production environment, and build the architecture that enhances Titan’s AI\-native capabilities.
 



  





**What will you do?** 



* Build solutions in collaboration with the team. In many cases, you will own a problem from the requirement itself as the sole builder. In others, you will take a prototype the team has already built into production, working alongside whoever built it, understanding the intent, and agreeing jointly on what to harden, what to rebuild and what to retire.
* Own the operational foundation end to end: deployment, CI/CD, monitoring, backups, secrets management, role\-based access and audit logging.
* Build the evaluation and guardrail layer. An agent that is correct eighty percent of the time on deal data remains a liability until its accuracy can be measured and bounded.
* Design scalable APIs and data models (Node.js / Express.js, MongoDB) and clear, responsive interfaces (React / Next.js).
* Own production incidents personally, from alert through resolution to post\-mortem.
* Integrate LLMs and AI APIs into production applications: retrieval, agents, tool use, and structured extraction from unstructured documents.
* Work AI\-natively yourself. Coding agents, evals and automation are how we expect this role to ship at the pace of a small team rather than one person.
* Maintain our data posture under India's DPDP Act and under LP security review.
* Work from problem definition rather than a specification. Translate the requirements of the investment and operations teams into technical solutions, and challenge them where the trade\-offs warrant it.
* Raise the technical capability of the team. Review what non\-engineers ship, provide patterns and guardrails, and ensure the team can keep prototyping.
* Study how leading teams are deploying AI, and bring the architectures worth adopting back to Titan Capital.



  





**What are we looking for?** 



* An AI\-native builder. You reach for LLMs, coding agents and automation as a default working method, not as an experiment..
* Demonstrated experience shipping LLM\-based systems into production, with real users depending on them. Fluency in prompt engineering, retrieval design and evaluation. You can distinguish a production\-ready model output from one that is not.
* Backend, where this role sits heaviest. Three plus years of experience building APIs and data models in Node.js / Express.js with MongoDB, working with SQL, and handling messy third‑party data. Job queues, retries, rate limits and schema drift are familiar territory.
* Frontend, React / Next.js. Pixel\-perfect design work is not required. Interfaces that are fast, clear and difficult to misuse are.
* Networking and infrastructure fundamentals. HTTP, DNS, TLS, VPCs, load balancing, authentication flows and latency budgets. You can trace a slow request from browser to database and account for the time.
* Genuine DevOps competence, including hands\-on responsibility for systems running in production.
* A working security instinct. You understand the cost of a credential in a repository, the case for role\-based access, and the response required when a vendor token is compromised. Application security or ethical hacking experience is an advantage.
* Comfort inheriting code you did not write. Some of your work begins as someone else's prototype, and you can read it, respect the intent behind it, and rebuild it constructively.
* An ownership mindset that does not depend on structure around it.
* Strong collaborative skills. You can sit with a team member, extract the real requirement from an imprecise brief, and explain a technical trade\-off without jargon.



  





**Nice to have:** 
 founding engineer experience, internal tooling or data infrastructure, entity resolution and deduplication, exposure to venture capital or private markets.

description:

 22 LPA – 38 LPA
   

  

**About Us \& Our Mission**
 Our company builds mission\-critical B2B SaaS architecture operating at the demanding intersection of global supply chain logistics and high\-throughput fintech settlement rails. Our platform ingests millions of inventory telemetry events, transactional ledger movements, and vector search queries every single hour. Maintaining absolute data consistency, partition tolerance, and low latency across distributed nodes is the core engineering challenge that keeps our platform running smoothly.
   

  

 We believe that building resilient distributed systems requires deep architectural discipline, rigorous concurrency control, and clean, modular code. If you are passionate about solving hard problems in distributed consistency, event sourcing, and high\-concurrency database states, you will find your ultimate engineering home with us.
   

  

 The Role \& Impact
   

  

 We are seeking an elite, hands\-on
 **Distributed Systems Engineer** 
 to take full ownership of our core ledger synchronization and transactional state replication engine. In this role, you will design, build, and scale distributed backend services that guarantee ACID compliance and high availability across multi\-region cloud deployments. You won't just write standard CRUD endpoints; you will architect fault\-tolerant consensus mechanisms, optimize network partition recovery, and ensure that our financial ledgers and supply chain telemetry remain perfectly synchronized under massive enterprise load.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities \& Daily Expectations
   

  

* Distributed Architecture: Design, build, and scale low\-latency distributed microservices and consensus\-driven backend architectures using Go, Rust, or Python.
* State Synchronization: Implement event\-sourcing patterns, CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation), and distributed locking mechanisms to handle high\-concurrency transactional updates.
* Database Partitioning \& Sharding: Architect and manage horizontal database sharding, cross\-region replication, and eventual\-consistency models for large\-scale enterprise data stores.
* Resiliency \& Fault Tolerance: Build robust retry logic, circuit breakers, dead\-letter queues, and automated failover systems to handle network partitions and service degradation gracefully.
* Performance Profiling: Conduct deep bottleneck analysis, memory profiling, and network payload optimization to achieve sub\-millisecond internal response times.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with data engineering, DevOps, and product squads to align distributed system capabilities with evolving business requirements.


**What We Are Looking For (Requirements)**
* Experience: 3 to 6 years of professional backend software engineering experience focusing heavily on distributed systems, concurrency, and high\-throughput data processing.
* Technical Mastery: Deep proficiency in systems programming or backend engineering using Go, Rust, or Python, combined with advanced understanding of networking protocols (TCP/UDP, gRPC, HTTP/2\).
* Database \& Messaging Expertise: Hands\-on experience with distributed databases (CockroachDB, Cassandra, or distributed PostgreSQL setups) and event streaming brokers (Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ).
* Theoretical Foundation: Solid grasp of the CAP theorem, consensus algorithms (Raft/Paxos), distributed transactions (2PC/Saga patterns), and vector clock synchronization.
* Engineering Mindset: Strong system design capabilities, meticulous debugging skills, and a proactive ownership mentality.


**What We Offer \& How To Apply**

title: Software Development Engineer II - Conversations
description:
**About HighLevel:**
 HighLevel is an AI\-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150\+ countries, fueling community\-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
   

  

 To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
   

  

 Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2\.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250\+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long\-term scalability.
   

  

**Our people**
 With over 2,000 team members across 10\+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote\-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.
   

  

**Our impact**
 Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1\.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
   

  

 Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
   

  

**What are we hiring for?**
 The systems that run millions of businesses.
   

  

 Every month, 2\.6 billion messages flow through our platform. Our automation engine enrolls 3\.1 billion contacts and executes 21\.5 billion workflow actions in the same window \- with API traffic peaking at 28,000\+ requests per second. If these systems lag, businesses lose leads. If they go down, people lose income.
   

  

 You haven't built at this scale yet. That's fine \- almost nobody has.
   

  

 What we're hiring for is the engineer who reads those numbers and feels pulled toward them. Who wants to know what a queue looks like when it's absorbing a 10x burst, what an index does at 1\.5 TB, what "eventually consistent" actually means when a customer is staring at the screen. You'll work on real production paths from week one — with senior engineers around you who've broken and fixed these systems before. You'll build. You'll break things. You'll learn faster here than anywhere else.
   

  

**Team \& System Overview:**
 The Conversations organization powers multi\-channel communication across SMS, Email, WhatsApp, and DMs — handling over 2B messages each month. The Threads \& Composer team owns the inbox and composer surfaces, and the backend services that deliver and store those interactions.You’ll work across Node.js microservices, GCP\-based infra (GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks), and MongoDB/Firestore storage layers, ensuring every message and UI state stays consistent, fast, and recoverable.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Build and ship features in Node.js / Go services that sit on real production paths — your code handles live traffic, not toy problems
* Own well\-scoped services and components end to end: code, tests, rollout, and monitoring
* Work with SQL and NoSQL data stores — writing queries, adding indexes, and learning why the schema looks the way it does
* Get hands\-on with queues, caches, and rate limiters — the building blocks of every system here
* Ship Vue 3 UIs that consume your own APIs — clean components, sane state management, and realtime updates that don't flicker or drift
* Write design docs for your features and defend them in review — clear thinking, honest trade\-offs
* Join the on\-call rotation with backup from senior engineers — incidents are where the deepest learning happens
* Ask questions relentlessly, absorb feedback from code reviews, and level up fast


**Requirements:**
* 2\+ years of backend engineering experience with strong fundamentals in Node.js, Go, or a comparable language — and the drive to go deep in ours
* Working knowledge of queues or async processing — you've used Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar, and want to master delivery semantics, ordering, and backpressure
* Genuine interest in distributed systems — you understand the basics (idempotency, retries, consistency trade\-offs) and are hungry to learn the rest by building
* Hands\-on with Redis or another cache/in\-memory store, even at small scale
* Comfortable with SQL or NoSQL databases — you can model data, write efficient queries, and reason about indexes
* Proficient in Vue 3 or a similar modern frontend framework — solid component design and real experience with state management (Pinia, Vuex, or equivalent)
* You write tests as a habit and can put your design thinking into a clear doc
* AI\-native builder — you code with agents daily and are pushing to get accurate, production\-quality output from them


**Technical Environment:**
* Languages: Node.js (TypeScript), Go
* Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia, Vite, Tailwind
* Storage: MongoDB, Firestore, Redis, ElasticSearch, ClickHouse
* Infra: GCP — GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks
* CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes


**Why This Role**
 Most engineers spend years at companies where "scale" means a few hundred requests per second — and never find out what they're capable of.
   

  

 Here, the systems are the teacher. Every design decision has a visible consequence at billions of events a month. Every incident is a masterclass. You'll sit in architecture reviews with staff engineers debating storage engines and consistency models — and within a year, you'll be contributing to those debates, not just watching them.
   

  

**If you optimize your career for learning velocity, there is no faster track than this.**
**On AI**
 We're past the debate. AI is part of how we build \- and we expect you to be
 **hungry for it** 
 .
   

  

 You already code with agents daily. You're learning what they're good at, where they hallucinate, and how to get
 **accurate, tested, slop\-free code** 
 out of them fast. You treat AI as a multiplier on your learning speed, not a substitute for understanding.
   

  

 If you're still copy\-pasting from a chat window and hoping, this isn't the seat for you.
   

  

**What You're Built For**
* You're deeply curious — you don't stop at "it works," you need to know why it works
* You read post\-mortems and system\-design write\-ups for fun, not because someone assigned them
* You've built things beyond your job description — side projects, internal tools, that one system you rewrote because the old one bothered you
* You take feedback like a gift: code review comments make your next PR better, every time
* When something breaks, your first instinct is curiosity, not panic


**What Success Looks Like**
* You own a service or component that the team trusts you on completely
* You're a dependable on\-call engineer — you've debugged real incidents and shipped the fixes
* Your design docs have gone from "reviewed heavily" to "approved with nits"
* Senior engineers pull you into harder problems — because you've earned it
* You're visibly on the path to SDE\-3, and everyone around you knows it


**Bonus Points**
* Familiarity with our stack: GCP, MongoDB, Firestore, ClickHouse, ElasticSearch
* You've contributed to a messaging, automation, or event\-driven system — at any scale
* Side projects or open\-source work that shows you build because you can't not build


**EEO Statement:**
 The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.
   

  

 We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering
 



  
 



  





**EXPERIENCE** 




 \-  Freshers or 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in electromagnetic system design and motor analysis.
 



 \-  Expertise in electromagnetic simulation softwares
 



 \- Solid understanding of electrical machine theory, electromagnetic fields, thermal management, and mechanical sizing constraints.

 \-  Strong problem\-solving ability and an ownership mindset in a fast\-paced hardware startup environment.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
**About Airbound**
**Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.**
 This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.
   

  

 The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground\-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.
   

  

 To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.
   

  

**About Hardware Engineering**
 Hardware Engineering owns the aircraft's physical development, from a concept sketch to a part that flies. This spans system design, mechanism design, and structural design: working out how something moves, what it's made of, and whether it holds up under real load. Because most of what we design is custom, it also means designing the equipment we use to prove our work — rigs, jigs, and testers built specifically to validate a design before it goes anywhere near a real flight. It's one team across concept, design, initial prototyping, and test: the full arc of getting a product from an idea to something that ships.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're hiring Mechanical Engineers across all levels. Apply regardless of years of experience; we'll place you at the right level based on your background and how you perform through the interview process. You'll take mechanical assemblies from concept through design, prototyping, testing, and into a shipped product, working closely with flight systems, composites, manufacturing, and external vendors along the way. We're looking for engineers who've shipped real hardware before, ideally having seen a product through at least one full development lifecycle, and who are comfortable owning a problem from first sketch to flying part. We're hiring for two kinds of strength on this team, and you should be strong in at least one: detailed mechanism design, or composites and structures.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Mechanical Systems Design**
* Design and develop mechanical systems and assemblies for our aircraft, from early concept through production intent
* Build and test prototypes yourself \- this is a hands\-on role where you will own an end\-to\-end mechanical system from concept through testing through production


**Analysis \& Validation**
* Run load calculations, tolerance stacks, basic FEA, and weight budgets to validate designs before they're cut or molded


**Manufacturing Process Collaboration**
* Work with composites layup, injection molding, additive manufacturing, and CNC machining to choose the right process for each part


**Composites \& Structures Track**
* If focused on composites/structures: build and improve how we model and design composite structures (laminate design, layup optimization, and structural analysis) rather than just building to a fixed layup


**Mechanism Design Track**
* If focused on mechanism design: select the right actuation hardware for the job (servos, stepper motors, and similar) and write short scripts to drive and test them


**Vendor \& Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Partner with external vendors and fabrication shops to get parts made to spec, on time
* Translate requirements from internal teams (flight systems, manufacturing, product) and external stakeholders into concrete mechanical designs
* Chase down the details that make the difference between a part that works on the bench and one that survives a thousand flights


**Qualifications**
 Must\-Have
   

  

* Advanced proficiency in 2D and 3D CAD
* Working knowledge of load calculations, tolerance analysis, basic FEA, and weight budgeting
* Ability to do first principles checks on loads, forces, energies with napkin calcs, or free body diagrams
* Hands\-on experience designing and prototyping mechanical/electromechanical assemblies for robotics applications
* Familiarity with the basics of composites layup, injection molding, additive manufacturing, and machining
* Strength in at least one of the following:
+ Detailed mechanism design (including selecting the right actuation hardware \- servos, stepper motors, and similar \- and writing short scripts to drive and test them)
+ Composites and structures (including composite modeling and analysis, not just layup execution)

* Basic project management skills \- able to scope, plan, and run your own projects with minimal oversight
* Strong attention to detail and genuine ownership over the parts you touch
* Clear communicator, comfortable working directly with both internal engineering teams and external vendors
* Willingness to go the extra mile when a project needs it


 Good to Have
   

  

* Experience with designing / building parts for UAV or aerospace applications
* Hands\-on project experience (BAJA, FSAE, or similar build teams) is a great substitute for professional experience, especially earlier in your career


**Work location:** 
 Hoskote, Bangalore (Headquarters)
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Comprehensive health insurance to keep you and your loved ones covered
* Relocation assistance and a daily travel stipend to ease your commute
* Advanced salary credit to support you when you need it


 “A driven, passionate team where you’ll have room to grow and thrive \-
 **this is more than just a job, it’s a rare opportunity to build something meaningful** 
 from the ground up”
   

  

**Work Schedule**
* In\-office role, working alternate Saturdays.


 Ready to take off?

 Beware of impersonators collecting fees for interviews \& jobs at Airbound (Opendrone Private Limited) Please do not make any payments and report any such incidents to us at contact@airbound.com .

title: Junior Product Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Nerve Solutions is a technology\-driven company focused on real\-time risk management and surveillance solutions for financial markets. Its products enable market participants to detect and quantify risk and anomalies in live markets and respond at sub\-second speeds. The team also builds automated trading systems that support high\-performance, data\-intensive decision\-making. Over time, Nerve Solutions has become a trusted technology partner to several major financial services organizations in the region, offering robust, scalable, and reliable market technology. The company values engineering excellence, innovation, and close collaboration with financial institutions.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Junior Product Manager will support the end\-to\-end lifecycle of financial technology products, from discovery and requirements gathering through delivery and ongoing optimization. In this full\-time on\-site role based in Mumbai, the Junior Product Manager will collaborate with engineering, design, and business stakeholders to define features, write user stories, and prioritize the product backlog. Daily responsibilities include analyzing user and market data, monitoring product performance, preparing documentation, and coordinating with cross\-functional teams to ensure timely releases. The role also involves assisting with product roadmaps, participating in client meetings, and helping translate complex market and technical concepts into clear product specifications. The successful candidate will contribute to continuous improvement of risk management and automated trading products while learning best practices in modern product management.
   

**Qualifications**
* Ability to work with cross\-functional teams, collaborate with engineers, designers, and business stakeholders, and communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, including comfort with quantitative data, market analysis, and interpreting metrics to inform product decisions.
* Foundational understanding of product management practices such as user research, requirements gathering, backlog management, and release coordination.
* Interest or background in financial markets, trading systems, or risk management technology; prior exposure to capital markets or fintech is an advantage.
* Basic proficiency with productivity and documentation tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentation software, project tracking tools) and willingness to learn new product tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work on\-site in Mumbai, manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment, and take initiative under guidance from senior product leaders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and a commitment to inclusive, ethical, and user\-centric product development.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About the Client** 




 Our client is a global leading, end\-to\-end enterprise volunteer engagement platform powering over 100 million volunteer hours. They exist to connect communities to events and causes they are passionate about. Used by over 3 million volunteers across 26 different countries, their SaaS platform powers mass volunteer programs across the globe for Not\-for\-Profits, local government, sporting federations, and major events. Our all in one solution helps our clients to recruit, retain, reward and train their volunteers, whilst also ensuring compliance.
 



  





**About Teamified** 




 Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast\-
 



 scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and
 



 accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high
 



 performing global teams simple, fast, and cost\-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers,
 



 designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.
 



  





**About The Role** 




 We're looking for a mid\-level Product Manager to join us in working directly
 



 with customers to understand their pain points and turning individual asks into solutions that scale across our whole customer base. This role sits across web and mobile, with a strong focus on compliance and platform consistency, and partners closely with Engineering, UX, Solutions Consulting, and Support.
 



 This is a role for someone who is genuinely curious about customers and how the product works in their hands, who can hold their own in a triad, and who's comfortable making prioritization calls backed by evidence rather than instinct alone.
 



**What you'll work on** 



* Work directly with customers to understand pain points and use cases, with a particular focus on customer\-raised asks and requests
* Translate individual customer problems into solutions that can be rolled out to the broader customer base, not just the requesting account
* Understand and solve for compliance requirements across both web and mobile platforms
* Translate web features into mobile features, ensuring parity and platform\-appropriate design
* Define and prioritize projects and tasks based on evidence and stakeholder consultation
* Proactively report on progress and challenges to stakeholders and leadership
* Own and drive product briefs, working in close collaboration with Engineering, UX, Solutions Consulting (SC), and Support
* Run gap analyses across multiple areas of the platform to identify where it falls short of customer or compliance needs



  





**Requirements** 




**What you bring** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in Product Management (or equivalent experience translating customer needs into shipped features)
* Genuine curiosity about customers and how they use the product
* Ability to clearly articulate problems, proposed solutions, and recommendations, including the trade\-offs behind them
* Strong communication skills, confident and articulate with customers, internal stakeholders, and engineers alike
* Demonstrated experience working within a triad model (Product, Engineering, UX) and directly with customers
* Solid instincts for user experience, knowing what makes a feature usable, not just functional
* Comfort working across both web and mobile product surfaces



**Nice to have** 



* Experience with AI tools applied to product workflows
* Data\-driven decision making
* Experience defining and measuring success metrics for shipped features
* Ability to uncover common themes across disparate customer feedback



**Why this role matters** 




 This PM sits close to the customer, translating real, individual problems into solutions that hold up across the whole platform and customer base. The work directly shapes how consistent, compliant, and usable the product feels across web and mobile, and gives you real ownership over problems from discovery through to delivery.
 



  





**Benefits** 



* Flexibility in work hours and location, with a focus on managing energy rather than time.
* Access to online learning platforms and a budget for professional development
* A collaborative, no\-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
* A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input
* Health insurance
* Leave Benefits
* Provident Fund
* Gratuity



  





 If you possess the required skills and are eager to contribute to our team's success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
 **Apply now!**

description:

 Saisystems Health \| Product Organization \| Reports to Manager, Product Operations

 India (Pune)
 



 Shift : EST Shift timing ( 05\.30pm IST to 02\.30 am IST )

* Support the Principal PM for Data \& Interoperability in managing specifications, testing, and documentation for data services and integration products.
* Write detailed technical specifications, API documentation, and data flow diagrams for integration features.
* Conduct validation testing for FHIR APIs, HL7 interfaces, and data exchange workflows.

Job description:
   

  

**About Narayana Health:** 
 Narayana Health is headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and operates a network of hospitals in India and Overseas. Our mission is to deliver high\-quality, affordable healthcare services to the broader population. Narayana Health Group is India’s leading healthcare provider and one of the largest hospital groups in the country, with a network of 21 hospitals, 5 heart centres, and 19 primary care facilities. The NH group treats over 2\.6 Million patients every year from over 78 countries, covering 30\+ medical specialities.Our Centers of Excellence help in treating Adult \& Pediatric patients, and we have one of the largest transplant centers in India. We have a strong presence across 17 locations in India, and an overseas hospital in the Cayman Islands, USA. Two of our hospitals have international accreditation from the Joint Commission International (JCI), and 19 hospitals have domestic accreditation from the National Accreditation Board for Hospitals (NABH).For more details, please refer to our website at: https://www.narayanahealth.org
 **About Medha:** 
 Medha is the Advanced Analytics \& AI arm of Narayana Health, focused on transforming healthcare through data, intelligence, and thoughtfully designed digital products. Our mission is to simplify decision\-making across hospitals, clinics, and care teams by bringing clarity, precision, and actionability to every layer of healthcare operations.Our products power large health systems, influence mission\-critical workflows, and support clinical and non\-clinical teams in delivering safer, faster, and more coordinated care.
 **For more details, please refer to our website at** 
**https://www.medha\-analytics.ai/** 
**Why Join Medha:** 
* Shape next\-generation healthcare intelligence products that drive decisions for clinicians, operations leaders, and frontline care teams.
* Own and influence multi\-product roadmaps from day one, working at the intersection of clinical insight and technology.
* Solve real, high\-impact problems — every product you build directly supports patient outcomes, operational efficiency, and healthcare quality.
* Collaborate in a vision\-led, cross\-functional environment alongside Engineering, Design, Data, and Clinical domain experts.
* Grow fast in a team that values ownership, analytical rigour, and user empathy equally.


**Job Purpose:** 
* The Product Manager will own product roadmaps across multiple products in the Medha portfolio and lead them through the full lifecycle — from discovery and prioritisation to delivery and post\-launch optimisation.
* This role sits at the nexus of Leadership, Design, Engineering, and Quality, and also carries responsibility for user onboarding, training, and first\-line query resolution — ensuring products deliver measurable value in live healthcare environments.


**Candidate Requirements:** 
**Education:** 
 Master's in Business Administration (MBA) from a premier institute preferred; equivalent analytical or technical postgraduate qualification considered.
 **Experience:** 
 3 – 6 years in product management, preferably in health\-tech, enterprise SaaS, or data/analytics\-driven products.
 **Location:** 
 Bengaluru (primary); travel as required.
 
**Key Responsibilities:** 
**Product Roadmap Ownership** 
* Own and drive product roadmaps for multiple products within the Medha portfolio, ensuring alignment with organisational strategy and business goals.
* Translate high\-level business objectives into clearly defined epics, user stories, and prioritised backlogs.
* Lead quarterly and annual roadmap planning cycles in collaboration with Leadership, balancing strategic bets with near\-term delivery commitments.
* Continuously evaluate and re\-prioritise the roadmap based on user feedback, competitive signals, and data insights.


**Cross\-functional Collaboration** 
* Partner closely with Leadership to understand strategic intent and cascade it into product direction.
* Work hand\-in\-hand with the Design team to drive user research, define experience requirements, and review design artefacts.
* Collaborate with Engineering to scope, estimate, and deliver features on time with high quality — participating in sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives.
* Engage with the Quality team to define acceptance criteria, support UAT, and ensure post\-release stability.


**User Training \& Query Resolution** 
* Lead user onboarding and training sessions for new product releases, ensuring clinical and operational users are confident and proficient.
* Create and maintain user\-facing documentation, FAQs, and training guides tailored to varied user personas (clinical, operational, administrative).
* Serve as the primary escalation point for user queries, coordinating with Engineering and QA for swift resolution of product issues.
* Track recurring issues and user pain points, feeding them into the product roadmap as prioritised improvement items.


**Discovery \& Validation** 
* Conduct user interviews, contextual inquiry, and observational research across hospital environments to deeply understand workflows and unmet needs.
* Perform market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities for product differentiation and innovation.
* Define and validate hypotheses through rapid prototyping, pilots, and structured feedback loops.


**Product Documentation \& Metrics** 
* Author and maintain comprehensive product documentation: PRDs, user stories, feature specifications, and release notes.
* Define product KPIs and success metrics; build dashboards and reports to track adoption, engagement, and outcome impact.
* Drive post\-launch reviews, compiling lessons learned and sharing actionable recommendations with stakeholders.


**Go\-to\-Market \& Stakeholder Communication** 
* Develop product positioning, messaging frameworks, and internal communication plans for major releases.
* Present product updates, roadmap reviews, and strategic proposals to senior leadership with clarity and confidence.
* Maintain strong relationships with key internal stakeholders — hospital operations, clinical leads, finance, and IT — to ensure product adoption and feedback loops are active.


**Required Skills:** 
* Roadmap Strategy \& Execution: Proven ability to own multi\-product roadmaps, balance competing priorities, and drive end\-to\-end delivery.
* Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional verbal and written skills — able to craft compelling narratives for C\-suite, clinical, and engineering audiences alike.
* Analytical \& Data\-Driven Mindset: Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and metrics; experience with analytics or BI tools is a strong advantage.
* User Empathy \& Product Sense: Deep ability to translate user pain points and behavioural insights into impactful product decisions.
* Agile Fluency: Hands\-on experience leading Agile/Scrum ceremonies; familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, or equivalent.
* Technical Literacy: Solid understanding of APIs, data pipelines, system architecture, and cloud platforms — enough to have credible conversations with engineering teams.
* Training \& Enablement: Demonstrated ability to design and deliver training programmes for diverse user groups in operational environments.
* Issue Identification \& Resolution: Skilled at diagnosing product issues, triaging urgency, and coordinating rapid cross\-functional resolution.
* Healthcare Domain Knowledge (Preferred): Familiarity with HIS/EMR systems, clinical workflows, or hospital operations is a significant advantage.

title: Engineering Product Management Specialist
description:
* Customer Intelligence \& Adoption Analyst
* Product Adoption Analyst


**Cisco Spaces \| Bangalore, India**
**Who We're Looking For**
 We're looking for someone who is relentlessly curious and gets excited by finding smarter ways to solve problems.
   

  

 You enjoy figuring things out. You love asking questions, digging into data, connecting dots, and uncovering insights that others miss. You are energized by AI, automation, and market research.
   

  

**Role**
 This role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants more than a narrowly defined job. You'll work alongside a cognitively diverse team of product managers and adoption specialists to help answer some of our most important questions:
   

  

* Which customers are most likely to realize value from Cisco Spaces?
* Who are the right stakeholders to engage within an organization?
* Where are customers getting stuck on their adoption journey?
* How can AI, automation, and analytics help us scale customer adoption?
* What insights should influence our product and adoption strategy?


 We're not looking for someone to maintain spreadsheets or manually research contacts all day. We're looking for someone who can combine market research, customer intelligence, analytics, AI, and business thinking to help solve interesting growth challenges at scale.
   

  

 If you’re naturally curious and want a front\-row seat to how product\-led growth works inside one of Cisco's fastest\-growing product lines, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Customer Intelligence \& Adoption**
* Identify the accounts, stakeholders, champions, and decision\-makers most likely to drive successful adoption of Cisco Spaces by leveraging internal and external data sources.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer personas (from both IT and business teams), buying centers, industry use cases, and adoption patterns across key segments.
* Partner with Product Marketing team to continuously refine Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs), persona frameworks, and targeting strategies based on customer behaviour, product usage, and business outcomes.
* Support the PLG\-Lifecycle team to drive targeted customer engagement and adoption programs.
* AI, Automation \& Scale
* Leverage AI, automation, and modern data tools to improve research, segmentation, and targeting.
* Design scalable workflows that reduce manual effort and enable the team to operate with speed and efficiency.
* Continuously challenge existing processes \& experiment with emerging technologies and new ways of working to improve customer intelligence and adoption outcomes.
* Analytics \& Insights
* Analyze customer and product data to uncover trends, opportunities, risks, and barriers to adoption.
* Build dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that help stakeholders make informed decisions.
* Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that influence product adoption.
* Work with the Product Ops and Business Intelligence team to ensure accurate collection of data and troubleshoot any data abnormalities.


**Required Qualifications**
**What We're Looking For**
* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Analytics, Marketing, or a related field.
* 1\-4 years of experience in automation, analytics, market research, or customer intelligence.
* Experience working in a B2B SaaS or enterprise tech..
* Proficiency in Excel and familiarity with SQL for data exploration and analysis.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate insights to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Exposure to data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
* Experience using AI tools to improve research, analysis, automation, or productivity.
* Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clay, Pendo, Hubspot, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar platforms.
* Strong knowledge of statistics, experimentation, segmentation, or customer analytics.
* Experience with Python, data automation, or workflow automation tools.
* Demonstrated curiosity through side projects, certifications, open\-source contributions, or experimentation with emerging technologies.


**Who We Are**
 We're building the future of smart spaces.
   

  

 Cisco Spaces is one of the fastest\-growing products at Cisco, helping some of the world's largest organizations understand and optimize how people, buildings, and things interact with each other. From hospitals and airports to workplaces, educational campuses, and major venues, our customers use Cisco Spaces to solve business challenges at scale.
   

  

 Think indoor navigation that helps visitors find their way through buildings. Asset tracking that helps healthcare providers locate critical equipment in seconds. Occupancy, guest onboarding, and analytics that help organizations deliver better customer and employee experiences.
   

  

 We've already digitized more than 19 billion square feet of space worldwide, but we're still in the early innings of what this category can become.
   

  

 What makes Cisco Spaces special isn't just the product. It’s also its people.
   

  

 We’re a cognitively diverse team of product thinkers who challenge each other's assumptions and care deeply about doing great work. The standards are high, but…there's always someone willing to help you think through a challenge. You'll be given real ownership early, supported by people who care deeply about your growth and want to see you succeed.
   

  

 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About 30 Sundays** 




 30 Sundays is on a mission to build the most customer\-centric outbound leisure travel company from India. We combine deep destination expertise with technology, operational rigor, and a strong bias for action to deliver effortless, high\-quality travel experiences while building a profitable, scalable business.
 



 Founded by alumni from Apple, BCG, and IIT. Backed by InfoEdge Ventures and Eximius Ventures.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We're hiring a Product Manager to own and build products across the 30 Sundays ecosystem, from customer\-facing tools that power the pre\-sales and post\-sales journey, to internal platforms that make our sales and operations teams more effective.
 



  





 Depending on the vertical, you could be shaping how couples discover, plan, and experience travel, or building the systems that help our teams sell smarter, operate faster, and deliver at scale.
 



  





 This role is for a builder. Someone who combines deep user empathy, strong product judgment, data fluency, and AI\-first thinking to turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions. We believe PMs should be able to go from idea to working prototype fast, using vibe coding with tools like Claude, Cursor, and Replit to build, test, and validate without waiting for engineering cycles.
 



  





 This is an early\-stage, high\-intensity environment. You'll wear multiple hats, move fast, and have outsized ownership. If you thrive in ambiguity and want to build things that ship, not just write docs about them, read on.
 



  





**What You'll Work On** 



* Own the end\-to\-end product experience for your vertical, whether customer\-facing or internal
* Define and drive a clear product vision grounded in user needs and business impact
* Lead product discovery through user research, stakeholder interviews, feedback loops, and data
* Translate insights into clear PRDs, prioritized roadmaps, and measurable success metrics
* Rapidly build functional prototypes and internal tools using vibe coding, turning ideas into working software by prompting AI tools like Claude, rather than waiting for dev bandwidth
* Use LLMs and automation to streamline workflows, personalize experiences, and reduce manual effort
* Use analytics, funnels, cohorts, and experiments to guide decisions and measure outcomes
* Conduct competitive and category research to inform product direction
* Partner closely with design and engineering to ship high\-quality experiences
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with ops, CX, sales, growth, and tech teams to drive adoption and impact



  





**Requirements** 



* 3\+ years of Product Management experience with clear ownership of a product or product area
* Experience building B2C consumer products (web or mobile), travel, fintech, e\-commerce, food delivery, or similar domains where the end user is a person making lifestyle or purchase decisions
* Strong user\-centric mindset, whether the user is a customer booking a trip, a salesperson closing a deal, or an ops team member planning logistics
* Hands\-on comfort with vibe coding, you've used tools like Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, or Replit to build working apps, dashboards, automations, or prototypes. Not just used AI to write docs, but actually shipped something.
* Comfort using data and analytics to drive prioritization and measure impact (SQL, Mixpanel, GA4, or similar)
* Familiarity with AI tools, LLM capabilities, and automation platforms
* Solid understanding of UX principles and lifecycle thinking
* Strong academic background or demonstrated intellectual rigor



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience in travel, hospitality, or high\-consideration purchase categories
* Experience at an early\-stage startup (seed to Series A) where you wore multiple hats
* Growth and funnel expertise, SEO, conversion optimization, A/B testing, retention loops
* Side projects, community building, or entrepreneurial attempts that show initiative beyond the day job



  





**Why Join 30 Sundays** 



* Own a product vertical end\-to\-end at a fast\-growing travel company redefining how Indians travel internationally
* Work directly with founders (ex\-Apple, ex\-BCG, ex\-IIT) with high autonomy and real impact
* Build both the customer experience (how couples discover and book travel) and the engine behind it (how the team sells, plans, and delivers)
* Ship fast using AI and vibe coding, we value PMs who can build, not just spec
* Shape AI\-driven, user\-first products in a category (outbound leisure travel) that's still early and wide open
* Gurugram, on\-site. Competitive base \+ meaningful ESOPs.

 when travel agents grow, we grow with them.

 Work with TravClan’s founders to identify, validate and build high\-priority opportunities. Turn an ambiguous customer or business problem into a testable proposition, launch it quickly and build evidence of customer adoption, revenue or improved economics.

 • Own one or more 0\-to\-1 opportunities from customer discovery and market sizing through pilot and early scale.

 • Speak directly with customers, launch minimum viable solutions and use evidence to iterate, scale or stop.

* The opportunity to build a new business, product or growth charter.

* Competitive compensation of about 18\-35 LPA (80% fixed and 20% variable)

* GM/Director \- 35\-50 LPA
* Head \- 18\-35 LPA
* Manager \- 10\-18 LPA
* Associate \- 5\-10 LPA



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




  






 • 2\-5 years in product, growth, business, consulting, founder’s office or another high\-quality problem\-solving role.
 





 • At least one year of startup experience is strongly preferred.
 





 • Evidence of building, launching or selling something—not only supporting it.
 





 • Strong problem\-solving, analytical, communication and execution skills.
 





 • Comfort working directly with customers and doing hands\-on work beyond the job title.
 





 • Curious, ethical, resilient and comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.
 




  





**You will Thrive in This Role If....** 




  






 • You enjoy turning ambiguity into experiments and measurable outcomes.
 





 • You learn quickly and change direction when evidence demands it.
 





 • You want to earn larger business ownership through demonstrated results.
 




  





**This Role May not be the Right Fit if you.** 




  






 • You expect a founder\-shadowing, research or presentation\-led role.
 





 • You are uncomfortable with customers, sales, targets or hands\-on execution.
 





 • You need a complete playbook before starting.
 





 • You focus on activity rather than measurable business or product outcomes.
 





 • You struggle to prioritise or make decisions with incomplete information.
 





 • You require a slow\-paced environment or highly predictable working hours.
 




  





**The Recruitment Process:** 




  





**1\. Personal Interviews:** 

 2\-3 video interviews. Detailed discussions about the job profile, company \& candidature are discussed in these rounds.
 




**2\. Extending an offer** 

 : On successfully clearing the interview rounds, the job offer is extended to the candidate. This includes financial benefits and many other benefits.
 




  





**Important Points** 




  





**Location** 

 : Connaught Place, New Delhi
 





 Work Schedule:
 
**You are considering joining a startup. Building anything of value takes time.**

title: Product Manager
description:
**The Role, in One Sentence**
 You own the bridge between Customer Success and Engineering — making sure engineering builds what customers can actually use, and making sure customers understand, adopt, and champion what gets built.
   

  

**The Three Metrics You Will Be Measured On**
**Product usage — are customers actually using the modules they pay for**
**Product champions — are there named people inside our accounts who advocate for us**
**Recurring revenue — retention and expansion, as an outcome of the first two**
 Everything below serves these three. If an activity doesn't move one of them, it isn't the job.
   

  

**What This Job Actually Is**
 Read this section carefully. It is the most important part of this posting.
   

  

 What It Means Day to Day
   

  

 \~40% Product
   

  

 Owning the roadmap for existing modules. Prioritisation. Writing specs. Relentlessly simplifying — fewer clicks, less jargon, usable by a 55\-year\-old warden and a 19\-year\-old student alike. Deciding what does not get built.
   

  

 \~30% Engineering \& Delivery
   

  

 Sprint planning, grooming, scope management, release coordination, UAT, post\-release verification. Working daily with our Tech Lead and engineering team.
   

  

 \~30% Customer\-Facing Product Work
   

  

 Product demos. Feature training. Webinars. Roadmap sessions that get customers excited about what's coming. Gathering requirements first\-hand rather than second\-hand.
   

  

 Travel is occasional, not routine. Most customer work is remote. Expect on\-site visits some months and none in others.
   

  

**What This Job Is Not**
* Not account management. We have a Customer Success team. They own accounts, escalations, support tickets, and day\-to\-day service. You do not.
* Not a growth role. There is no funnel to optimise, no experimentation programme, no PLG motion. If your last three years were Mixpanel dashboards and A/B tests, this will make you unhappy within six months.
* Not pure product, not pure engineering. You will not sit in Figma all day, and you will not be writing code. You will spend your time translating in both directions — and the translation is the value.


**What You Will Own**
 Product
   

  

* Roadmap for existing modules — user management, leave and attendance, tickets and assets, mess, amenities, checklists, visitor management, finance, notifications
* Prioritisation across competing asks from Customer Success, Sales, and Engineering
* Simplification as a discipline. Our users are not software people. When engineering ships something in six clicks, your job is to ask why it isn't three. When a screen uses internal terminology, your job is to catch it before a customer does.
* Saying no — to customers, to Sales, and to engineering — with a reason that holds
* Protecting the roadmap from one\-off customisations that fork the product


 Delivery
   

  

* Sprint planning, grooming, and release coordination with the Tech Lead and engineering team
* Turning requirements into specs engineering can act on, with the "why" intact
* UAT and post\-release verification — confirming it works for the customer, not just in staging
* Never committing a date engineering hasn't agreed to


 Customer\-Facing Product Work
   

  

* Product demos that make non\-technical institutional buyers want the product
* Training existing customers on new features so they actually get adopted
* Webinars and roadmap sessions across the customer base
* Building product champions inside accounts — the people who will renew and expand us
* First\-hand requirement gathering, so we aren't building from a game of telephone


 Systems, Not Heroics
   

  

* Every commitment logged. No verbal promises that live only in your head.
* Building the process so it runs without founder involvement.


**Must\-Haves**
* 3\+ years of full\-time product management, post\-graduation, with real ownership specs, prioritisation, sprints, releases.
* Demonstrable ability to run an excellent product demo to a non\-technical audience. This is tested, not taken on trust.
* Experience with external paying customers. Internal\-platform\-only PMs do not fit — you need to have built for people who could leave.
* Sprint ownership: planning, grooming, scope, release. Not "worked alongside a Scrum Master."
* A demonstrated instinct for simplification an example where you removed steps, jargon or complexity from a product and can explain what it did to adoption.
* Requirements ownership: you have interrogated a request, not transcribed it.
* Written English strong enough to send an email to a university Dean without review.
* Bengaluru\-based or genuinely relocating. This is an onsite role.


**Strongly Preferred**
* Education, EdTech, campus, or institutional software
* Products used by low\-digital\-literacy or non\-technical user bases
* Experience running customer webinars, training programmes, or feature\-adoption campaigns


 Explicitly Not Required
   

  

 Mixpanel
   

  

* Amplitude
* A/B testing
* funnel and cohort analytics
* PLG
* SQL
* growth experimentation
* consumer product background.


 These will not improve your candidacy. Their absence will not hurt it.
